HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0001.title: Consider ornaments for frequently needed controls

statement.en: Consider an ornament for frequently needed controls or information that need a consistent, uncluttered location.
statement.ja: 頻繁に必要なcontrolや情報を一貫した整理された場所に置くためornamentを検討する。

conditions: Keep the ornament close to its window so people know where to find it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0001.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate and preserved the consider strength and predictable-location purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0002.title: Keep ornament width within its window

statement.en: Aim to keep a visionOS ornament no wider than its associated window.
statement.ja: visionOS ornamentの幅を関連window以下に保つ。

conditions: Prevent a wide ornament from interfering with tab bars or vertical content beside the window.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0002.review_note: Recorded the same-or-narrower width boundary and side-content interference risk.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0003.title: Consider borderless ornament buttons

statement.en: Consider borderless buttons on a visionOS ornament’s glass background.
statement.ja: visionOS ornamentのglass backgroundではborderless buttonを検討する。

conditions: The glass background provides enough visual definition without a border.
The system supplies the gaze hover effect automatically.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0003.review_note: Preserved MAY and recorded both glass-background and system-hover behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0004.title: Prefer system visionOS toolbars and tab bars

statement.en: Use system-provided visionOS toolbars and tab bars unless a custom component is necessary.
statement.ja: custom componentが必要でない限りsystem-providedのvisionOS toolbarとtab barを使う。

conditions: System toolbars and tab bars already appear as ornaments.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0004.review_note: Recorded automatic ornament presentation and the custom-component exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0005.title: Keep visionOS ornaments generally visible

statement.en: Keep a visionOS ornament visible in general.
statement.ja: 通常はvisionOS ornamentを表示したままにする。

conditions: Preserve consistent access to the ornament’s controls.
exceptions: Hide an ornament when people intentionally immerse themselves in window content such as a video or photo.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0005.review_note: Recovered the general visibility rule and retained the content-immersion exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0006.title: Balance windows with multiple ornaments

statement.en: Prioritize the window’s overall visual balance when displaying multiple visionOS ornaments.
statement.ja: 複数のvisionOS ornamentを表示する場合はwindow全体のvisual balanceを優先する。

conditions: Prevent elevated actions from distracting from content or increasing visual weight.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0006.review_note: Recovered the multiple-ornament condition and its distraction and complexity risks.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0007.title: Consider limiting ornament count

statement.en: When necessary, consider limiting the total number of visionOS ornaments.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はvisionOS ornamentの総数制限を検討する。

conditions: Multiple ornaments increase visual weight or make the app feel more complicated.
exceptions: Relocate removed ornament elements into the main window when appropriate.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0007.review_note: Recovered the qualified count-limiting option and the relocation fallback.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0001.title: Use tables for nonhierarchical data

statement.en: Use a table instead of a macOS outline view when the data isn’t hierarchical.
statement.ja: dataがhierarchicalでない場合はmacOS outline viewではなくtableを使う。

conditions: The presented data has no parent-and-child hierarchy.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Retained the existing ID and narrowed component selection to nonhierarchical data.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0002.title: Use descriptive outline-view headings

statement.en: Use descriptive column headings that give people enough context.
statement.ja: 十分なcontextを伝えるdescriptiveなcolumn headingを使う。

conditions: Each heading identifies the content or attribute in its column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0002.review_note: Retained the context purpose while separating heading wording, capitalization, punctuation, and presence.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0003.title: Consider sortable column headings

statement.en: Consider letting people sort a macOS outline view by clicking column headings.
statement.ja: column headingをclickしてmacOS outline viewをsortできるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: Sorting by an outline-view attribute would help people inspect the data.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Preserved the optional consider strength and separated behavior after sorting is offered.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0004.title: Let people resize outline-view columns

statement.en: Preserve people’s ability to resize columns.
statement.ja: columnをresizeできる状態を維持する。

conditions: Let people reveal data that is wider than its current column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0004.review_note: Retained the exact contextual duplicate and recorded the variable-width purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0005.title: Make nested containers easy to expand

statement.en: Make nested outline-view containers easy to expand and collapse.
statement.ja: nested outline-view containerを簡単にexpandおよびcollapseできるようにする。

conditions: Use disclosure triangles to reveal the children of parent containers.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0005.review_note: Retained the interaction goal; Finder click and Option-click behavior remains a reviewed example rather than a universal requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0006.title: Consider alternating outline-view rows

statement.en: Consider alternating row colors in a multi-column macOS outline view.
statement.ja: multi-column macOS outline viewではrow colorを交互にすることを検討する。

conditions: Alternating colors help people track values across wide rows.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0006.review_note: Preserved MAY and the multi-column, wide-view readability context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0007.title: Allow appropriate outline-view editing

statement.en: Let people edit outline-view data when editing makes sense in the app.
statement.ja: appで適切な場合はoutline-view dataを編集できるようにする。

conditions: Keep single-click editing distinguishable from any double-click action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0007.review_note: Retained the product-fit condition and separated the expected single-click interaction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0008.title: Consider centered cell ellipses

statement.en: Consider a centered ellipsis instead of clipping outline-view cell text.
statement.ja: outline-view cell textをclipする代わりにcentered ellipsisを検討する。

conditions: Preserving both the beginning and end makes truncated content more recognizable.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0008.review_note: Preserved MAY and the distinctiveness rationale for middle truncation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0009.title: Consider search for lengthy outline views

statement.en: Consider a search field for a lengthy macOS outline view.
statement.ja: lengthyなmacOS outline viewにはsearch fieldを検討する。

conditions: A window whose primary feature is the outline view can place search in its toolbar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0009.review_note: Preserved MAY and the lengthy, primary-feature context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0010.title: Retain outline-view expansion choices

statement.en: Retain people’s outline-view expansion choices between visits.
statement.ja: outline viewの利用間で人が選んだexpansion stateを保持する。

conditions: Store the expansion state and restore it the next time the outline view appears.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0010.review_note: Recorded persistence and restoration as the implementation of retained navigation state.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0011.title: Keep hierarchy in the first column

statement.en: Expose outline-view hierarchy only in the first column.
statement.ja: outline-view hierarchyはfirst columnだけに表示する。

conditions: Use other columns only for attributes that supplement the primary hierarchical data.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0011.review_note: Activated the previously inactive candidate and retained the first-column-only boundary.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0012.title: Use concise noun headings

statement.en: Use nouns or short noun phrases for outline-view column headings.
statement.ja: outline-view column headingにはnounまたは短いnoun phraseを使う。

conditions: Keep each heading concise while identifying its column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0012.review_note: Recovered the heading-part-of-speech guidance as a separate atomic rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0013.title: Capitalize outline-view headings consistently

statement.en: Use title-style capitalization for outline-view column headings.
statement.ja: outline-view column headingにはtitle-style capitalizationを使う。

conditions: Apply the convention to every visible column heading.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0013.review_note: Recovered capitalization separately from wording and punctuation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0014.title: Avoid punctuation in outline-view headings

statement.en: Avoid punctuation in outline-view column headings, especially a trailing colon.
statement.ja: outline-view column headingではpunctuation、特にtrailing colonを避ける。

conditions: The text functions as a column heading rather than a sentence.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit avoid clause conservatively as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0015.title: Always provide multi-column outline-view headings

statement.en: Always provide column headings in a multi-column macOS outline view.
statement.ja: multi-column macOS outline viewでは常にcolumn headingを提供する。

conditions: The outline view contains more than one column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0015.review_note: Recovered the unqualified Always directive and retained its multi-column scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0016.title: Provide context when omitting a single heading

statement.en: When a single-column outline view omits its heading, provide a label or another source of sufficient context.
statement.ja: single-column outline viewでheadingを省略する場合はlabelなどで十分なcontextを提供する。

conditions: The outline view has one column and no visible column heading.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0016.review_note: Recovered the conditioned fallback without extending it to multi-column views.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0017.title: Support both sort directions

statement.en: Support ascending and descending sorts for clickable outline-view column headings.
statement.ja: click可能なoutline-view column headingでascendingとdescendingのsortをsupportする。

conditions: The app offers sorting through column-heading clicks.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0017.review_note: Recovered both sort directions as behavior conditioned on offering sortable headings.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0018.title: Consider secondary-column sorting

statement.en: When necessary, consider secondary-column sorting behind the scenes.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はsecondary-column sortingを内部で行うことを検討する。

conditions: A primary sort needs a secondary attribute to produce a useful stable order.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0018.review_note: Preserved the optional and necessary qualifications.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0019.title: Sort primary columns by hierarchy level

statement.en: When people sort by the primary column, sort independently at each hierarchy level.
statement.ja: primary columnでsortする場合は各hierarchy levelを個別にsortする。

conditions: People click the primary hierarchical column heading in a sortable outline view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0019.review_note: Recovered hierarchy-level sorting separately from the optional decision to offer sorting.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0020.title: Reverse repeated column sorts

statement.en: Reverse the sort direction when people click the currently sorted column heading.
statement.ja: 現在sort済みのcolumn headingをclickした場合はsort directionを反転する。

conditions: The clicked column is already the active sort column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0020.review_note: Recovered the repeated-click behavior as a conditioned sorting rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0021.title: Use single-click cell editing

statement.en: Use a single click to edit an editable outline-view cell.
statement.ja: editableなoutline-view cellはsingle clickで編集する。

conditions: The cell supports direct editing.
exceptions: A double click may perform a distinct action, such as opening the represented item.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0021.review_note: Recovered the explicit editing expectation and retained the distinct double-click exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0022.title: Consider useful row changes

statement.en: When useful, consider letting people reorder, add, and remove outline-view rows.
statement.ja: 有用な場合はoutline-view rowのreorder、add、removeを可能にすることを検討する。

conditions: The row operation supports the app’s data-management task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0022.review_note: Recovered the qualified row-mutation option without promoting it above MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PATH-CONTROLS-0001.title: Place path controls in the window body

statement.en: Place a macOS path control in the window body, not the window frame.
statement.ja: macOS path controlはwindow frameではなくwindow bodyに配置する。

conditions: Do not place a path control in a toolbar or status bar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PATH-CONTROLS-0001.review_note: Retained the only explicit directive and recorded the toolbar and status-bar exclusions; style descriptions remain nonnormative context.

conditions: Dim an unavailable item and prevent it from responding to interactions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0002.review_note: Recorded both visible unavailability and disabled interaction.

conditions: Reserve icons for common actions, key features, locations, devices, visual concepts, or recognizable user content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0003.review_note: Recorded the documented purposes and separated unclear-icon avoidance.

conditions: Provide icons for every item in a group or for none of them.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0004.review_note: Recorded the all-or-none treatment that preserves balance.

conditions: Use a platform-appropriate separator to distinguish related groups visually.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0006.review_note: Recorded the separator technique without making grouping mandatory.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0007.title: Keep logically related menu commands together

statement.en: Keep logically related menu commands in one group even when their importance differs.
statement.ja: importanceが異なっても論理的に関連するmenu commandは同じgroupにまとめる。

conditions: Preserve expected command neighborhoods such as related editing actions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0007.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate and recorded the importance exception.

conditions: Consider separate menus or a submenu when a long menu slows scanning.
exceptions: Allow long, scrollable menus for user-defined or dynamically generated content people expect to be complete.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0008.review_note: Recorded both shortening alternatives and the dynamic-content exception.

conditions: Consider a submenu when one term repeats in more than two items in a group.
Use the repeated term in the parent label when it helps predict submenu contents.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0009.review_note: Recorded the repeated-term threshold and predictive-label technique.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0010.title: Keep unavailable submenus openable

statement.en: Keep a submenu available even when every nested item is unavailable.
statement.ja: nested itemがすべてunavailableでもsubmenu自体は利用可能に保つ。

conditions: Let people open the submenu and learn which commands it contains.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0010.review_note: Reconfirmed the Make sure requirement and discoverability rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0017.title: Keep in-game menus accessible on every supported platform

statement.en: Keep in-game menus easy to open, read, and interact with on every supported platform.
statement.ja: すべての対応platformでin-game menuを開きやすく読みやすく操作しやすく保つ。

conditions: Use platform-appropriate font and interaction-target sizes.
If scaling makes menus too small, resize targets and consider another way to communicate content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0017.review_note: Reconfirmed the Make sure requirement and captured text and target-size handling.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0018.title: Choose compact menu layouts when they streamline choices

statement.en: Choose a small or medium iOS or iPadOS menu layout when it streamlines people’s choices.
statement.ja: 選択を効率化できる場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのsmallまたはmedium menu layoutを選ぶ。

conditions: Small places four icon-only items above the remaining list.
Medium places three symbol-and-short-label items above the remaining list.
Large is the default and displays every item in one list.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0018.review_note: Recorded all three layout definitions and their numeric top-row constraints.

conditions: Keep the menu close enough that people can see the controlled content while looking and tapping.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0019.review_note: Recorded the gaze-attention reason for spatial proximity.

conditions: Use subtle or automatic to preserve legibility, depth, and scene context.
exceptions: Use prominent only when scene-wide visibility is important and account for disruption or discomfort.
Use none when intentional occlusion is part of the experience and accept reduced visibility and access.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0020.review_note: Recorded automatic behavior and both qualified alternatives without raising their strength.

conditions: Use standard system icons for common actions such as Share, Print, and Search.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0021.review_note: Recorded the standard-icon mechanism for consistent representation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0022.title: Write clear succinct menu-item labels

statement.en: Give every menu item a clear, succinct label that describes it.
statement.ja: すべてのmenu itemに内容を説明する明確で簡潔なlabelを付ける。

conditions: Use a verb or verb phrase for an item that initiates an action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0022.review_note: Recovered the general labeling lead and its action-label form.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0023.title: Use title-style capitalization in menu labels

statement.en: Use title-style capitalization for menu-item labels to match platform experience.
statement.ja: platform experienceに合わせてmenu-item labelにtitle-style capitalizationを使う。

conditions: A game's distinct writing style may justify a different treatment.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0023.review_note: Recovered the capitalization lead and preserved the game-style qualification.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0024.title: Use ellipses for menu actions needing more input

statement.en: Append an ellipsis when a menu action needs more information or choices before completion.
statement.ja: 完了前に追加情報または選択が必要なmenu actionにはellipsisを付ける。

conditions: The action opens another view for input or additional choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0024.review_note: Recovered the ellipsis lead and its incomplete-action condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0025.title: Limit submenu depth and length

statement.en: Limit submenu hierarchy to one level and keep each submenu short.
statement.ja: submenu hierarchyを1 levelに制限し各submenuを短く保つ。

conditions: If a submenu has more than about five items, consider creating another menu.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0025.review_note: Recovered the limit lead and recorded both source thresholds.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0026.title: Consider separate items when toggling is unclear

statement.en: When necessary, consider displaying both state actions instead of one toggled menu item.
statement.ja: 必要な場合は1つのtoggled menu itemではなく両方のstate actionを表示することを検討する。

conditions: Seeing both states at once helps people understand the available action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0026.review_note: Recovered the conditional alternative without promoting its strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0027.title: Keep fully unavailable menus openable

statement.en: Keep a menu available even when every item it contains is unavailable.
statement.ja: 含まれるitemがすべてunavailableでもmenu自体は利用可能に保つ。

conditions: Let people open the menu and learn which commands it contains.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit needs-to requirement separately from individual item appearance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0028.title: Avoid unclear menu-item icons

statement.en: Avoid displaying an icon that doesn’t clearly represent its menu item.
statement.ja: menu itemを明確に表さないiconの表示を避ける。

conditions: No suitable clear icon is available.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0028.review_note: Recovered the explicit don't guidance conservatively as AVOID.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0029.title: Reserve small menus for related action groups

statement.en: Use the small iOS or iPadOS menu layout only for closely related actions that form a group.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのsmall menu layoutはgroupを成す密接に関連したactionだけに使う。

conditions: The four top-row actions are recognizable as one related set.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0030.title: Use recognizable symbols for unlabeled small-menu actions

statement.en: Use a recognizable symbol for every unlabeled action in a small iOS or iPadOS menu.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのsmall menu内の各unlabeled actionに識別可能なsymbolを使う。

conditions: People must identify each action without a text label.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0030.review_note: Recovered the per-action symbol requirement under the small layout.

HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0031.title: Consider medium menus for three important actions

statement.en: Consider the medium iOS or iPadOS layout for three important, frequently used actions.
statement.ja: 重要で頻繁に使うactionが3つある場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのmedium layoutを検討する。

conditions: The app has exactly three important actions people often perform.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0031.review_note: Recovered the medium-layout recommendation and preserved its consider strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0001.title: Leave adequate space between tvOS lockups

statement.en: Leave enough space between tvOS lockups for focused expansion.
statement.ja: tvOS lockupのfocus時の拡大に十分な間隔を設ける。

conditions: Prevent a focused lockup from overlapping or displacing neighboring lockups.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0001.review_note: Recorded focused expansion as the spacing requirement's cause.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0002.title: Keep grouped tvOS lockups consistently sized

statement.en: Use consistent lockup sizes within each tvOS row or group.
statement.ja: tvOSの各rowまたはgroup内でlockup sizeを一貫させる。

conditions: Match both width and height across grouped elements.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0002.review_note: Recorded both size dimensions and the visual-consistency scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0003.title: Prefer portraits over initials in monograms

statement.en: Prefer an available image of a person over initials in a tvOS monogram.
statement.ja: 人物画像がある場合はtvOS monogramでinitialより画像を優先する。

conditions: Use initials only when an image isn’t available.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0003.review_note: Recorded image availability and the more personal visual connection.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0004.title: Match focused caption-button tilt to swipes

statement.en: Make each focused tvOS caption button tilt in the direction of the remote-control swipe.
statement.ja: focusされたtvOS caption buttonをremote-controlのswipe方向へtiltさせる。

conditions: Tilt vertically aligned buttons up and down, horizontally aligned buttons left and right, and grid buttons in both directions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0004.review_note: Recovered the Make sure requirement and recorded all three layout-to-tilt mappings.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0005.title: Size tvOS posters for their content

statement.en: Make every tvOS poster size appropriate for its content.
statement.ja: すべてのtvOS posterをcontentに適したsizeにする。

conditions: Posters may use any dimensions that fit their content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LOCKUPS-0005.review_note: Recovered the needs-to requirement while preserving the source's flexible sizing allowance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0001.title: Prefer lists or tables for text

statement.en: Prefer a list or table when displaying primarily textual content.
statement.ja: 主にtext contentを表示する場合はlistまたはtableを優先する。

conditions: Use the row-based format to support scanning and reading.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0001.review_note: Recorded the text-scanning rationale and separated the collection alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0002.title: Allow table editing when useful

statement.en: Let people edit a table when editing makes sense for its content.
statement.ja: contentに対して妥当な場合はtableを編集できるようにする。

conditions: Consider supporting reordering even when adding and removing aren’t available.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0002.review_note: Recorded reordering as the key partial-editing example.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0003.title: Provide selection-appropriate list feedback

statement.en: Provide feedback that matches what selecting a list item does.
statement.ja: list itemの選択結果に合うfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: Distinguish navigation selections from option-state changes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0003.review_note: Separated the two documented selection-feedback patterns.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0004.title: Keep list-item text succinct

statement.en: Keep list- and table-item text succinct and comfortable to read.
statement.ja: listとtableのitem textを簡潔で読みやすく保つ。

conditions: Minimize wrapping and truncation to preserve scanning.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0004.review_note: Recorded the wrapping, truncation, and scanning rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0005.title: Consider preserving narrow-table text readability

statement.en: Consider ways to keep clipped or truncated table text recognizable and readable.
statement.ja: clipまたはtruncateされるtable textを識別しやすく読みやすく保つ方法を検討する。

conditions: The table can become narrow or vary in width.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0005.review_note: Recorded the variable-width condition and separated the middle-ellipsis technique.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0006.title: Use descriptive multicolumn headings

statement.en: Use descriptive headings for every multicolumn table column.
statement.ja: multicolumn tableの各columnに説明的なheadingを使う。

conditions: Make each column's content understandable from its heading.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0006.review_note: Separated heading wording, capitalization, punctuation, and single-column fallback rules.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0007.title: Coordinate list style with data and platform

statement.en: Choose a list or table style that fits both the data and Apple platform.
statement.ja: dataとApple platformの両方に合うlistまたはtable styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Use style details to communicate grouping, hierarchy, or platform-specific experience.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0007.review_note: Recorded the purpose of platform styles without turning examples into universal requirements.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0008.title: Fit row style to displayed information

statement.en: Choose a row style that fits the information each row needs to display.
statement.ja: 各rowで表示する情報に合うrow styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Use built-in platform row styles when they fit the content arrangement.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0008.review_note: Recorded information fit and treated platform APIs as examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0009.title: Reserve info buttons for row details

statement.en: Use an info button only to reveal more information about a row’s content.
statement.ja: info buttonはrow contentの追加情報を表示する場合だけ使う。

conditions: Do not use an info button for hierarchical navigation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0009.review_note: Recorded the detail-only purpose and separated the disclosure-indicator alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0010.title: Avoid indexes beside trailing row controls

statement.en: Avoid a table index when rows also have controls at their trailing ends.
statement.ja: rowのtrailing endにもcontrolがあるtableではindexを避ける。

conditions: Prevent people from accidentally activating an adjacent disclosure indicator or other trailing control.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0010.review_note: Recorded the shared trailing-side conflict and accidental-activation risk.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0011.title: Let people resize macOS table columns

statement.en: Let people resize columns in a macOS table.
statement.ja: macOS tableのcolumnをresizeできるようにする。

conditions: Support concentrating on different areas and revealing clipped data.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0011.review_note: Recorded both purposes of column resizing.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0012.title: Consider alternating rows in macOS multicolumn tables

statement.en: Consider alternating row colors in a macOS multicolumn table.
statement.ja: macOSのmulticolumn tableではalternating row colorを検討する。

conditions: Use alternating colors when they help track values across wide columns.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0012.review_note: Preserved MAY and the wide-table tracking condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0013.title: Use an outline view for macOS hierarchy

statement.en: Use an outline view instead of a table view for hierarchical macOS data.
statement.ja: macOSのhierarchical dataにはtable viewではなくoutline viewを使う。

conditions: Use disclosure triangles to expose nested levels.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0013.review_note: Recorded the nested-level reason for the component choice.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0014.title: Test nearby images against focused tvOS rows

statement.en: Confirm images near a tvOS table remain visually sound as a row gains focus.
statement.ja: tvOS tableの近くにある画像がrowのfocus時にも適切に見えることを確認する。

conditions: Account for highlight, slight scale increase, and possible corner rounding.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0014.review_note: Repaired the truncated statement and removed the false gaze modality.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0015.title: Consider a collection for varied items or many images

statement.en: Consider a collection instead of a list or table for widely varying item sizes or many images.
statement.ja: item sizeが大きく異なる場合や画像が多い場合はlistやtableの代わりにcollectionを検討する。

conditions: Items vary widely in size or the design displays many images.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0015.review_note: Recovered the collection alternative and preserved its consider strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0016.title: Require edit mode for iOS and iPadOS table selection

statement.en: Require people to enter edit mode before selecting table items in iOS or iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSでtable itemを選択する前にedit modeへ入ることを必須にする。

conditions: People select table items on iOS or iPadOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit must constraint and narrowed it to iOS and iPadOS.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0017.title: Persistently highlight hierarchy selections

statement.en: Keep a selected row persistently highlighted when a table navigates a hierarchy.
statement.ja: tableでhierarchyを移動する場合は選択rowを継続的にhighlightする。

conditions: Use persistent highlighting to clarify the navigation path.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0018.title: Use transient feedback for option selections

statement.en: For option lists, briefly highlight a selected row before showing its selection indicator.
statement.ja: option listでは選択rowを短くhighlightしてからselection indicatorを表示する。

conditions: The row changes an option state rather than navigating a hierarchy.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0019.title: Consider alternatives to oversized text rows

statement.en: Consider alternatives to oversized rows when each item contains a large amount of text.
statement.ja: 各itemに大量のtextがある場合はoversized rowの代替を検討する。

conditions: One option is listing only titles and revealing full content in a detail view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0019.review_note: Recovered the large-text alternative and retained its example as optional.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0020.title: Consider middle ellipses for recognizable text

statement.en: Consider a middle ellipsis when preserving both ends makes truncated text easier to recognize.
statement.ja: textの両端を残すと識別しやすい場合はmiddle ellipsisを検討する。

conditions: The beginning and end together distinguish the item better than one end alone.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0020.review_note: Recovered the optional middle-ellipsis technique and its recognition condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0021.title: Use noun phrases for table headings

statement.en: Use nouns or short noun phrases for multicolumn table headings.
statement.ja: multicolumn table headingにはnounまたは短いnoun phraseを使う。

conditions: Keep the heading descriptive and concise.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0021.review_note: Split heading wording from capitalization and punctuation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0022.title: Use title-style capitalization for table headings

statement.en: Use title-style capitalization in multicolumn table headings.
statement.ja: multicolumn table headingにはtitle-style capitalizationを使う。

conditions: Apply consistently across all column headings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0022.review_note: Recovered the capitalization action as an atomic rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0023.title: Avoid punctuation after table headings

statement.en: Avoid ending punctuation in multicolumn table headings.
statement.ja: multicolumn table headingのending punctuationを避ける。

conditions: The heading is a noun or short noun phrase.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0023.review_note: Recovered the explicit don't clause conservatively as AVOID.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0024.title: Provide context when a single-column heading is absent

statement.en: Use a label or header to provide context when a single-column table omits its column heading.
statement.ja: single-column tableでcolumn headingを省く場合はlabelまたはheaderでcontextを示す。

conditions: A single-column table view has no column heading.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0025.title: Use disclosure indicators for hierarchy navigation

statement.en: Use a disclosure indicator to open a list or table row’s hierarchical subviews.
statement.ja: listまたはtable rowのhierarchical subviewを開くにはdisclosure indicatorを使う。

conditions: Apply on iOS, iPadOS, and visionOS instead of using an info button.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0026.title: Let valuable macOS columns drive sorting

statement.en: When it provides value, let people sort a macOS table by clicking a column heading.
statement.ja: 価値がある場合はmacOS tableのcolumn headingをclickしてsortできるようにする。

conditions: Column-based sorting helps people work with the table's data.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0027.title: Reverse sorting when a sorted heading is reselected

statement.en: Reverse a macOS column’s sort direction when people click its already-sorted heading.
statement.ja: macOSでsort済みcolumn headingを再度clickした場合はsort方向を反転する。

conditions: The selected column is already the active sort column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0027.review_note: Recovered the repeat-click state transition as an atomic rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0028.title: Avoid custom masks on focused tvOS rows

statement.en: Avoid custom corner-rounding masks on images beside focused tvOS table rows.
statement.ja: focused tvOS table rowの隣にある画像へcustom corner-rounding maskを追加しない。

conditions: The system may round a focused row's corners.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0028.review_note: Recovered the explicit don't clause as AVOID and kept focus from being misread as gaze.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0029.title: Limit watchOS list rows when possible

statement.en: When possible, limit the number of rows in a watchOS list.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はwatchOS listのrow数を抑える。

conditions: Keep short lists easy to scan.
exceptions: When people expect many items, show the most relevant items and provide a way to view more.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0029.review_note: Recovered the qualified lead and the expected-long-list exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0030.title: Keep watchOS detail views short for page navigation

statement.en: Keep watchOS detail views short when supporting vertical page-based navigation between list items.
statement.ja: list item間のvertical page-based navigationを支援する場合はwatchOS detail viewを短く保つ。

conditions: Detail views must not require scrolling for vertical page navigation to work.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LISTS-AND-TABLES-0030.review_note: Recovered the navigation-length constraint and its scrolling incompatibility.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0001.title: Use image views primarily for display

statement.en: Use an image view when its primary purpose is simply to display an image.
statement.ja: 主な目的が画像表示だけの場合にimage viewを使う。

conditions: Treat image views as typically noninteractive.
exceptions: For a rare interactive image, use a system-provided button that displays the image.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Recorded the display-only purpose and the rare interactive-image exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0002.title: Keep animated-sequence images consistently sized

statement.en: Aim for consistent image sizes throughout an animated sequence.
statement.ja: animated sequence全体で画像サイズを一貫させる。

conditions: Prescale images to fit the view when practical so the system doesn’t need to scale them.
When system scaling is necessary, matching both size and shape generally improves performance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0002.review_note: Recorded the prescaling path and the size-and-shape performance condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0003.title: Use an image button for clickable macOS images

statement.en: Use an image button instead of an image view for a clickable image in macOS.
statement.ja: macOSでclickable imageにはimage viewではなくimage buttonを使う。

conditions: The image initiates an instantaneous app-specific action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Recorded the macOS component distinction and instantaneous-action purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0004.title: Prefer SwiftUI for watchOS image animation

statement.en: Use SwiftUI to create watchOS image animations when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はwatchOSのimage animationをSwiftUIで作成する。

conditions: Prefer SwiftUI as the primary watchOS animation path.
exceptions: When necessary, WatchKit can animate an image sequence within an image element.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0004.review_note: Preserved the when-possible qualification and recorded the WatchKit fallback separately.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0005.title: Consider symbols or interface icons for icons

statement.en: When displaying an interface icon, consider a symbol or interface icon instead of an image view.
statement.ja: interface iconを表示する場合はimage viewではなくsymbolまたはinterface iconを検討する。

conditions: Symbols and interface icons can adopt accent colors people choose.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0005.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate while retaining its source hash and MAY strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0006.title: Use an image well for editable macOS images

statement.en: Use an image well when a macOS app needs an editable image view.
statement.ja: macOSアプリでeditable image viewが必要な場合はimage wellを使う。

conditions: An image well supports copy, paste, drag, and Delete-key clearing.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0006.review_note: Recorded the editable-content condition and the documented image-well behaviors.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0007.title: Use a system button for interactive images

statement.en: Display a rare interactive image in a system-provided button instead of adding button behavior to an image view.
statement.ja: まれにinteractiveな画像が必要な場合はimage viewにbutton behaviorを加えずsystem-provided buttonで表示する。

conditions: An image needs to be interactive on an Apple platform.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0007.review_note: Recovered the cross-platform interactive-image exception as its own component-selection rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0008.title: Use care when overlaying text on images

statement.en: Use care when overlaying text on an image.
statement.ja: 画像上にtextを重ねる場合は注意する。

conditions: Protect both image clarity and text legibility.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0008.review_note: Recovered the caution lead and its two documented readability risks.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0009.title: Ensure overlaid text contrasts with its image

statement.en: Ensure text overlaid on an image contrasts well with that image.
statement.ja: 画像上に重ねるtextが画像と十分なcontrastを持つようにする。

conditions: Text is composited over an image.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0009.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure requirement separately from the optional standout techniques.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0010.title: Consider standout treatments for overlaid text

statement.en: Consider a text shadow or background layer to help text over an image stand out.
statement.ja: 画像上のtextを目立たせるためtext shadowまたはbackground layerを検討する。

conditions: Additional separation beyond contrast would improve overlaid-text legibility.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0010.review_note: Preserved the optional strength and the two documented treatment examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0011.title: Consider WatchKit image-sequence animation when necessary

statement.en: When necessary, consider WatchKit for animating an image sequence within a watchOS image element.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はwatchOSのimage element内でimage sequenceをanimationするためWatchKitを検討する。

conditions: SwiftUI is not suitable for the necessary watchOS animation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-IMAGE-VIEWS-0011.review_note: Recovered the documented WatchKit fallback without raising the source's can language above MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0001.title: Expose custom Dock-menu commands elsewhere

statement.en: Make every custom Dock-menu command available through another visible part of the Mac app.
statement.ja: すべてのcustom Dock menu commandをMacアプリ内の別の見える場所からも利用可能にする。

conditions: Offer the same commands in places such as menu-bar menus or the app interface.
Account for people who don’t use the Dock menu.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0001.review_note: Recorded the discoverability rationale and the documented menu-bar and in-interface alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0002.title: Prefer high-value custom Dock-menu items

statement.en: Prefer high-value commands and destinations for custom Dock-menu items.
statement.ja: custom Dock menu itemには価値の高いcommandやdestinationを優先する。

conditions: Current or recently open windows can provide convenient navigation destinations.
Limit action shortcuts to a few likely useful choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0002.review_note: Recorded the open-window navigation example and the source's focus on a small number of useful actions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0003.title: Label Dock-menu items succinctly

statement.en: Give every Dock-menu item a succinct label.
statement.ja: すべてのDock menu itemに簡潔なlabelを付ける。

conditions: Apply the general menu-labeling requirement to both system-provided and custom Dock-menu items under app control.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0003.review_note: Recovered the labeling half of the explicit need-to requirement as an atomic rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0004.title: Organize Dock-menu items logically

statement.en: Organize every Dock menu logically.
statement.ja: すべてのDock menuを論理的に整理する。

conditions: Apply the general menu-organization requirement to the complete Dock menu.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0004.review_note: Recovered the organization half of the explicit need-to requirement as an atomic rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0005.title: Consider useful actions for inactive app states

statement.en: Consider listing a few likely useful Dock-menu actions when the app isn’t frontmost or has no open windows.
statement.ja: アプリが前面にない場合やopen windowがない場合は、役立つ可能性が高い少数のDock menu actionを検討する。

conditions: The Mac app isn’t frontmost or has no open windows.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DOCK-MENUS-0005.review_note: Preserved the source's consider strength and both inactive-app conditions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DIGIT-ENTRY-VIEWS-0001.title: Use secure tvOS digit fields

statement.en: Use secure fields when a tvOS digit-entry view needs to conceal entered digits.
statement.ja: tvOSのdigit entry viewで入力した数字を隠す必要がある場合はsecure fieldを使う。

conditions: Secure digit fields replace entered digits with asterisks onscreen.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DIGIT-ENTRY-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Reviewed the general secure-field recommendation and recorded the documented asterisk-concealment behavior without raising it to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DIGIT-ENTRY-VIEWS-0002.title: Explain the purpose of tvOS digit entry

statement.en: Clearly explain why a tvOS digit-entry view needs the requested digits.
statement.ja: tvOSのdigit entry viewが数字を必要とする理由を明確に説明する。

conditions: Use the optional title and prompt above the digits to explain the request.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DIGIT-ENTRY-VIEWS-0002.review_note: Recorded the title-and-prompt technique as supporting context for the existing purpose rule rather than duplicating it.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DIGIT-ENTRY-VIEWS-0003.title: Always secure sensitive tvOS digit entry

statement.en: Use a secure tvOS digit field whenever the app requests sensitive data.
statement.ja: アプリが機密データを求める場合は常にtvOSのsecure digit fieldを使う。

conditions: The app requests sensitive data through a tvOS digit-entry view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DIGIT-ENTRY-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always requirement separately from the page's general secure-field recommendation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTEXT-MENUS-0023.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Make sure every context-menu item has a short clear action label” and recorded its context-menu and platform conditions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0071.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Test large App Clip Code print workflows and verify output” and recorded its applicable conditions.

Maintain file management, versioning, and change tracking.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0072.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “You need to map each App Clip Code SVG file to its invocation URL” and recorded its applicable conditions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0073.title: Use only approved App Clip Codes

statement.en: Use only Apple-provided App Clip Codes created with approved tools and following the guidelines.
statement.ja: 承認済みtoolで作成しguidelineに従うApple提供App Clip Codeだけを使う。

conditions: The code comes from App Store Connect or App Clip Code Generator and follows the published guidelines.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0073.review_note: Corrected strength after reviewing the explicit supporting requirement and its source-scoped conditions.

conditions: The prohibition includes the Apple logo, App Clip mark, and code design.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0074.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Never use App Clip Code elements in company or product names” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Do not seek copyright or trademark registration for the code or any contained element.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0075.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Never seek copyright or trademark registration for App Clip Code elements” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Protect Apple's and App Clips' goodwill, value, and reputation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0076.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Never use App Clip Codes in ways that damage Apple goodwill or reputation” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Protect third-party trademarks and proprietary rights.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0077.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Never use App Clip Codes in ways that infringe third-party proprietary rights” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Avoid confusion about the source of products or services.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0078.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Never use App Clip Codes in ways that confuse product or service source” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: The restriction applies to codes produced by both approved Apple tools.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0079.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Avoid adding symbols to generated App Clip Codes” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Reserve advanced or complex features for the full app and minimize screens and forms.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0080.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Use only essential App Clip features for the current task” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Store necessary data securely and keep essential login information off-device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0081.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Keep App Clip data storage and handling minimal” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Present SKOverlay after task completion or at a natural pause.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0082.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Use task completion or a natural pause to recommend the full app” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Do not repeat installation asks, interrupt a task, or use push notifications for the recommendation.
Clearly explain additional full-app features.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0083.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Use nonintrusive polite recommendations for the full app” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Use this when App Clip functionality lasts more than one day.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0084.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Use an explicit permission request when App Clip functionality exceeds one day” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: People can use the App Clip for more than one business or location at once.
Consider switching among recent businesses and location verification.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0085.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Make sure App Clips handle simultaneous businesses or locations and update their interfaces” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Apply this when the App Clip Code appears near a QR code or another scannable item.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0086.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Use an App Clip Code at least as large as nearby scannable items” and recorded its applicable conditions.

conditions: Use suggested wording or equivalent clear custom copy.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0087.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Always use a simple clear App Clip Code call to action” and recorded its applicable conditions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0088.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Avoid displaying App Clip Codes for inactive App Clips” and recorded its applicable conditions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APP-CLIPS-0089.review_note: Reviewed the rendered source context for “Make sure Apple trademarks remain in English” and recorded its applicable conditions.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0001.title: Make undo and redo outcomes predictable

statement.en: Help people predict the result of an undo or redo before they perform it.
statement.ja: undoまたはredoを実行する前に結果を予測できるようにする。

conditions: On iPhone, an undo alert can describe the result and offer undo or cancellation.
When menu items are present, identify the result in their labels.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0001.review_note: Recorded both documented prediction techniques and kept them conditional on their respective interfaces.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0002.title: Highlight each undo and redo result

statement.en: Show and highlight the result of each undo or redo.
statement.ja: 各undoまたはredoの結果を表示しhighlightする。

conditions: When affected content is offscreen, reveal it so people do not mistake the action for having no effect.
For example, scroll to restored content when appropriate.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0002.review_note: Recorded visibility, repeated-action risk, and the offscreen-content recovery example.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0003.title: Support multiple undo and redo operations

statement.en: Let people perform undo and redo multiple times.
statement.ja: undoとredoを複数回実行できるようにする。

conditions: A logical boundary can be opening a document or saving work.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0003.review_note: Recorded multi-level behavior and the source's logical-session boundary examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0004.title: Consider reverting related changes as a group

statement.en: Consider letting people revert multiple related changes at once.
statement.ja: 関連する複数のchangeを一度にrevertできるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: A group can contain discrete incremental changes to one property.
Another option is reverting all changes since opening or saving a document.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0004.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded both grouping scenarios without making batch undo mandatory.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0005.title: Add dedicated undo and redo buttons only when necessary

statement.en: Provide dedicated undo and redo buttons only when they are important to the experience.
statement.ja: 体験上重要な場合だけ専用undo・redo buttonを提供する。

conditions: Prefer system-supported methods such as the macOS Edit menu, Mac or iPad keyboard shortcuts, and iPhone shake gestures.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0005.review_note: Recorded system methods as the default and preserved the necessity test for dedicated controls.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0006.title: Avoid redefining standard undo and redo gestures

statement.en: Avoid redefining standard iOS and iPadOS gestures for undo and redo.
statement.ja: undo・redo用のstandard iOS・iPadOS gestureを再定義しない。

conditions: Standard input includes three-finger swipe gestures and shaking iPhone.
Redefinition can confuse people and make the experience unpredictable.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0006.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the standard gestures and predictability rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0007.title: Place undo and redo at the top of the macOS Edit menu

statement.en: Place undo and redo commands at the top of the macOS Edit menu.
statement.ja: undo・redo commandをmacOS Edit menuの先頭に配置する。

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0007.review_note: Narrowed the stable rule to the documented menu placement and split keyboard mappings separately.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0008.title: Avoid unnecessary undo and redo limits

statement.en: Avoid unnecessary limits on how many times people can undo or redo.
statement.ja: undoまたはredoできる回数へ不要な制限を設けない。

exceptions: A logical boundary such as opening a document or saving work can delimit the history.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0008.review_note: Recovered the explicit AVOID clause while preserving the source's logical-boundary exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0009.title: Use standard symbols for dedicated undo and redo buttons

statement.en: Use standard system-provided symbols for dedicated undo and redo buttons.
statement.ja: 専用undo・redo buttonにはsystem提供のstandard symbolを使う。

conditions: Dedicated buttons are important enough to add instead of relying only on standard system methods.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0009.review_note: Recovered the conditional symbol requirement as a separate atomic control-design rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0010.title: Place dedicated undo and redo buttons in a toolbar

statement.en: Place dedicated undo and redo buttons in a toolbar.
statement.ja: 専用undo・redo buttonをtoolbarに配置する。

conditions: Dedicated buttons are important enough to add instead of relying only on standard system methods.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0010.review_note: Recovered toolbar placement separately from the symbol requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0011.title: Describe the operation in undo and redo alert titles

statement.en: Provide one or two words after the automatic Undo or Redo prefix to describe the operation.
statement.ja: automaticなUndoまたはRedo prefixの後にoperationを表す1〜2語を付ける。

conditions: The system alert title already includes the prefix and its trailing space.
Keep the added operation description brief and precise.
HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0011.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit You need requirement and its one-or-two-word alert-title contract.

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0012.title: Support standard macOS undo and redo shortcuts

statement.en: Support Command-Z for undo and Shift-Command-Z for redo on macOS.
statement.ja: macOSでundoにCommand-Z、redoにShift-Command-Zを対応させる。

HIG-PATTERNS-UNDO-AND-REDO-0012.review_note: Split and preserved both standard macOS keyboard mappings as one paired shortcut rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0001.title: Use the system video player by default

statement.en: Use the system video player to provide familiar playback behavior and controls.
statement.ja: 使い慣れたplayback behaviorとcontrolを提供するためsystem video playerを使う。

conditions: Create a custom player only when the system player cannot meet an essential experience need.
exceptions: A custom player should closely reference the system player's interface and behavior.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0001.review_note: Recorded the system-player default and constrained the custom-player alternative to essential needs.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0002.title: Preserve the original video aspect ratio

statement.en: Always display video content at its original aspect ratio.
statement.ja: video contentは常に元のaspect ratioで表示する。

conditions: Let the player apply letterboxing or pillarboxing when the display and content ratios differ.
Avoid embedding black padding in the asset because it can compound when modes change or Picture in Picture begins.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0002.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit always directive and recorded padding and Picture in Picture failure modes.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0003.title: Add playback information only when valuable

statement.en: Provide additional playback information only when it adds value.
statement.ja: 価値を加える場合だけ追加のplayback informationを提供する。

conditions: Relevant platforms include iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
Keep the information secondary to the video and its controls.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0003.review_note: Recorded the value test and documented platform scope without treating extra information as a default.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0004.title: Support expected playback interactions

statement.en: Support the playback interactions people expect across available input devices.
statement.ja: 利用可能なinput device全体で期待されるplayback interactionに対応する。

conditions: Preserve familiar play, pause, scrubbing, and dismissal behavior.
Map supported keyboard and Siri Remote input to the expected playback action.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0004.review_note: Recorded cross-device interaction consistency and the source's keyboard and Siri Remote examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0005.title: Avoid mixing audio while switching playback modes

statement.en: Avoid mixing audio from different sources while viewers switch modes.
statement.ja: 視聴modeの切替中に異なるsourceのaudioを混在させない。

conditions: Mute or pause secondary content before starting the newly selected source.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0005.review_note: Recorded the source-switch boundary and the secondary-audio handling needed to prevent overlap.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0006.title: Make TV app transitions smooth

statement.en: Ensure a smooth transition from the TV app into playback.
statement.ja: TV appからplaybackへのtransitionを滑らかにする。

conditions: Present black immediately before the video becomes available to avoid flashing unrelated interface content.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0006.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit ensure directive and recorded the documented black transition.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0007.title: Show TV app content immediately

statement.en: Show the content people selected in the TV app immediately.
statement.ja: TV appで選択されたcontentを即時表示する。

conditions: Avoid opening on a splash screen, detail view, intro animation, or unrelated content.
exceptions: If a rare required interstitial appears, make its skip behavior clear and return promptly to the selected content.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0007.review_note: Recorded direct entry to selected content and preserved the narrow interstitial exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0008.title: Avoid a resume-playback prompt

statement.en: Avoid asking whether to resume playback when a valid prior position exists.
statement.ja: 有効な以前の位置がある場合、resumeするかを尋ねない。

conditions: Resume automatically at the appropriate saved position.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0008.review_note: Recorded automatic resume as the documented alternative to an unnecessary prompt.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0009.title: Play content for the correct viewer

statement.en: Make sure TV app content plays for the correct viewer profile.
statement.ja: TV app contentを正しいviewer profileで再生する。

conditions: Use the profile associated with the selected content when possible.
Switch to that profile or ask for a choice when no reliable association exists.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0009.review_note: Retained MUST from make sure and recorded selection, switching, and no-profile behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0010.title: Resume long video from its prior end time

statement.en: Use the previous end time when resuming a long video clip.
statement.ja: 長いvideo clipをresumeするとき以前のend timeを使う。

conditions: Apply this to content where restarting would lose meaningful viewing progress.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0010.review_note: Recorded the long-content condition without turning the duration description into a fixed threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0011.title: Avoid unnecessary playback loading screens

statement.en: Avoid showing a loading screen when playback can begin quickly.
statement.ja: playbackをすぐ開始できる場合はloading screenを表示しない。

exceptions: If loading exceeds about two seconds, show a black screen with a centered spinner and no other content.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0011.review_note: Preserved the quick-load default and the approximate two-second fallback rather than making it universal.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0012.title: Minimize playback loading-screen content

statement.en: Minimize content on a playback loading screen.
statement.ja: playback loading screen上のcontentを最小限にする。

conditions: Use a black background and keep branding minimal so the transition remains focused on playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0012.review_note: Recorded the black background and minimal-branding treatment.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0013.title: Exit playback to relevant content

statement.en: After playback exits, show a contextually relevant screen.
statement.ja: playback終了後はcontextに関連するscreenを表示する。

conditions: Prefer a detail view that supports resuming or choosing related content.
exceptions: Use the app's main menu when no more specific destination is meaningful.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0013.review_note: Recorded the detail-and-resume destination and main-menu fallback.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0014.title: Prepare the playback exit destination immediately

statement.en: Prepare the post-playback view as soon as an exit notification arrives.
statement.ja: exit notificationを受けたらpost-playback viewをすぐ準備する。

conditions: The destination needs to be ready even when playback exits immediately.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0014.review_note: Recorded notification timing and the immediate-exit readiness requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0015.title: Keep noninteractive tvOS overlays subordinate

statement.en: Defer to video content when displaying tvOS logos or noninteractive overlays.
statement.ja: tvOSのlogoやnoninteractive overlayはvideo contentを優先して表示する。

conditions: Keep a logo or timer small, unobtrusive, brief, and translucent when practical.
Use SDR treatment and consider display-retention risk for persistent overlays.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0015.review_note: Recorded size, duration, translucency, dynamic-range, and retention constraints.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0016.title: Present interactive tvOS overlays gracefully

statement.en: Present interactive tvOS overlays without surprising or trapping viewers.
statement.ja: 利用者を驚かせたり閉じ込めたりせずinteractive tvOS overlayを表示する。

conditions: Delay presentation or pause playback for at least about half a second before interaction.
Provide clear ways to dismiss the overlay and resume playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0016.review_note: Recorded the approximate half-second interaction guard and both recovery actions.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0017.title: Promote comfort during visionOS video playback

statement.en: Help people remain comfortable while playing video in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSでvideoを再生するとき利用者のcomfortを保つ。

conditions: Give people control over start timing, window size, surrounding visibility, and immersive presentation.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0017.review_note: Kept the comfort principle at SHOULD and split its concrete techniques into separate rules.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0018.title: Avoid immersive visionOS autoplay

statement.en: Avoid automatically starting fully immersive visionOS video playback.
statement.ja: fully immersiveなvisionOS video playbackを自動開始しない。

conditions: Let people choose when to enter the immersive playback experience.
exceptions: Do not rely on a warning alone to replace deliberate start control.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0018.review_note: Recorded user-controlled entry and the inadequacy of warning-only autoplay.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0019.title: Provide visionOS scrubbing thumbnails

statement.en: Create a thumbnail track when supporting visionOS video scrubbing.
statement.ja: visionOS videoのscrubbingに対応するときthumbnail trackを作成する。

conditions: Use thumbnails around 160 pixels wide to balance clarity and resource cost.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0019.review_note: Recorded the conditional scrubbing scope and approximate thumbnail width.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0020.title: Avoid filling a visionOS window with inline video

statement.en: Avoid expanding an inline visionOS video player to fill its window.
statement.ja: inline visionOS video playerをwindow全体へ拡大しない。

conditions: Keep surrounding window content visible and preserve familiar 2D inline-player expectations.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0020.review_note: Recorded surrounding-content continuity and the conventional 2D-player behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0021.title: Use RealityKit for special-purpose visionOS video

statement.en: Use a RealityKit video player for splash, transitional, or special-effect video.
statement.ja: splash、transition、special effect用videoにはRealityKit video playerを使う。

conditions: Use this approach when transport controls and system-player integration are unnecessary.
Preserve the source aspect ratio for 2D or 3D content and provide captions where needed.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0021.review_note: Repaired the truncated title and recorded control, integration, aspect-ratio, dimensional, and caption constraints.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0022.title: Keep watchOS video clips short

statement.en: Keep watchOS video clips short.
statement.ja: watchOS video clipを短く保つ。

conditions: Prefer clips of about 30 seconds or less to limit wrist fatigue and storage cost.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0022.review_note: Kept the guidance at SHOULD and preserved 30 seconds as a preference, not a universal hard maximum.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0023.title: Use recommended watchOS video encoding values

statement.en: Use the recommended sizes and encoding values for watchOS media assets.
statement.ja: watchOS media assetには推奨sizeとencoding valueを使う。

conditions: Use H.264 High Profile video at about 160 kbps and up to 30 fps.
Use 208×260 for full-screen portrait or 320×180 for 16:9 landscape video.
Use HE-AAC audio at about 64 kbps.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0023.review_note: Preserved every value in the structured watchOS media table and kept them scoped to watchOS assets.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0024.title: Avoid control-like watchOS poster images

statement.en: Avoid making a watchOS poster image look like a system control.
statement.ja: watchOS poster imageをsystem controlのように見せない。

conditions: Prevent a static poster from implying an unavailable or different interaction.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0024.review_note: Recorded the control-affordance confusion behind the prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0025.title: Consider a representative watchOS poster image

statement.en: Consider using a watchOS poster image that represents the video clip.
statement.ja: video clipを表すwatchOS poster imageの使用を検討する。

conditions: Choose an image that helps people understand the clip before playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0025.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded relevance as the selection criterion.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0026.title: Consider useful tvOS transport controls or information tabs

statement.en: Consider a tvOS transport control or custom information tab when playback-specific access is useful.
statement.ja: playback固有のaccessが有用な場合、tvOS transport controlまたはcustom information tabを検討する。

conditions: Use transport controls for playback actions and custom tabs for succinct content-specific information.
Include only options that are useful in the current viewing context.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0026.review_note: Repaired the truncated title and preserved optionality, component roles, usefulness, and succinctness.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0027.title: Default wide video to aspect-fill

statement.en: Use aspect-fill by default for wide video from 2:1 through 2.40:1.
statement.ja: 2:1から2.40:1までのwide videoではaspect-fillをdefaultにする。

conditions: Aspect-fill scales to the display and may crop content at the edges.
At exactly 2:1, the source also includes fit-to-screen; choose deliberately for that boundary case.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0027.review_note: Recovered the aspect-fill range and preserved the source's inclusive 2:1 overlap as unresolved guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0028.title: Default standard and ultrawide video to fit-to-screen

statement.en: Use fit-to-screen by default for standard and ultrawide video ratios.
statement.ja: standardおよびultrawide video ratioではfit-to-screenをdefaultにする。

conditions: This includes 4:3, 16:9, ratios through 2:1, and ultrawide ratios beyond 2.40:1.
Fit-to-screen keeps the entire video visible and can add letterboxing or pillarboxing.
At exactly 2:1, the source also includes aspect-fill; choose deliberately for that boundary case.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0028.review_note: Recovered both fit-to-screen ranges and preserved the source's inclusive 2:1 overlap as unresolved guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0029.title: Avoid obscuring video with additional information

statement.en: Avoid letting additional information obscure video playback.
statement.ja: 追加informationでvideo playbackを隠さない。

conditions: Keep supplementary content placed and timed so the video remains understandable.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0029.review_note: Recovered the explicit visibility constraint separately from the optional value test.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0030.title: Keep tvOS transport actions within one or two steps

statement.en: Make sure tvOS transport actions take no more than one or two steps.
statement.ja: tvOS transport actionを1〜2手以内で完了できるようにする。

conditions: Apply the limit to actions exposed through playback transport controls.
Keep any associated custom information concise and relevant.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0030.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure directive and its one-or-two-step ceiling.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0031.title: Map Space to play and pause

statement.en: Use Space on a connected Bluetooth keyboard to play or pause playback.
statement.ja: 接続Bluetooth keyboardのSpaceでplaybackをplayまたはpauseする。

conditions: Support the mapping when a Bluetooth keyboard controls TV app playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0031.review_note: Recovered the concrete keyboard mapping from supporting prose.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0032.title: Begin playback once enough content loads

statement.en: Begin playback as soon as enough content has loaded.
statement.ja: 十分なcontentがloadされたらすぐplaybackを開始する。

conditions: Do not wait for the remaining TV app content to finish loading before playback begins.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0032.review_note: Recovered the actual readiness condition instead of retaining the vague immediate-playback fragment.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0033.title: Avoid distracting tvOS playback overlays

statement.en: Avoid large or distracting tvOS overlays that do not enhance viewing.
statement.ja: 視聴を高めないlargeまたはdistractingなtvOS overlayを避ける。

conditions: Keep a logo or other noninteractive overlay subordinate to the video.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0033.review_note: Recovered the direct size, distraction, and viewing-value prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0034.title: Let people start visionOS video deliberately

statement.en: Let people choose when to start visionOS video playback.
statement.ja: visionOS video playbackの開始時点を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Preserve user control before playback changes attention or immersion.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0034.review_note: Recovered the first comfort technique at SHOULD without raising it to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0035.title: Use a small resizable visionOS playback window

statement.en: Use a small window for visionOS video playback and let people resize it.
statement.ja: visionOS video playbackにはsmall windowを使い、利用者がresizeできるようにする。

conditions: Use window scale and resizing to support comfortable viewing.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0035.review_note: Recovered both the small initial window and user resizing technique at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0036.title: Keep surroundings visible during visionOS playback

statement.en: Keep people's surroundings visible during visionOS video playback.
statement.ja: visionOS video playback中も利用者のsurroundingsを見える状態に保つ。

conditions: Apply this as a comfort technique when full immersion is unnecessary.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0036.review_note: Recovered surroundings visibility at SHOULD and preserved its comfort context.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0037.title: Avoid obscuring immersive playback controls

statement.en: Avoid virtual content obscuring immersive video or its transport controls.
statement.ja: virtual contentでimmersive videoまたはtransport controlを隠さない。

conditions: Apply this in a fully immersive playback experience.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0037.review_note: Recovered the conditional control-visibility prohibition at conservative AVOID strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0038.title: Avoid scaling watchOS video clips

statement.en: Avoid scaling watchOS video clips.
statement.ja: watchOS video clipをscaleしない。

conditions: Encode media at an appropriate target size instead of relying on runtime scaling.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0038.review_note: Recovered the direct no-scaling instruction from the media-encoding paragraph.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0039.title: Avoid irrelevant watchOS poster images

statement.en: Avoid watchOS poster images that do not represent their video clips.
statement.ja: video clipを表さないwatchOS poster imageを避ける。

conditions: Use a representative image when a poster is useful, while keeping it distinct from controls.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0039.review_note: Recovered relevance as a separate prohibition from the optional poster-image rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0040.title: Keep loading TV app content in the background

statement.en: Keep loading remaining TV app content in the background after playback begins.
statement.ja: playback開始後も残りのTV app contentをbackgroundでloadし続ける。

conditions: Start playback once enough content is ready and continue fetching the rest without interrupting it.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-VIDEO-0040.review_note: Recovered the background continuation separately from the playback-readiness rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0001.title: Respond smoothly to audio interruptions

statement.en: Respond smoothly when another app or the system interrupts the app's audio.
statement.ja: 他のappまたはsystemがapp audioをinterruptしたとき滑らかに応答する。

conditions: Distinguish primary-audio interruptions from shorter transient interruptions.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0001.review_note: Recorded the two interruption classes and separated their required responses.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0002.title: Use background notifications sparingly

statement.en: Use notifications sparingly while the app is suspended or running in the background.
statement.ja: appがsuspend中またはbackground動作中のnotificationを控えめに使う。

conditions: Reserve completion notifications for tasks important or time-sensitive enough to justify them.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0002.review_note: Recorded both background states and separated useful and unnecessary completion cases.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0003.title: Avoid interfering with visionOS multitasking feedback

statement.en: Avoid interfering with system-provided visionOS multitasking behavior and feedback.
statement.ja: system提供のvisionOS multitasking behaviorとfeedbackを妨げない。

conditions: The system uses translucency, z-axis recession, and a feathered mask to communicate active-window changes.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0003.review_note: Recorded every system state cue and separated the concrete window-edge restriction.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0004.title: Avoid pausing visionOS video when gaze moves away

statement.en: Avoid pausing a visionOS window's video when people look away from it.
statement.ja: 利用者が視線を外したときvisionOS windowのvideoをpauseしない。

conditions: People expect playback started in one window to continue while they use another window.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0004.review_note: Retained AVOID under the conservative don't policy and recorded cross-window playback continuity.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0005.title: Handle visionOS audio ducking

statement.en: Prepare for visionOS audio to duck when people look from the app to another app.
statement.ja: 利用者が別appへ視線を移したときvisionOS audioがduckする状況へ備える。

exceptions: The current Now Playing app does not duck for this reason.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0005.review_note: Recorded the gaze transition and Now Playing exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0006.title: Support multitasking except in rare cases

statement.en: Make every app work well with multitasking except in rare justified cases.
statement.ja: 正当な稀な例外を除き、すべてのappをmultitaskingへ適切に対応させる。

exceptions: Some games and visionOS apps running in a Full Space can be rare exceptions.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0006.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit every-app need while preserving both named exception classes.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0007.title: Always save and restore multitasking context

statement.en: Always prepare to save and restore people's context when multitasking begins or ends.
statement.ja: multitaskingの開始・終了時に利用者のcontextをsave・restoreできるよう常に備える。

conditions: The app cannot predict when people will initiate multitasking.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0007.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit always need with its unpredictable-timing rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0008.title: Prevent missed activity content during app switching

statement.en: Make sure people do not miss attention-dependent activity content when they switch apps.
statement.ja: app切替時にattention-dependentなactivity contentを見逃さないようにする。

conditions: This is especially relevant to games and media-viewing apps.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0008.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure requirement and its two example app types.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0009.title: Resume activities from their prior context
