statement.en: When people return after app switching, let them continue an activity from where they left it.
statement.ja: app切替後に戻ったとき、離れたcontextからactivityを続行できるようにする。

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0009.review_note: Recovered the return-path continuation rule as a separate state-restoration outcome.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0010.title: Consider important background-task completion notifications

statement.en: Consider notifying people when an important or time-sensitive background task completes.
statement.ja: 重要またはtime-sensitiveなbackground task完了時の通知を検討する。

conditions: A notification can help people return and take the next step.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0010.review_note: Recovered the optional notification case and retained both importance qualifiers.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0011.title: Avoid routine background-task completion notifications

statement.en: Avoid notifying people immediately when a routine or secondary background task completes.
statement.ja: routineまたはsecondaryなbackground task完了直後の通知を避ける。

exceptions: Let people check the task when they return to the app.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0011.review_note: Recovered the unnecessary-notification AVOID and its passive-return alternative.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0012.title: Adapt iPadOS apps to different window sizes

statement.en: Make an iPadOS app adapt gracefully across different window sizes.
statement.ja: iPadOS appを異なるwindow sizeへ滑らかにadaptさせる。

conditions: People can open the app in a resizable window.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0012.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure requirement from the updated iPadOS guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0013.title: Avoid changing visionOS window edges during gaze transitions

statement.en: Avoid changing a visionOS window's edges when people look from it to another window.
statement.ja: 別windowへ視線を移したときvisionOS windowのedgeを変更しない。

conditions: Preserve the system feathered mask that communicates the window's changed state.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0013.review_note: Recovered the concrete don't clause at AVOID and tied it to the system feedback it protects.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0014.title: Pause attention-dependent activities during app switching

statement.en: Pause activities that require attention or active participation when people switch away.
statement.ja: 利用者が切り替えたときattentionまたはactive participationを要するactivityをpauseする。

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0014.review_note: Recovered the activity-pause rule and preserved both applicability criteria.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0015.title: Pause indefinitely for primary-audio interruptions

statement.en: Pause app audio indefinitely when a primary-audio interruption begins.
statement.ja: primary-audio interruption開始時にapp audioを無期限にpauseする。

conditions: Primary audio includes music, podcasts, and audiobooks.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0015.review_note: Recovered the primary-audio response and every source example.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0016.title: Temporarily duck or pause audio for short interruptions

statement.en: For a short audio interruption, temporarily lower or pause app audio and resume it afterward.
statement.ja: 短いaudio interruptionではapp audioを一時的に下げるかpauseし、終了後にresumeする。

conditions: A GPS directional notification is an example of a short interruption.
Resume the original volume or playback when the interruption ends.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0016.review_note: Recovered both short-interruption responses, the example, and the restoration requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0017.title: Finish user-initiated background tasks before suspension

statement.en: Finish a user-initiated task that needs no more input in the background before suspending.
statement.ja: 追加input不要のuser-initiated taskをsuspend前にbackgroundで完了する。

conditions: Examples include downloading assets and processing a video file.
HIG-PATTERNS-MULTITASKING-0017.review_note: Recovered the completion rule and preserved its no-more-input condition and examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0001.title: Show content as soon as possible

statement.en: Show useful content or a meaningful placeholder as soon as possible while loading.
statement.ja: loading中は有用なcontentまたは意味のあるplaceholderをできるだけ早く表示する。

conditions: A blank initial state can look like a problem with the app or game.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0001.review_note: Recorded the blank-state failure interpretation and separated optional placeholder forms.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0002.title: Keep other actions available while content loads

statement.en: Let people continue using other app or game actions while content loads.
statement.ja: contentのloading中も他のappまたはgame actionを続けて使えるようにする。

conditions: Load content in the background so unrelated actions remain available.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0002.review_note: Recorded background loading as the mechanism for continued interaction.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0003.title: Consider a custom game loading view

statement.en: For a game, consider a custom loading view that matches the game's visual style.
statement.ja: gameではvisual styleに合うcustom loading viewを検討する。

conditions: Standard progress indicators work well in most apps but can feel out of place in a game.
Custom animations and elements can create a more engaging experience.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0003.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded both the standard default and game-style rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0004.title: Avoid watchOS loading indicators where possible

statement.en: Wherever practicable, avoid showing a loading indicator in a watchOS experience.
statement.ja: 可能な限りwatchOS体験でloading indicatorを表示しない。

conditions: Apple Watch interactions are expected to be quick.
exceptions: For a one- or two-second load, an indicator is preferable to a blank screen.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0004.review_note: Preserved the practicability qualifier and the brief-loading blank-screen exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0005.title: Communicate loading state and expected duration

statement.en: Clearly communicate that content is loading and how long completion may take.
statement.ja: contentがloading中であることと完了までの見込み時間を明確に伝える。

conditions: When loading exceeds a moment or two, use an appropriate system-provided progress indicator.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0005.review_note: Recorded the delay threshold and system-component response.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0006.title: Keep loading from disrupting the experience

statement.en: Design asset and content loading to avoid disrupting or harming the user experience.
statement.ja: assetやcontentのloadingがuser experienceを妨げたり損なったりしないよう設計する。

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0006.review_note: Recovered the page-level loading principle without raising its strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0007.title: Consider meaningful loading placeholders

statement.en: Consider showing placeholder text, graphics, or animations while content loads.
statement.ja: contentのloading中にplaceholder text、graphic、animationの表示を検討する。

conditions: Replace each placeholder as its content becomes available.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0007.review_note: Recovered the optional placeholder technique and every listed form.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0008.title: Provide interesting content during unavoidable long loading

statement.en: When loading is unavoidably long, give people interesting content to view while they wait.
statement.ja: loadingが避けられず長い場合、待機中に見られる興味深いcontentを提供する。

conditions: Possible content includes gameplay hints, tips, or introductions to new features.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0008.review_note: Recovered the conditional long-wait rule and every content example.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0009.title: Download large assets in the background

statement.en: Download large assets in the background to improve installation and launch time.
statement.ja: installationとlaunch timeを改善するためlarge assetをbackgroundでdownloadする。

conditions: Consider scheduling downloads after installation, during updates, or at other nondisruptive times.
Large assets can include level packs, 3D models, and textures.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0009.review_note: Recovered the background-download rule and recorded all timing and asset examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0010.title: Match progress-indicator type to duration knowledge

statement.en: Use a determinate progress indicator for a known duration and an indeterminate indicator for an unknown duration.
statement.ja: durationが既知ならdeterminate、未知ならindeterminate progress indicatorを使う。

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0010.review_note: Recovered both halves of the source's progress-indicator selection mapping.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0011.title: Aim to display watchOS content immediately

statement.en: Aim to display watchOS content immediately.
statement.ja: watchOS contentを即時表示することを目指す。

conditions: People expect quick Apple Watch interactions.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0011.review_note: Recovered the watchOS immediacy aim without promoting it to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0012.title: Prefer a watchOS indicator to a brief blank screen

statement.en: For a one- or two-second watchOS load, prefer a loading indicator to a blank screen.
statement.ja: 1〜2秒のwatchOS loadingではblank screenよりloading indicatorを優先する。

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0012.review_note: Recovered the narrow brief-loading exception and its preferred fallback.

HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0013.title: Estimate remaining loading time accurately

statement.en: Estimate remaining loading time as accurately as possible for long-wait placeholder content.
statement.ja: 長時間待機のplaceholder content用に残りloading timeをできるだけ正確に見積もる。

conditions: Avoid giving people too little time to use placeholder content or so much time that it must repeat.
HIG-PATTERNS-LOADING-0013.review_note: Recovered the timing-accuracy rule and both placeholder-duration failure modes.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0001.title: Use familiar document commands and keyboard shortcuts

statement.en: Use familiar app-menu commands and keyboard shortcuts to create and open documents in iPadOS and macOS.
statement.ja: iPadOSとmacOSで使い慣れたapp menu commandとkeyboard shortcutを使ってdocumentを作成・開く。

conditions: Expose commands such as New and Open in the iPadOS shortcuts interface and the macOS File menu.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0001.review_note: Narrowed the rule to the two documented platforms and recorded both command surfaces.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0002.title: Preserve work unless people cancel or delete it

statement.en: Help people trust that their work remains preserved unless they cancel or delete it.
statement.ja: cancelまたはdeleteしない限りworkが保持されると利用者が信頼できるようにする。

conditions: Use automatic saving behavior rather than relying on an explicit save action.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0002.review_note: Recorded the preservation outcome and separated its explicit-save and autosave techniques.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0003.title: Use Quick Look for files the app cannot open

statement.en: Use a Quick Look viewer to preview files the app can interact with but cannot open.
statement.ja: appが操作できても開けないfileのpreviewにQuick Look viewerを使う。

conditions: Keep the preview available without requiring people to leave the app.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0003.review_note: Recorded the unsupported-file interaction condition and in-app continuity purpose.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0004.title: Consider a Quick Look generator for custom file types

statement.en: Consider implementing a Quick Look generator when the app produces custom file types.
statement.ja: appがcustom file typeを生成する場合はQuick Look generatorの実装を検討する。

conditions: Enable Finder, Files, Spotlight, and other apps to display document previews.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0004.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the custom-type condition and cross-app preview consumers.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0005.title: Distinguish the document-launcher background

statement.en: Make the document-launcher background clearly distinct from its accessories and title card.
statement.ja: document launcherのbackgroundをaccessoryとtitle cardから明確に区別する。

conditions: A solid color, gradient, or pattern can provide the background.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0005.review_note: Recorded the foreground-separation goal and every suggested background type.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0006.title: Place document-launcher accessories deliberately

statement.en: Place document-launcher accessories deliberately around the title card.
statement.ja: document launcherのaccessoryをtitle cardの周囲へ意図的に配置する。

conditions: Accessories may appear in front of and behind the card to create depth.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0006.review_note: Repaired the vague statement and separated visibility, clutter, and device-testing requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0007.title: Use document-launcher animation sparingly

statement.en: Use document-launcher accessory animation sparingly.
statement.ja: document launcher accessoryのanimationを控えめに使う。

conditions: Avoid motion that confuses or disorients people.
exceptions: Consider gentle repeating motion that subtly highlights or enhances content.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0007.review_note: Recorded the motion risks and the qualified gentle-animation option.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0008.title: Let people choose export and move destinations

statement.en: Let people choose a destination when exporting or moving documents through a file provider.
statement.ja: file providerでdocumentをexportまたはmoveするときdestinationを選べるようにする。

conditions: Let people navigate to a specific location in the directory hierarchy.
exceptions: Destination navigation may be unnecessary when the app stores documents in one directory.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0008.review_note: Recorded the hierarchy behavior and single-directory exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0009.title: Avoid a second top toolbar in file-provider extensions

statement.en: Avoid adding a custom top toolbar to a file-provider extension's modal view.
statement.ja: file provider extensionのmodal viewへcustom top toolbarを追加しない。

conditions: The containing modal view already provides a toolbar.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0009.review_note: Recorded the duplicate-toolbar context and its confusion and content-space costs.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0010.title: Make custom macOS file opening convenient

statement.en: Make a custom macOS file-opening interface convenient for its task.
statement.ja: custom macOS file-opening interfaceをtaskに適した使いやすいものにする。

conditions: Consider recent-file access, filtering criteria, multiple selection, and a task-specific Open button title.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0010.review_note: Recorded all four convenience examples and their task-specific context.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0011.title: Let people choose macOS save name, format, and location

statement.en: Provide a macOS save interface for choosing a file's name, format, and location.
statement.ja: fileのname、format、locationを選ぶmacOS save interfaceを提供する。

conditions: Default new documents to an untitled state and a logical browsing location.
When multiple formats are supported, provide a format choice.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0011.review_note: Recorded all editable file properties, the initial state, and the multi-format condition.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0012.title: Consider extending the macOS Save dialog

statement.en: Consider extending the macOS Save dialog with useful app-specific settings or options.
statement.ja: macOS Save dialogへ有用なapp-specific settingやoptionを追加することを検討する。

conditions: Add a custom accessory view only when the extension makes sense for the app.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0012.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the usefulness and app-fit conditions.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0013.title: Prevent work loss when macOS autosaving is off

statement.en: Help people avoid losing work when they turn off macOS autosaving.
statement.ja: macOS autosavingをoffにしたときworkを失わないよう利用者を支援する。

conditions: Show unsaved changes and present a save dialog before document close, app quit, logout, or restart.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0013.review_note: Recorded the autosave-off setting and every save-dialog trigger.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0014.title: Use Finder badges for item sync status

statement.en: Use Finder Sync badges to indicate item synchronization status.
statement.ja: itemのsynchronization statusを示すためFinder Sync badgeを使う。

conditions: The app synchronizes local and remote files through a Finder Sync extension.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0014.review_note: Recorded the extension and local-to-remote synchronization context.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0015.title: Use Finder Sync context menus for item management

statement.en: Provide Finder Sync contextual menu items for file and folder management tasks.
statement.ja: fileとfolderのmanagement taskにFinder Sync contextual menu itemを提供する。

conditions: Examples include favoriting and adding password protection.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0015.review_note: Repaired the truncated title and recorded both example item-level tasks.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0016.title: Use Finder Sync toolbar buttons for global actions

statement.en: Provide Finder Sync toolbar buttons for global actions.
statement.ja: global actionにFinder Sync toolbar buttonを提供する。

conditions: A global action can initiate synchronization.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0016.review_note: Recorded the global-action scope and synchronization example.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0017.title: Hide file extensions by default but allow viewing

statement.en: Hide file extensions by default while letting people choose to view them.
statement.ja: file extensionをdefaultでは隠し、利用者が表示を選べるようにする。

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0017.review_note: Preserved both the default and the user-controlled visibility option.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0018.title: Provide an Add action regardless of keyboard shortcuts

statement.en: Provide an Add action for new documents regardless of keyboard-shortcut availability.
statement.ja: keyboard shortcutの有無にかかわらず新規document用のAdd actionを提供する。

conditions: Use an Add button in iPadOS and place the macOS add action in the File menu.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0018.review_note: Recovered the independent Add requirement and recorded each platform surface.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0019.title: Follow platform conventions in a required custom file browser

statement.en: When a custom file browser is required, preserve people's understanding of the platform file system.
statement.ja: custom file browserが必要な場合、platform file systemに対する利用者の理解を保つ。

conditions: The app has an important reason to require a custom browser.
It may open at a relevant location while still letting people browse the rest of the file system.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0019.review_note: Recovered the conditional browser rule and recorded both initial-location flexibility and full-system access.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0020.title: Avoid requiring explicit save actions

statement.en: In general, avoid requiring people to take an explicit action to save their work.
statement.ja: 通常はwork保存のための明示操作を利用者へ求めない。

conditions: Use automatic saving to support confidence that work remains preserved.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0020.review_note: Recovered the source's qualified AVOID clause without turning it into a prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0021.title: Reflect the file-extension choice across interfaces

statement.en: Reflect the current file-extension visibility choice in every save and open interface.
statement.ja: 現在のfile-extension表示設定をすべてのsave・open interfaceへ反映する。

conditions: People can choose whether file extensions are visible.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0021.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure requirement with its current-choice scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0022.title: Assign document-launcher buttons to important functions

statement.en: Assign document-launcher title-card buttons to the app's most important functions.
statement.ja: document launcher title cardのbuttonをappの最重要functionへ割り当てる。

conditions: The primary button typically creates a document; the secondary button can offer additional options.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0022.review_note: Recovered the omitted assignment lead and recorded both button roles.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0023.title: Avoid distracting document-launcher backgrounds

statement.en: Avoid complex document-launcher images or patterns that can distract from foreground elements.
statement.ja: foreground elementから注意をそらす複雑なdocument launcher imageやpatternを避ける。

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0023.review_note: Recovered the background-complexity AVOID and its foreground-attention condition.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0024.title: Keep the document-launcher title and buttons visible

statement.en: Keep the app name and both document-launcher title-card buttons clearly visible.
statement.ja: app nameとdocument launcher title cardの両buttonを明確に見える状態へ保つ。

conditions: Accessories appear around, in front of, or behind the title card.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0024.review_note: Recovered and retained the conditional explicit need to make sure all title-card content remains visible.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0025.title: Avoid cluttering the document-launcher title card

statement.en: Avoid cluttering the document-launcher title card with too many accessories.
statement.ja: 過剰なaccessoryでdocument launcher title cardをclutterさせない。

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0025.review_note: Recovered the accessory-count AVOID as a separate atomic rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0026.title: Test the document launcher across supported displays

statement.en: Test the document launcher's overall appearance across every supported screen size and device orientation.
statement.ja: support対象の全screen sizeとdevice orientationでdocument launcher全体のappearanceをtestする。

conditions: The app customizes the document launcher and supports the tested size and orientation.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0026.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure test requirement with both documented dimensions.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0027.title: Show only context-appropriate file-provider documents

statement.en: When opening or importing through a file provider, show only documents appropriate to the current context.
statement.ja: file providerでopenまたはimportするとき、現在のcontextに適したdocumentだけを表示する。

conditions: For example, a PDF-editing app should list only PDF files for opening or import.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0027.review_note: Recovered the contextual display rule and its type-filtering example.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0028.title: Consider useful file-provider metadata

statement.en: Consider showing modification date, size, and local or remote status in a file provider.
statement.ja: file providerでmodification date、size、local・remote statusの表示を検討する。

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0028.review_note: Recovered the optional metadata clause and preserved every listed field.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0029.title: Consider adding subdirectories from a file provider

statement.en: Consider letting people add subdirectories while choosing a file-provider destination.
statement.ja: file providerのdestination選択中にsubdirectoryを追加できるようにすることを検討する。

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0029.review_note: Recovered the optional subdirectory-creation clause without raising its strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0030.title: Use the default macOS file browser by default

statement.en: Use the default macOS file browser unless an important reason requires a custom one.
statement.ja: 重要な理由でcustom browserが必要でない限りdefault macOS file browserを使う。

conditions: Preserve the familiar Finder and document-app file-browsing experience.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0030.review_note: Recovered the default-browser rule and preserved its important-reason exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0031.title: Expose unsaved changes when autosaving is off

statement.en: When macOS autosaving is off, make sure people know which documents have unsaved changes.
statement.ja: macOS autosavingがoffのとき、unsaved changeのあるdocumentを利用者が把握できるようにする。

conditions: Display a dot on the document window close button and beside the document name in the Window menu.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0031.review_note: Recovered and retained the conditional Make sure requirement and both documented indicators.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0032.title: Avoid unsaved-change dots when autosaving is on

statement.en: Avoid displaying unsaved-change dots when macOS autosaving is on.
statement.ja: macOS autosavingがonのときunsaved-change dotを表示しない。

conditions: A dot would incorrectly imply that people must act to preserve their work.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0032.review_note: Recovered a conservative AVOID rule from the source's confusion warning.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0033.title: Remove the Edited suffix immediately after saving

statement.en: Remove an Edited document-title suffix as soon as automatic or explicit saving completes.
statement.ja: automaticまたはexplicit save完了直後にdocument titleのEdited suffixを除去する。

conditions: The app appends Edited to a document title regardless of autosave status.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0033.review_note: Recovered and retained the conditional Be sure requirement with both save paths.

HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0034.title: Save automatically during editing and transitions

statement.en: Save work automatically at intervals during editing and when a file closes or the app changes.
statement.ja: editing中は定期的に、fileを閉じる時やappを切り替える時にworkを自動保存する。

conditions: Use automatic saving as the alternative to explicit save actions.
HIG-PATTERNS-FILE-MANAGEMENT-0034.review_note: Recovered the positive autosave rule and preserved every documented save trigger.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0001.title: Make all feedback accessible

statement.en: Make all feedback accessible by providing multiple complementary ways to receive it.
statement.ja: 複数の補完的な受け取り方を提供し、すべてのfeedbackをaccessibleにする。

conditions: Combine applicable forms such as color, text, sound, and haptics.
Account for silenced devices, attention away from the screen, and VoiceOver use.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0001.review_note: Retained the accessibility-critical MUST and recorded the source's multimodal examples and receiving contexts.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0002.title: Consider integrating status feedback into the interface

statement.en: Consider integrating status feedback near the interface items it describes.
statement.ja: status feedbackを説明対象のinterface itemの近くへ統合することを検討する。

conditions: Keep important status information available without requiring action or a context change.
Prefer an unobtrusive presentation that remains easy to check.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0002.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the proximity, no-action, and unobtrusive-access conditions.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0003.title: Use alerts for critical, preferably actionable information

statement.en: Use alerts to deliver critical and preferably actionable information.
statement.ja: criticalで、できればactionableな情報の伝達にalertを使う。

conditions: Match the importance of the information to the alert's interruption level.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0003.review_note: Recorded the criticality, actionability preference, and proportional-interruption constraint.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0004.title: Warn before unexpected irreversible data loss

statement.en: Warn people before a task can cause data loss that is both unexpected and irreversible.
statement.ja: taskが予期せず不可逆なdata lossを起こす前に警告する。

conditions: Both unexpectedness and irreversibility distinguish this warning case from ordinary destructive actions.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0004.review_note: Preserved both source qualifiers and separated the expected-result exception into its own AVOID rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0005.title: Explain why a command cannot be carried out

statement.en: Tell people when a command cannot be carried out and explain why.
statement.ja: commandを実行できないことと、その理由を利用者へ伝える。

conditions: Provide enough context for people to understand the invalid or incomplete request.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0005.review_note: Repaired the generated statement and retained both failure disclosure and explanation.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0006.title: Avoid indeterminate progress indicators in watchOS apps

statement.en: Avoid displaying an indeterminate progress indicator in a watchOS app.
statement.ja: watchOS appでindeterminate progress indicatorを表示しない。

conditions: Animated indefinite indicators can imply that people need to keep watching the display.
exceptions: Prefer reassuring people that a notification will arrive when the process completes.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0006.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the attention cost and completion-notification alternative.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0007.title: Match feedback delivery to information significance

statement.en: Match the way feedback is delivered to the significance of its information.
statement.ja: feedbackの伝達方法を情報の重要度に合わせる。

conditions: Passive delivery can suit status information people check when needed.
Potential data loss can justify an interruption that gives people a chance to avoid it.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0007.review_note: Recovered the page-level principle and recorded both passive-status and interruptive-warning examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0008.title: Avoid overusing alerts

statement.en: Avoid using alerts too often or for unimportant information.
statement.ja: alertを頻繁に使ったり、重要でない情報へ使ったりしない。

conditions: Preserve the impact of alerts by reserving their interruption for sufficiently important information.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0008.review_note: Recovered a conservative AVOID rule from the source's alert-impact warning.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0009.title: Avoid warnings for expected data loss

statement.en: Avoid warning people when data loss is the expected result of their action.
statement.ja: data lossが操作の予期された結果である場合は警告しない。

conditions: For example, ordinary file deletion has an expected destructive result.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0009.review_note: Recovered the explicit don't clause while retaining AVOID under the repository's conservative strength policy.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0010.title: Confirm completion of sufficiently important actions

statement.en: When appropriate, confirm that a sufficiently important action or task has completed.
statement.ja: 適切な場合、十分に重要なactionやtaskの完了を確認できるようにする。

conditions: Reserve explicit success confirmation for activities important enough to justify it.
exceptions: Routine actions generally need feedback only when they fail.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0010.review_note: Recovered the conditional completion rule and preserved its importance threshold and routine-success exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0011.title: Notify people when a watchOS process completes

statement.en: Notify people when a watchOS process completes instead of requiring continued attention.
statement.ja: 継続的な注視を求めず、watchOS processの完了時に通知する。

conditions: Use this completion feedback where an indeterminate animated indicator would otherwise imply continued attention.
HIG-PATTERNS-FEEDBACK-0011.review_note: Recovered the watchOS completion-notification alternative as a separate positive rule.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0001.title: Respond consistently to mouse and trackpad gestures

statement.en: Respond to familiar mouse and trackpad gestures consistently with system expectations.
statement.ja: 使い慣れたmouseとtrackpad gestureへsystemの期待と一貫して応答する。

conditions: For example, Swipe between pages behaves consistently across documents, webpages, and images.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0001.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded the cross-content consistency example.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0002.title: Avoid redefining systemwide trackpad gestures

statement.en: Avoid redefining systemwide trackpad gestures, including in games with custom gestures.
statement.ja: custom gestureを使うgameを含め、systemwide trackpad gestureを再定義しない。

conditions: Keep gestures for the Dock, Mission Control, and other system actions available.
Account for user-customized system gesture settings.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0002.review_note: Recorded the game scope, system examples, and customizable-gesture constraint.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0003.title: Keep interactions consistent across input methods

statement.en: Keep the app experience consistent across gestures, gaze, pointing devices, and keyboards.
statement.ja: gesture、gaze、pointing device、keyboard間でapp体験を一貫させる。

conditions: Let people move fluidly between input types without learning separate interaction models.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0003.review_note: Repaired the truncated statement and preserved every named input method.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0004.title: Let the pointer reveal and hide transient controls

statement.en: Let people use the pointer to reveal and hide controls that minimize or fade automatically.
statement.ja: 自動的にminimizeまたはfadeするcontrolをpointerで表示・非表示にできるようにする。

conditions: Examples include a minimized toolbar and full-screen playback controls.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0004.review_note: Recorded both control examples and the bidirectional reveal-and-hide behavior.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0005.title: Keep modifier-key interactions consistent

statement.en: Keep object interactions consistent while a person holds a modifier key.
statement.ja: modifier keyを押している間のobject interactionを一貫させる。

conditions: Option-drag duplication is a representative modifier-key interaction.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0005.review_note: Separated general modifier-key consistency from the explicit touch-and-pointer equality requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0006.title: Support pointer multiple selection in custom iPadOS views

statement.en: When needed, support pointer-based multiple selection in custom iPadOS views.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はcustom iPadOS viewでpointerによるmultiple selectionをsupportする。

conditions: In iPadOS 15 and later, click-and-drag expands the pointer into a rectangular selection region.
Standard nonlist collection views support this by default; custom views require implementation.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0006.review_note: Recorded OS availability, selection behavior, and the custom-view implementation boundary.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0007.title: Differentiate pointer and touch only when valuable

statement.en: Differentiate iPadOS pointer and touch input only when the distinction adds value.
statement.ja: 価値が加わる場合にだけiPadOSのpointerとtouch inputを区別する。

conditions: A video scrubber can offer precise pointer seeking while retaining touch dragging.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0007.review_note: Recorded the value gate and the precision-without-replacement example.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0008.title: Use clear, simple pointer-accessory images

statement.en: Use clear, simple images for custom iPadOS pointer accessories.
statement.ja: custom iPadOS pointer accessoryには明確でsimpleなimageを使う。

conditions: The small image must communicate the interaction without excessive detail.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0008.review_note: Recorded the accessory size and communication constraint.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0009.title: Consider accessory transitions for state changes

statement.en: Consider using an iPadOS pointer-accessory transition to communicate an element’s state or behavior change.
statement.ja: elementのstateやbehavior変化を伝えるためiPadOS pointer accessory transitionを検討する。

conditions: The system animates accessory appearance, disappearance, shape, and position transitions.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0009.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the complete transition behavior.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0010.title: Prefer standard pointer appearances for standard elements

statement.en: Prefer system-provided iPadOS pointer appearances for standard buttons and text-entry areas.
statement.ja: standard buttonとtext-entry areaにはsystem提供のiPadOS pointer appearanceを優先する。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0010.review_note: Recorded the exact standard element types and familiarity purpose.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0011.title: Create contiguous hit regions for custom bar buttons

statement.en: Create contiguous iPadOS hit regions for adjacent custom bar buttons.
statement.ja: 隣接するcustom bar buttonに連続したiPadOS hit regionを作る。

conditions: Prevent the pointer from briefly reverting to its default shape between buttons.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0011.review_note: Recorded adjacency and the distracting default-shape transition it prevents.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0012.title: Use standard pointer effects for standard-like custom elements

statement.en: Prefer system-provided iPadOS pointer effects for custom elements that behave like standard elements.
statement.ja: standard elementのように動作するcustom elementにはsystem提供のiPadOS pointer effectを優先する。

conditions: A nonstandard effect on a standard-like control can make it appear broken.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0012.review_note: Recorded the behavior-based test and the broken-control risk.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0013.title: Use pointer effects consistently

statement.en: Use iPadOS pointer effects consistently throughout the app.
statement.ja: app全体でiPadOS pointer effectを一貫して使う。

conditions: Give similar work areas, such as drawing regions, similar pointer behavior.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0013.review_note: Recorded the cross-area learning transfer the consistency supports.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0014.title: Avoid gratuitous pointer and content effects

statement.en: Avoid iPadOS pointer and content effects that provide no practical value.
statement.ja: 実用的な価値のないiPadOS pointer effectやcontent effectを避ける。

conditions: Purely decorative changes can distract or irritate people.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0014.review_note: Recorded the practical-value test and both user-impact risks.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0015.title: Keep custom pointer shapes simple

statement.en: Keep custom iPadOS pointer shapes simple and immediately understandable.
statement.ja: custom iPadOS pointer shapeをsimpleで即座に理解できるものにする。

conditions: Signal the available action without drawing excessive attention to the pointer.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0015.review_note: Repaired the statement and recorded action signaling and attention limits.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0016.title: Consider useful pointer annotations

statement.en: Consider custom iPadOS pointer annotations that provide useful contextual information.
statement.ja: 有用なcontext情報を提供するcustom iPadOS pointer annotationを検討する。

conditions: Representative information includes graph coordinates or a resizable image’s dimensions.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0016.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the usefulness gate and both examples.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0017.title: Avoid instructional pointer text

statement.en: Avoid displaying instructional text with an iPadOS pointer.
statement.ja: iPadOS pointerにinstructional textを表示しない。

exceptions: Make the interface clear and simple enough to understand with either pointer or touch.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0017.review_note: Recorded the complexity risk and the interface-clarity alternative.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0018.title: Consider shadow, scale, and spacing together

statement.en: Consider shadow, scale, and element spacing together when defining an iPadOS hover effect.
statement.ja: iPadOS hover effectではshadow、scale、element spacingを合わせて検討する。

conditions: Reserve scaling for elements with room to grow without crowding or overlap.
When space is limited, consider tint without scale and shadow; avoid shadow without scale.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0018.review_note: Retained MAY and preserved all scale, tint, shadow, and spacing relationships.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0019.title: Use highlight for small transparent elements

statement.en: Use the iPadOS highlight effect for a small element with a transparent background.
statement.ja: transparent backgroundを持つsmall elementにはiPadOS highlight effectを使う。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0020.title: Use lift for small opaque elements

statement.en: Use the iPadOS lift effect for a small element with an opaque background.
statement.ja: opaque backgroundを持つsmall elementにはiPadOS lift effectを使う。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0021.title: Use hover for large iPadOS elements

statement.en: Use the iPadOS hover effect for large elements and customize scale, tint, and shadow as needed.
statement.ja: large elementにはiPadOS hover effectを使い、必要に応じてscale、tint、shadowを調整する。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0021.review_note: Repaired the truncated statement and preserved all three customizable attributes.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0022.title: Provide the corner radius for a nonstandard lift shape

statement.en: Provide the corner radius when an iPadOS lift-effect element uses a nonstandard shape.
statement.ja: iPadOS lift effectのelementが非標準shapeを使う場合はcorner radiusを提供する。

conditions: The element’s shape differs from the system rounded rectangle, such as a circle.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0022.review_note: Promoted to MUST after confirming the conditional explicit need to provide the radius for seamless animation.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0023.title: Keep modifier-key results identical across touch and pointer input

statement.en: Ensure a modifier-key interaction produces the same result with touch and pointer input.
statement.ja: modifier-key interactionがtouchとpointer inputで同じ結果になるようにする。

conditions: The app supports the same object interaction with touch and a pointer.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0023.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit ensure requirement as an atomic input-parity rule.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0024.title: Support system iPadOS content effects when possible

statement.en: When possible, support system-provided iPadOS content effects according to each effect’s design intent.
statement.ja: 可能な場合は各effectのdesign intentに従ってsystem提供のiPadOS content effectをsupportする。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0024.review_note: Recovered the omitted lead and its system-consistency condition.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0025.title: Provide comfortable iPadOS pointer hit regions

statement.en: Provide comfortable pointer hit regions around iPadOS interactive elements.
statement.ja: iPadOSのinteractive element周囲に快適なpointer hit regionを設ける。

conditions: Balance selection precision against the effort needed to pull the pointer away.
About 12 points around bezel elements and 24 points around bezel-free visible edges are documented starting points.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0025.review_note: Recovered the omitted lead and preserved both approximate padding values without making them universal minima.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0026.title: Avoid magnetism on iPadOS hover effects

statement.en: Avoid adding pointer magnetism to an iPadOS element that uses hover.
statement.ja: hoverを使うiPadOS elementにpointer magnetismを追加しない。

conditions: Hover retains the default pointer shape, so magnetism can feel jarring or reduce control.
exceptions: iPadOS applies magnetism by default to lift, highlight, and text-entry areas.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0026.review_note: Recovered the omitted hover-specific restriction and preserved the system-applied exceptions.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0027.title: Support standard macOS pointing-device mappings

statement.en: Support standard macOS mouse and trackpad interactions with their documented behavior.
statement.ja: standard macOS mouse・trackpad interactionを記載されたbehaviorでsupportする。

conditions: Mouse and trackpad: primary click selects; secondary click opens context; scroll moves content; smart zoom and page or full-screen swipes navigate.
Mouse and trackpad: Mission Control activates; trackpad lookup shows data; tap to click performs primary click; force click shows Quick Look or pressure control.
Trackpad pinch zooms; two-finger rotation rotates; edge swipe opens Notification Center; downward swipe opens App Exposé.
Trackpad thumb-and-three-finger pinch opens Launchpad; spreading them reveals the desktop.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0027.review_note: Recovered a specification rule and preserved every interaction, expected behavior, and mouse-versus-trackpad support row.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0028.title: Use standard macOS pointer styles by meaning

statement.en: Use each standard macOS pointer style only for its documented interactive meaning.
statement.ja: 各standard macOS pointer styleを記載されたinteractive meaningに合わせて使う。

conditions: Arrow selects; closed or open hand repositions; contextual-menu and pointing-hand pointers indicate menu and link availability.
Crosshair selects precisely; disappearing-item, drag-copy, and drag-link pointers communicate drag results.
Horizontal or vertical I-beam indicates matching text insertion; operation-not-allowed rejects a drop.
Directional resize pointers communicate down, left, left-right, right, up, or up-down resizing.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0028.review_note: Recovered a specification rule and preserved every standard pointer name, meaning, and AppKit mapping.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0001.title: Offer multiple interaction methods

statement.en: Give people more than one way to interact with the app.
statement.ja: アプリを操作する方法を複数提供する。

conditions: Alternative inputs can include voice, keyboard, and Switch Control.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0001.review_note: Recorded the accessibility purpose and stated alternative input examples.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0002.title: Make custom gestures easy to learn

statement.en: Make custom gestures easy for people to learn and perform.
statement.ja: custom gestureを学びやすく実行しやすいものにする。

conditions: Offer timely learning moments using simple language and graphics.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0002.review_note: Separated learnability from the explicit real-use testing requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0003.title: Keep standard alternatives to shortcut gestures

statement.en: Use shortcut gestures to supplement standard gestures, not replace them.
statement.ja: shortcut gestureはstandard gestureの補助として使い、置き換えない。

conditions: Keep simple, familiar navigation and action paths even when they require extra taps.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0003.review_note: Recorded the persistent familiar path that must remain alongside a shortcut.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0004.title: Avoid conflicts with system UI gestures

statement.en: Avoid custom gestures that conflict with gestures for accessing system UI.
statement.ja: system UIへアクセスするgestureと競合するcustom gestureを避ける。

exceptions: Specific games or immersive experiences can defer a system gesture where the platform permits it.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0004.review_note: Preserved the system-consistency default and the narrow deferral exception.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0005.title: Consider simultaneous iOS and iPadOS gestures

statement.en: Consider recognizing multiple iOS or iPadOS gestures simultaneously when doing so enhances the experience.
statement.ja: 体験を高める場合は複数のiOSまたはiPadOS gestureの同時認識を検討する。

conditions: Simultaneous gestures are generally more relevant to games with multiple onscreen controls than to nongame apps.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0005.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the game-specific use case and nongame limitation.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0006.title: Support standard visionOS gestures wherever possible

statement.en: Support standard visionOS gestures everywhere the experience can.
statement.ja: 可能な場所ではstandard visionOS gestureをsupportする。

conditions: Touch selects or activates; touch and hold opens a contextual menu; touch and drag moves an object.
Double touch previews or selects a word; swipe reveals, dismisses, or scrolls.
Two-hand pinch-and-drag zooms; circular two-hand pinch-and-drag rotates.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0006.review_note: Preserved the standard-gesture default and every direct-gesture table mapping.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0007.title: Offer indirect and direct visionOS interactions

statement.en: Offer both indirect and direct visionOS interactions when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はindirectとdirectの両方のvisionOS interactionを提供する。

conditions: Prefer indirect gestures for UI and common components.
Reserve direct and custom gestures for close-up objects or specific game and interactive motions.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0007.review_note: Recorded the two interaction categories and their intended contexts.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0008.title: Avoid required body movements or positions

statement.en: Avoid requiring a specific body movement or position for visionOS input.
statement.ja: visionOS入力に特定のbody movementやpositionを必須にしない。

exceptions: When movement is required, consider alternative inputs that let people choose a workable method.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0008.review_note: Recorded disability, space, and environmental access constraints plus the alternative-input response.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0009.title: Prioritize comfort in custom visionOS gestures

statement.en: Prioritize physical comfort when designing custom visionOS gestures.
statement.ja: custom visionOS gestureの設計では身体的なcomfortを優先する。

conditions: Continually test ergonomics.
Avoid sustained raised arms and repeated similar motions that can stress muscles or joints.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0009.review_note: Replaced the generic statement with its ergonomic testing and fatigue limits.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0010.title: Avoid hand-specific custom visionOS gestures

statement.en: Avoid custom visionOS gestures that require a specific hand.
statement.ja: 特定の手を必須とするcustom visionOS gestureを避ける。

conditions: Hand-specific gestures can increase cognitive load and exclude people with hand dominance or limb differences.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0010.review_note: Recorded both cognitive and inclusive-design reasons for the restriction.

section_path: Working with system overlays in visionOS

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0011.title: Consider deferring visionOS system overlays in immersive experiences

statement.en: Consider deferring system-overlay behavior in an immersive visionOS app or game.
statement.ja: immersiveなvisionOS appやgameではsystem overlay behaviorのdeferを検討する。

conditions: The app runs in a Full Space and preserving immersion justifies requiring a tap to reveal the Home indicator.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0011.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the Full Space, immersion, and tap-to-reveal conditions.

section_path: Working with system overlays in visionOS

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0012.title: Use caution with rolling-hand visionOS gestures

statement.en: Use caution with custom visionOS gestures that roll the hand, wrist, or forearm.
statement.ja: hand、wrist、forearmを回すcustom visionOS gestureは慎重に設計する。

conditions: The rolling motion is reserved for system overlays.
Test conflicts because overlays appear above app content and the app cannot detect their visibility.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0012.review_note: Recorded the reserved motion, overlay precedence, app visibility limit, and testing need.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0013.title: Avoid watchOS primary actions in scrolling views

statement.en: Avoid setting a watchOS primary action in a list, scroll view, or vertical tab view.
statement.ja: list、scroll view、vertical tab viewにwatchOS primary actionを設定しない。

conditions: Preserve the double-tap navigation behavior people expect in these views.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0013.review_note: Recorded every conflicting view type and the double-tap navigation rationale.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0014.title: Choose the most-used watchOS button as the primary action

statement.en: In a nonscrolling watchOS view, choose the most commonly used button as the primary action.
statement.ja: scrollしないwatchOS viewでは最もよく使うbuttonをprimary actionにする。

conditions: For media controls, play and pause is a representative primary action.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0014.review_note: Recorded the nonscrolling condition, frequency criterion, and media example.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0015.title: Carefully consider complex custom visionOS gestures

statement.en: Carefully consider custom visionOS gestures that require multiple fingers or both hands.
statement.ja: 複数の指や両手を必要とするcustom visionOS gestureは慎重に検討する。

exceptions: When a complex gesture is required, consider an alternative that needs less movement.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0015.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded hand availability and the lower-movement alternative.

section_path: Working with system overlays in visionOS

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0016.title: Reserve hand-adjacent space for visionOS system overlays

statement.en: Reserve the area around a person’s hand for visionOS system overlays and their gestures.
statement.ja: 利用者の手の周囲をvisionOS system overlayとそのgesture用に確保する。

conditions: When possible, do not anchor content to hands or wrists.
Place necessary hand-anchored game content outside the immediate hand area and Home indicator.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0016.review_note: Recorded the reservation, preferred no-anchor behavior, and game placement exception.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0017.title: Indicate unavailable gestures clearly

statement.en: Clearly indicate when a gesture is unavailable and why it cannot complete.
statement.ja: gestureが利用できないことと完了できない理由を明確に示す。

conditions: Communicate locked-object and unavailable-control states so failure does not resemble a frozen app or incorrect gesture.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0017.review_note: Recorded both failure examples and the confusion the feedback must prevent.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0018.title: Avoid assuming a specific gesture is usable

statement.en: Avoid assuming every person can use a specific gesture for a task.
statement.ja: すべての利用者が特定のgestureでtaskを実行できると仮定しない。

conditions: Support alternatives such as voice, keyboard, or Switch Control.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0018.review_note: Recovered the explicit accessibility restriction as an atomic AVOID rule.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0019.title: Respond to gestures in familiar ways

statement.en: Respond to gestures in ways that remain consistent with familiar platform expectations.
statement.ja: gestureには使い慣れたplatformの期待と一貫する形で応答する。

conditions: For example, tap ordinarily activates or selects an object.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0019.review_note: Recovered the omitted lead and its representative tap behavior.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0020.title: Avoid familiar gestures for unique app actions

statement.en: Avoid assigning a familiar gesture such as tap or swipe to an app-unique action.
statement.ja: tapやswipeなど使い慣れたgestureをapp固有のactionに割り当てない。

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0020.review_note: Recovered the first expectation-conflict restriction as a separate AVOID rule.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0021.title: Avoid unique gestures for standard actions

statement.en: Avoid requiring an app-unique gesture for a standard action such as activation or scrolling.
statement.ja: activateやscrollなどstandard actionにapp固有のgestureを必須にしない。

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0021.review_note: Recovered the inverse expectation-conflict restriction as a separate AVOID rule.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0022.title: Provide predictive gesture feedback

statement.en: Provide feedback that helps people predict a gesture’s result and required movement.
statement.ja: gestureの結果と必要なmovementを予測できるfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: When needed, communicate both the extent and type of movement required to finish the action.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0022.review_note: Recovered the ongoing feedback requirement and both movement dimensions.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0023.title: Make custom gestures discoverable

statement.en: Make every custom gesture discoverable.
statement.ja: すべてのcustom gestureを発見可能にする。

conditions: The app implements a custom gesture.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0023.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure requirement from the custom-gesture checklist.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0024.title: Make custom gestures straightforward

statement.en: Make every custom gesture straightforward to perform.
statement.ja: すべてのcustom gestureを簡単に実行できるものにする。

conditions: The app implements a custom gesture.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0024.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure performance requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0025.title: Keep custom gestures distinct

statement.en: Make every custom gesture distinct from other gestures.
statement.ja: 各custom gestureを他のgestureと明確に区別できるものにする。

conditions: The app implements a custom gesture.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0025.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure distinctness requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0026.title: Provide alternatives to custom gestures for important actions

statement.en: Provide a noncustom-gesture way to perform every important action.
statement.ja: すべての重要なactionにcustom gesture以外の実行方法を提供する。

conditions: A custom gesture performs an important app or game action.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0026.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure alternative-path requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0027.title: Test custom gestures in real use

statement.en: Test custom-gesture interactions in real use scenarios.
statement.ja: custom gesture interactionを実際の利用scenarioでtestする。

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0027.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure testing requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0028.title: Support expected iOS and iPadOS gesture mappings

statement.en: Support the documented additional gesture mappings on iOS and iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSで記載された追加gesture mappingをsupportする。

conditions: Three-finger swipe performs undo or redo; three-finger pinch copies or pastes.
Four-finger swipe switches apps on iPadOS only; shake initiates undo or redo.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0028.review_note: Recovered a rule for the platform table and preserved all four gesture-action rows.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0029.title: Consider a custom visionOS gesture only for an unsupported interaction

statement.en: Consider a custom visionOS gesture only when no existing system gesture provides the interaction.
statement.ja: 既存のsystem gestureでinteractionを提供できない場合にだけcustom visionOS gestureを検討する。

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional consider clause and retained MAY.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0030.title: Run custom visionOS gestures only in a Full Space

statement.en: Run an interaction that requires a custom visionOS gesture only in a Full Space.
statement.ja: custom visionOS gestureが必要なinteractionはFull Space内だけで実行する。

conditions: The interaction cannot use an existing system gesture.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0030.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit app-needs-to-be-running platform prerequisite.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0031.title: Request permission before accessing hand information

statement.en: Request a person’s permission before accessing hand information for a custom visionOS gesture.
statement.ja: custom visionOS gesture用のhand informationへアクセスする前に利用者のpermissionを求める。

conditions: The app implements a custom visionOS gesture that uses hand information.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0031.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit must-request privacy requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0032.title: Support documented standard gesture mappings

statement.en: Support each standard gesture on its documented Apple platforms with its familiar action.
statement.ja: 各standard gestureを記載されたApple platformで使い慣れたactionとしてsupportする。

conditions: Tap activates or selects; swipe reveals, dismisses, or scrolls; drag moves a UI element.
Touch or pinch and hold reveals more controls; double tap zooms or performs the supported Apple Watch primary action.
Zoom magnifies content; rotate turns a selected item, on the platforms listed by the source table.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0032.review_note: Recovered a specification rule and preserved every standard gesture, platform scope, and common action row.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0033.title: Respond to gestures promptly

statement.en: Respond to gestures as promptly as possible.
statement.ja: gestureへ可能な限り迅速に応答する。

conditions: Immediate feedback supports direct manipulation.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0033.review_note: Recovered the omitted responsiveness lead separately from predictive feedback.

HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0034.title: Use custom gestures only when necessary

statement.en: Use a custom gesture only when a frequent specialized task lacks an existing gesture.
statement.ja: 既存gestureで対応できない頻繁なspecialized taskにだけcustom gestureを使う。

conditions: Games and drawing apps are representative specialized contexts.
HIG-INPUTS-GESTURES-0034.review_note: Recovered the omitted necessity lead and preserved its frequency and no-existing-gesture tests.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0001.title: Avoid moving focus without user interaction

statement.en: Avoid changing focus without a person’s interaction.
statement.ja: 利用者の操作なしにfocusを変更しない。

conditions: Preserve a predictable focus location so people can continue their current task.
exceptions: When directional input is moving focus and the focused item disappears, move focus one discrete step to a nearby remaining item.
Without directional input, hide the focus indicator when its focused object disappears.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0001.review_note: Preserved the default prohibition and both disappearance behaviors for directional and nondirectional input.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0002.title: Match focus behavior to each platform

statement.en: Match focus navigation and focusable elements to each platform’s interaction model.
statement.ja: focus navigationとfocus可能なelementを各platformのinteraction modelに合わせる。

conditions: On iPadOS and macOS, support focus for content elements while Full Keyboard Access reaches controls.
On tvOS, directional input is the primary navigation model.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0002.review_note: Separated platform-consistent behavior from the explicit all-elements tvOS requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0003.title: Make custom iPadOS focus traversal predictable

statement.en: Make focus move through custom iPadOS views in a predictable order.
statement.ja: custom iPadOS view間でfocusが予測可能な順序で移動するようにする。

conditions: Default focus-group traversal follows reading order: leading to trailing, then top to bottom.
Identify a vertical custom-view stack as one focus group when focus should traverse it before moving trailing.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0003.review_note: Retained MUST and recorded the default reading order plus the custom vertical-stack technique.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0004.title: Avoid pointers for tvOS interface navigation

statement.en: Avoid using a pointer to navigate tvOS menus and interface elements.
statement.ja: tvOSのmenuやinterface elementのnavigationにpointerを使わない。

conditions: Use the focus model for a fixed set of navigable interface items.
exceptions: Free-form movement can be appropriate during gameplay.
If a pointer is required, apply the separate visibility and integration requirement.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0004.review_note: Narrowed the AVOID rule to interface navigation and preserved gameplay and required-pointer exceptions.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0005.title: Design for every tvOS focus state

statement.en: Design tvOS focusable items for their distinct unfocused, focused, chosen, selected, and unavailable states.
statement.ja: tvOSのfocus可能な項目をunfocused、focused、chosen、selected、unavailableの各状態に合わせて設計する。

conditions: Focused items stand out through foreground elevation, illumination, and animation.
Chosen items provide immediate visual feedback before the selected appearance.
Selected items communicate activation; unavailable items appear inactive.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0005.review_note: Preserved all five table states and their distinct visual purposes.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0006.title: Match focus indication to the content type

statement.en: Use a focus ring for text or search fields and a highlight for lists or collections.
statement.ja: text fieldやsearch fieldにはfocus ring、listやcollectionにはhighlightを使う。

exceptions: A focus ring can suit an item such as a photo that fills a collection cell.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0006.review_note: Recorded both default visual treatments and the cell-filling-content exception.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0007.title: Use platform-consistent focus appearances

statement.en: Indicate focus with visual appearances that are consistent with the platform.
statement.ja: platformと一貫したvisual appearanceでfocusを示す。

conditions: On iPadOS and macOS, focused list items use white text and the app accent color; unfocused highlights use standard text color and gray.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0007.review_note: Recorded the platform-consistency goal and the official list-item appearance example.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0008.title: Rely on system focus effects

statement.en: Rely on system-provided focus effects for responsive and predictable platform behavior.
statement.ja: responsiveで予測可能なplatform動作のためsystem提供のfocus effectを利用する。

exceptions: Consider a custom focus effect only when it is absolutely necessary.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0008.review_note: Recorded the system-effect rationale and the narrow optional custom-effect exception.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0009.title: Make every tvOS interface element focusable

statement.en: Make every onscreen tvOS interface element reachable through focus navigation.
statement.ja: 画面上のすべてのtvOS interface elementへfocus navigationで到達できるようにする。

conditions: People use directional remote, game-controller, or keyboard input to reach onscreen elements.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0009.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure requirement, with tvOS-only scope and all stated input methods.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0010.title: Customize an iPadOS halo only when necessary

statement.en: Customize an iPadOS halo focus effect only when the system-provided result is insufficient.
statement.ja: system提供の結果で不十分な場合にだけiPadOSのhalo focus effectをcustomizeする。

conditions: Refine the halo to match contours such as rounded corners or Bézier paths.
Adjust its position when another component occludes or clips it.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0010.review_note: Recovered the omitted actionable lead and preserved its necessity gate and two customization purposes.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0011.title: Use focus priority to reflect item importance

statement.en: Use iPadOS focus priority to reflect an item’s importance within its focus group.
statement.ja: iPadOSのfocus priorityでfocus group内の項目の重要度を表す。

conditions: Increasing an item’s priority makes it the primary item that receives focus when the group does.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0011.review_note: Recovered the priority lead and recorded the automatic primary-item behavior.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0012.title: Use full-screen tvOS gestures for content interaction

statement.en: In a full-screen tvOS experience, let gestures interact with content instead of moving focus.
statement.ja: full-screenのtvOS体験ではgestureをfocus移動ではなくcontent操作に使う。

conditions: A full-screen item does not display focus, so people expect gestures to affect the object.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0012.review_note: Recovered the full-screen gesture behavior and its no-visible-focus rationale.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0013.title: Make a required tvOS pointer visible and integrated

statement.en: When a tvOS app requires a pointer, make it highly visible and integrated with the experience.
statement.ja: tvOS appにpointerが必要な場合は、見やすく体験に統合されたものにする。

conditions: The app requires a pointer despite the default focus-model guidance.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0013.review_note: Recovered and retained the conditional make sure requirement within the pointer exception.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0014.title: Supply sharp assets for enlarged tvOS focus

statement.en: Supply assets that remain sharp at the larger size used for focused tvOS items.
statement.ja: focusされたtvOS項目の拡大サイズでも鮮明さを保つassetを用意する。

conditions: The focus effect increases the item’s scale.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0014.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit need requirement for larger focused-size assets.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0015.title: Prevent enlarged focused items from crowding tvOS interfaces

statement.en: Prevent an enlarged focused tvOS item from crowding the surrounding interface.
statement.ja: focusで拡大したtvOS項目が周囲のinterfaceを圧迫しないようにする。

conditions: The focus effect increases the item’s scale.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0015.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit make sure spacing requirement for enlarged focus.

HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0016.title: Use hover effects for visionOS gaze feedback

statement.en: Use hover effects, not focus effects, to provide feedback for visionOS gaze targeting.
statement.ja: visionOSのgaze targeting feedbackにはfocus effectではなくhover effectを使う。

conditions: The system treats gaze-based object identification separately from the focus system.
HIG-INPUTS-FOCUS-AND-SELECTION-0016.review_note: Recovered the visionOS platform distinction documented in the page note.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0001.title: Offer alternatives to eye-based interaction

statement.en: Give people multiple ways to interact with the app, including alternatives to using their eyes.
statement.ja: 視線以外の方法を含め、アプリを操作する複数の方法を提供する。

conditions: Support people who cannot use their eyes to interact.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0001.review_note: Retained the accessibility-critical Always requirement and made the alternative-input purpose explicit.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0002.title: Design visionOS content for visual comfort

statement.en: Design visionOS content placement and viewing transitions for visual comfort.
statement.ja: visionOSのコンテンツ配置と視線移動を視覚的な快適さに配慮して設計する。

conditions: Review both angular distance across the field of view and depth changes.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0002.review_note: Replaced the generic statement with the page's placement and eye-adjustment comfort context.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0003.title: Place sustained visionOS content at a comfortable distance

statement.en: Aim to place visionOS content people view for sustained periods at least 1 meter away.
statement.ja: 長時間見るvisionOSコンテンツは1メートル以上離して配置することを目指す。

conditions: The content remains visible for a sustained period.
exceptions: Closer content can be appropriate for brief viewing.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0003.review_note: Preserved the 1-meter aim and the brief-viewing exception without promoting the aim to MUST.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0004.title: Prefer standard visionOS components for gaze interaction

statement.en: Prefer standard visionOS components that provide familiar gaze and hover behavior.
statement.ja: 使い慣れた視線とhoverの動作を提供する標準visionOSコンポーネントを優先する。

conditions: Use consistent system-provided hover feedback to communicate interactivity.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0004.review_note: Recorded the consistent gaze response that supports the standard-component preference.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0005.title: Minimize peripheral visual distractions

statement.en: Minimize visual noise and movement, especially in peripheral vision.
statement.ja: 特に周辺視野での視覚的なノイズや動きを最小限にする。

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0005.review_note: Recorded both noise and motion plus the heightened peripheral-vision concern.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0006.title: Space visionOS items for comfortable gaze selection

statement.en: Provide enough space around visionOS items for comfortable gaze selection.
statement.ja: 快適に視線選択できるよう、visionOSの項目周囲に十分な間隔を設ける。

conditions: Use at least 16 points between item edges or at least 60 points between item centers as documented spacing targets.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0006.review_note: Preserved both alternative spacing measurements and their gaze-selection purpose.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0007.title: Avoid full-field repeating patterns in visionOS

statement.en: Avoid filling a person’s field of view with a repeating pattern or texture.
statement.ja: 反復するパターンやテクスチャで利用者の視野全体を埋めない。

exceptions: Offer an option that confines the pattern or texture to a smaller area.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0007.review_note: Recorded the full-field comfort risk and the smaller-area alternative.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0008.title: Consider subtle cues for likely gaze targets

statement.en: Consider subtle visual cues that draw attention to the item people are most likely to want.
statement.ja: 利用者が最も必要としそうな項目へ注意を導く、控えめな視覚的手がかりを検討する。

conditions: Possible cues include central placement, gentle motion, contrast, color, or scale.
Keep cues noticeable without making them flashy or harsh.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0008.review_note: Retained MAY while preserving the cue options and visual-comfort limits.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0009.title: Reserve custom hover effects for special moments

statement.en: Prefer custom hover effects for emphasizing or enhancing special moments.
statement.ja: 特別な場面を強調または高めるためにカスタムhover effectを優先して使う。

conditions: Too many custom hover effects can dilute emphasis, distract, or cause discomfort.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0009.review_note: Recorded the special-moment purpose and all overuse risks.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0010.title: Choose a custom-hover delay that matches its purpose

statement.en: Choose a custom-hover delay that matches the interaction and information it presents.
statement.ja: 操作と提示情報に合うカスタムhoverのdelayを選ぶ。

conditions: Use no delay for subtle effects that invite interaction.
Use a short delay for quick interactions that should not require waiting.
Use a long delay for extra information such as tooltips.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0010.review_note: Preserved all three official delay-to-purpose mappings.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0011.title: Keep a primary view stable across custom-hover states

statement.en: Keep at least one primary element view unchanged across custom-hover states.
statement.ja: カスタムhoverの状態間で、少なくとも1つの主要なelement viewを変えずに保つ。

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0011.review_note: Recorded the visual anchor that preserves recognition between states.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0012.title: Rely on tap events instead of pre-tap gaze data

statement.en: Rely on system-reported tap events instead of direct pre-tap gaze information.
statement.ja: tap前の直接的な視線情報ではなく、systemが報告するtap eventを利用する。

conditions: visionOS does not provide apps with gaze location before a person taps.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0012.review_note: Recovered the privacy boundary and the system tap-event interaction model.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0013.title: Keep primary-task objects within the field of view

statement.en: Keep objects people need for their primary task within their field of view.
statement.ja: 主要タスクに必要なobjectを利用者の視野内に保つ。

conditions: In a Full Space, request head-pose permission only when the experience needs to place content relative to the field of view.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0013.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure requirement while preserving the Full Space permission condition.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0014.title: Avoid rapid eye adjustments across area or depth

statement.en: Avoid requiring multiple rapid eye adjustments across a large area or between depths.
statement.ja: 広い範囲や異なるdepth間で、視線を何度も素早く調整させない。

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0014.review_note: Recovered the two distinct spatial dimensions of the visual-comfort restriction.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0015.title: Use rounded shapes for interactive items

statement.en: In general, give interactive visionOS items rounded shapes.
statement.ja: 原則として、interactiveなvisionOS項目にはrounded shapeを使う。

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0015.review_note: Recovered the general rounded-shape affordance without making it unconditional.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0016.title: Highlight multi-element components as a whole

statement.en: Provide an overall containing shape or custom hover region that highlights an entire multi-element component.
statement.ja: 複数elementのcomponent全体をhighlightする、overall containing shapeまたはcustom hover regionを提供する。

conditions: The interactive component consists of more than one element.
HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0016.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure requirement plus both supported highlight techniques.

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0017.title: Test custom hover effects while wearing Apple Vision Pro

statement.en: Test custom hover effects thoroughly while wearing Apple Vision Pro.
statement.ja: Apple Vision Proを装着してカスタムhover effectを十分にテストする。

HIG-INPUTS-EYES-0017.review_note: Recovered the device-on testing context that the truncated candidate omitted.

conditions: When marking uses Apple Pencil, let controls respond to Apple Pencil so people need not switch to a finger.
exceptions: Scribble supports Apple Pencil input only.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.review_note: Recorded control activation and the Scribble input exception.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.title: Let people mark immediately when Apple Pencil touches the screen

statement.en: Let people mark immediately when Apple Pencil touches the screen.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilが画面に触れた瞬間に書き始められるようにする。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.review_note: Repaired the statement while the pre-mode avoidance is represented separately.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.title: Respond to Apple Pencil marking characteristics

statement.en: Respond to Apple Pencil tilt, pressure, orientation, and barrel roll in intuitive marking behavior.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilの傾き、筆圧、向き、barrel rollを直感的な描画動作へ反映する。

conditions: Use pressure for continuous properties such as ink opacity or brush size.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.review_note: Replaced the generic statement with the complete sensor and stroke context.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.title: Show a direct connection between Apple Pencil and content

statement.en: Provide visual feedback that directly connects Apple Pencil with touched content.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilと触れたコンテンツの直接的なつながりを視覚フィードバックで示す。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.review_note: Clarified the visual-feedback outcome; immediate manipulation and disconnected actions are separate rules.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.title: Support both left- and right-handed Apple Pencil use

statement.en: Support comfortable Apple Pencil use with either hand.
statement.ja: 左右どちらの手でもApple Pencilを快適に使えるようにする。

exceptions: When controls may become obscured, consider letting people reposition them.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded the optional repositioning response.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.title: Use Apple Pencil hover to preview the resulting mark

statement.en: Use Apple Pencil hover to preview the mark that touching the screen will create.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilのhoverで、画面に触れたときに作られる線をプレビューする。

conditions: A preview can show the current tool’s mark dimensions and color.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.review_note: Recorded the mark-prediction purpose and preview contents.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.title: Preview a middle value for dynamic Apple Pencil properties

statement.en: Prefer a middle value when previewing a range of dynamic Apple Pencil properties.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilの動的プロパティ範囲をプレビューするときは中間値を優先する。

conditions: Maximum values can obscure the marking area; minimum values can be difficult to detect.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-000.review_note: Recorded both endpoint failures that justify a middle preview value.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.title: Respect applicable system double-tap settings

statement.en: Respect people’s system double-tap settings when they apply to the app.
statement.ja: アプリに適用できる場合はシステムのdouble tap設定を尊重する。

conditions: Supported settings include current tool and eraser, current and previous tool, color picker visibility, and no action.
exceptions: When systemwide settings do not fit, double tap can change an app-specific interaction mode.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Recorded every default behavior and the app-specific mode exception.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.title: Let people choose custom double-tap behavior

statement.en: When custom double-tap behavior is necessary, let people select its mode.
