statement.ja: カスタムdouble tap動作が必要な場合は、そのモードを利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: People need a clear indication of the current custom behavior mode.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Recorded the selection control and current-mode visibility requirement.

conditions: Prefer double-tap actions that are easy to undo.
Avoid potentially destructive double-tap actions that can cause data loss.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Recorded accidental activation, undoability, and the destructive-action restriction.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.title: Treat squeeze as a quick, discrete action

statement.en: Treat squeeze as one quick gesture that performs a discrete, noncontinuous action.
statement.ja: squeezeを、離散的で連続しない操作を行う1回の短いジェスチャとして扱う。

conditions: Respond to one squeeze and display its result promptly to reduce fatigue.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded fatigue and feedback timing.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.title: Use barrel roll only for marking behavior

statement.en: Use barrel roll only to modify marking behavior, not for navigation or other controls.
statement.ja: barrel rollは描画動作の変更だけに使い、ナビゲーションや他のコントロールには使わない。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Preserved the only and not restrictions at SHOULD without promoting them to MUST.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.title: Make Scribble text entry fluid and effortless

statement.en: Make Scribble text entry fluid and effortless.
statement.ja: Scribbleによるテキスト入力を滑らかで負担のないものにする。

conditions: Scribble works by default in standard text fields, text views, search fields, and editable web fields.
exceptions: Password fields are excluded from the standard-component default.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Recorded supported standard components and the password-field exception.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.title: Make Scribble available wherever text entry feels natural

statement.en: Make Scribble available wherever people naturally expect to enter text.
statement.ja: 自然にテキスト入力を期待する場所ではScribbleを使えるようにする。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and preserved the natural text-entry test.

conditions: Avoid autocompletion text that visually interferes with handwriting.
Hide placeholder text when writing begins to prevent overlap.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-001.review_note: Recorded the autocompletion and placeholder techniques for distraction-free writing.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.title: Give Apple Pencil handwriting enough text-field space

statement.en: Give Apple Pencil handwriting enough text-field space.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilの手書き入力に十分なテキストフィールド領域を確保する。

conditions: Increase field size before writing begins or after writing pauses.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Recorded safe resize timing; resizing during writing is a separate AVOID rule.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.title: Preserve markup visibility over existing content

statement.en: Keep PencilKit markup sharp and visible over existing content.
statement.ja: 既存コンテンツ上のPencilKitマークアップを鮮明で見やすく保つ。

conditions: For PDFs and photos, prevent Dark Mode from dynamically adjusting markup colors.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Replaced the generic statement with the existing-content color behavior.

conditions: The compact tool picker omits undo and redo buttons.
exceptions: Consider also supporting the standard three-finger undo and redo gesture in every environment.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the compact-only gap and cross-environment gesture option.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.title: Keep squeeze actions nondestructive and undoable

statement.en: Keep squeeze actions nondestructive and easy to undo.
statement.ja: squeeze操作を非破壊的で取り消しやすくする。

conditions: Account for unintended squeeze gestures and avoid actions that can cause data loss.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Repaired the generated statement and recorded the accidental-input risk.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.title: Make marking controls respond to Apple Pencil

statement.en: When marking uses Apple Pencil, make the app’s controls respond to Apple Pencil.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilで描画する場合は、アプリのコントロールもApple Pencilに応答させる。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure requirement that prevents an apparent malfunction.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.title: Avoid requiring a button tap or special mode before marking

statement.en: Avoid requiring a button tap or special mode before people can mark with Apple Pencil.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilで描き始める前にボタン操作や特別なモードを求めない。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Recovered the pre-mark mode restriction at conservative AVOID strength.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.title: Make Apple Pencil manipulate touched content directly and immediately

statement.en: Make Apple Pencil manipulate touched content directly and immediately.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilで触れたコンテンツを直接かつ即座に操作できるようにする。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure direct-manipulation requirement.

statement.en: Avoid making Apple Pencil initiate disconnected actions or affect untouched screen content.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilで無関係な操作を始めたり、触れていない画面内容へ影響したりしない。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Recovered both disconnected-action cases at AVOID.

statement.en: Avoid placing controls where either hand can obscure them.
statement.ja: 左右どちらの手でも隠れる可能性がある位置にコントロールを置かない。

exceptions: When obscuring remains possible, consider letting people reposition controls.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Recovered the handedness layout restriction and repositioning option.

statement.en: Wherever practicable, avoid continuously changing hover previews with Apple Pencil height.
statement.ja: 可能な限りApple Pencilの高さに応じてhoverプレビューを連続変化させない。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-002.review_note: Recovered the height-driven preview restriction and preserved its practicability qualifier.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.title: Make custom double-tap behavior easy to discover

statement.en: Make custom double-tap behavior easy to discover.
statement.ja: カスタムdouble tap動作を見つけやすくする。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure discoverability requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.title: Avoid enabling custom double-tap behavior by default

statement.en: Avoid enabling custom double-tap behavior by default.
statement.ja: カスタムdouble tap動作を既定で有効にしない。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.review_note: Recovered the explicit don’t clause at the repository’s conservative AVOID strength.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.title: Display squeeze-revealed UI near Apple Pencil Pro

statement.en: Display squeeze-revealed app UI near the tip of Apple Pencil Pro.
statement.ja: squeezeで表示するアプリUIをApple Pencil Proの先端付近に配置する。

conditions: The squeeze gesture reveals app UI such as a contextual menu.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.review_note: Recovered the contextual display guidance and its device-to-result connection.

statement.en: Avoid requiring people to tap or select a custom text field before handwriting begins.
statement.ja: 手書き開始前にカスタムテキストフィールドのタップや選択を求めない。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.title: Keep text fields stationary during Apple Pencil writing

statement.en: Keep a text field stationary while people write in it with Apple Pencil.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilで書いている間はテキストフィールドを動かさない。

exceptions: When movement or resizing cannot be prevented, consider delaying it until writing pauses.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure stationary-field requirement and its pause-time fallback.

statement.en: Avoid resizing text fields while people write with Apple Pencil.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilで書いている間はテキストフィールドのサイズを変更しない。

exceptions: Resize before writing begins or after writing pauses.
HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.review_note: Recovered the during-writing resize restriction and safe timing.

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.title: Prevent autoscrolling during Apple Pencil writing and editing

statement.en: Prevent text from autoscrolling while people write or edit with Apple Pencil.
statement.ja: Apple Pencilで書いたり編集したりしている間はテキストの自動スクロールを防ぐ。

HIG-INPUTS-APPLE-PENCIL-AND-SCRIBBLE-003.review_note: Recovered the autoscroll restriction and kept it at AVOID rather than promoting the imperative to MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Consider the minimum immersion needed for each distinctive moment

statement.en: For each distinctive app moment, consider the minimum suitable level of immersion.
statement.ja: アプリの特徴的な各場面では、適切な最小限の没入度を検討する。

conditions: Evaluate windowed, fully immersive, and intermediate presentation styles.
exceptions: Do not assume every distinctive moment needs full immersion.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Retained MAY and preserved the minimum-immersion test and full-immersion caution.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Use standard windows for contained visionOS tasks

statement.en: Use standard windows for contained, UI-centric visionOS tasks.
statement.ja: 完結したUI中心のvisionOSタスクには標準ウインドウを使う。

conditions: Prefer familiar controls for standard tasks.
Let system dynamic scaling preserve legibility as people relocate windows.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Recorded the standard-task context, familiar controls, relocation, and dynamic scaling.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Prioritize comfort in visionOS experiences

statement.en: Prioritize visual and physical comfort in visionOS apps and games.
statement.ja: visionOSのアプリやゲームでは視覚的・身体的な快適さを優先する。

conditions: Review field of view, motion, indirect gestures, direct-gesture duration, and movement in full immersion.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and linked it to every documented comfort fundamental.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Use SharePlay for shared spatial activities

statement.en: Use SharePlay to help people share spatial activities with others.
statement.ja: SharePlayを使い、他の人と空間アクティビティを共有できるようにする。

conditions: Spatial Personas can make remote participants feel present in the same space.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded SharePlay and spatial Personas as the documented mechanism.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Keep visionOS content within the field of view

statement.en: Keep visionOS content within the person’s field of view and position it relative to their head.
statement.ja: visionOSコンテンツを利用者の視野内に保ち、頭部を基準に配置する。

conditions: Apply while preserving a comfortable, physically relaxed interaction posture.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Narrowed the mixed generated rule to the positive field-of-view placement guidance; the avoidance clause is separate.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Avoid uncomfortable visionOS motion

statement.en: Avoid visionOS motion that is overwhelming, jarring, too fast, or lacks a stationary reference.
statement.ja: 圧倒的、急激、高速、または静止基準のないvisionOSの動きを避ける。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Preserved every documented motion-comfort qualifier at AVOID.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Support indirect visionOS gestures from a resting posture

statement.en: Support indirect visionOS gestures while people’s hands rest in their lap or at their sides.
statement.ja: 手を膝上または体の横で休めたまま使えるvisionOSの間接ジェスチャに対応する。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Restored the complete resting-posture condition lost by the evidence-fragment limit.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Avoid excessive movement in fully immersive visionOS experiences

statement.en: Avoid encouraging excessive physical movement during fully immersive visionOS experiences.
statement.ja: 完全没入型のvisionOS体験では過度な身体移動を促さない。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Preserved the fully immersive condition and conservative AVOID strength.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Prioritize Apple Vision Pro user safety

statement.en: Prioritize user safety when designing for Apple Vision Pro.
statement.ja: Apple Vision Pro向けの設計では利用者の安全を優先する。

conditions: Account for the device’s unique spatial-computing characteristics.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Recovered the Important safety guidance as a high-confidence SHOULD without overstating its wording.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Avoid Apple Vision Pro use while operating vehicles or heavy machinery

statement.en: Avoid using Apple Vision Pro while operating a vehicle or heavy machinery.
statement.ja: 車両や重機の操作中はApple Vision Proを使用しない。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Recovered the safety warning and kept AVOID because the source says should not rather than an explicit Must not or Never.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Avoid Apple Vision Pro use while moving through unsafe environments

statement.en: Avoid using Apple Vision Pro while moving through unsafe environments.
statement.ja: 危険な環境を移動中はApple Vision Proを使用しない。

conditions: Examples include balconies, streets, stairs, and other potential hazards.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Recovered the unsafe-environment warning and preserved its examples at AVOID.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Limit Apple Vision Pro fitting and use to people aged 13 or older

statement.en: Limit Apple Vision Pro fitting and use to people aged 13 or older.
statement.ja: Apple Vision Proの装着と使用は13歳以上の人を対象にする。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Recovered the age restriction as a high-confidence SHOULD; did not promote descriptive source wording to MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Use Apple Vision Pro’s unique spatial features

statement.en: Use Apple Vision Pro’s space, Spatial Audio, immersion, passthrough, and spatial input features.
statement.ja: Apple Vision Proの空間、Spatial Audio、没入、パススルー、空間入力を活用する。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Recovered the omitted platform-feature lead and preserved every named feature.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Avoid interactions that require head turns or position changes

statement.en: Avoid placing visionOS content where interaction requires head turns or position changes.
statement.ja: 頭を回したり姿勢を変えたりしないと操作できない位置へvisionOSコンテンツを置かない。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Split the avoidance clause from the mixed field-of-view rule to preserve atomic strength.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.title: Keep direct-gesture content nearby and interaction brief

statement.en: When supporting direct gestures, keep interactive content nearby and interaction periods brief.
statement.ja: 直接ジェスチャに対応する場合は、操作対象を近くに置き、操作時間を短く保つ。

conditions: The visionOS experience supports direct gestures.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-VISION.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure requirement and preserved both distance and duration constraints.

conditions: Choose defaults using device resolution, paired accessories, controllers, and the player’s accessibility settings.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recorded the device and accessibility inputs used to choose game defaults.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Defer game requests until the relevant moment

statement.en: Defer game requests until the context that needs them.
statement.ja: ゲーム内の要求は、それを必要とする文脈まで延期する。

conditions: Avoid presenting many requests before gameplay begins.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the generated statement and recorded the request-timing context.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Keep game text legible on every supported display

statement.en: Keep game text legible on every supported display.
statement.ja: 対応するすべてのディスプレイでゲーム内テキストを判読可能に保つ。

conditions: Maintain sufficient contrast with the background.
Use at least 11 pt on iOS and iPadOS, 10 pt on macOS, 23 pt on tvOS, and 12 pt on visionOS and watchOS.
The documented default sizes are 17, 13, 29, 17, and 16 pt respectively.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Retained MUST and preserved the platform text-size table plus contrast requirement.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Keep game buttons easy to use on every supported platform

statement.en: Keep game buttons easy to use on every supported platform.
statement.ja: 対応するすべてのプラットフォームでゲームボタンを使いやすく保つ。

conditions: Default/minimum button sizes are iOS and iPadOS 44x44/28x28 pt, macOS 28x28/20x20 pt, tvOS 66x66/56x56 pt, visionOS 60x60/28x28 pt, and watchOS 44x44/28x28 pt.
The supporting paragraph says iOS touch buttons must be at least 44x44 pt.
exceptions: The table also labels 28x28 pt as the iOS and iPadOS minimum; verify the applicable component guidance before using the smaller value.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Retained MUST, preserved every table value, and surfaced the page’s unresolved iOS 44-point versus 28-point wording.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Prefer resolution-independent game graphics

statement.en: Prefer resolution-independent game textures and graphics.
statement.ja: 解像度に依存しないゲーム用テクスチャとグラフィックを優先する。

conditions: In visionOS, prefer vector art that remains clear as the system changes its scale.
exceptions: When resolution-independent assets are impossible, match the game resolution to the device resolution.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recorded the device-resolution fallback and visionOS vector-art preference.

conditions: Support aspect ratios such as 16:10, 19.5:9, and 4:3.
Keep menus legible, usable, and clear of other content on every device and supported iPhone or iPad orientation.
Prefer dynamic layouts with relative constraints.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Retained MUST and recorded aspect ratios, orientations, unobscured content, and dynamic-layout guidance.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Design games for a full-screen experience

statement.en: Design games for a distraction-free, full-screen experience.
statement.ja: ゲームを集中しやすいフルスクリーン体験向けに設計する。

conditions: Account for full-screen mode on macOS, iOS, and iPadOS and Full Space on visionOS.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the generated statement and recorded the platform-specific full-screen contexts.

conditions: Use touch by default on iOS and iPadOS; keyboard, mouse, or trackpad on macOS; remote on tvOS; eyes and hands on visionOS; and touch on watchOS.
Review control sizing and menu behavior when moving from pointer input to touch input.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recorded each platform’s default interactions, additional controller support, and pointer-to-touch review focus.

conditions: Physical game controllers are supported on every listed platform except watchOS.
Offer alternative interactions because not every player can use a physical controller.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recorded controller availability and the accessibility reason for alternatives.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Offer touchscreen-native controls on iPhone and iPad

statement.en: Offer touchscreen-native game controls on iPhone and iPad.
statement.ja: iPhoneとiPadではタッチスクリーンに適したゲーム操作を提供する。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Corrected the scope from every Apple platform to iOS and iPadOS.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Prioritize game-content perceivability

statement.en: Prioritize perceivability throughout game content.
statement.ja: ゲーム内容全体で知覚可能性を優先する。

conditions: Do not rely on color alone for important details.
Provide descriptive subtitles or another readable form for cutscenes.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded the color and cutscene examples.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Let players personalize accessibility-related game settings

statement.en: Let players personalize game settings that affect their abilities and preferences.
statement.ja: 能力や好みに影響するゲーム設定をプレイヤーが調整できるようにする。

conditions: Include type size, control mapping, motion intensity, and sound balance.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and preserved all documented personalization examples.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Give players inclusive self-representation tools

statement.en: Give players inclusive tools to represent themselves.
statement.ja: プレイヤーが自分自身を包括的に表現できる手段を提供する。

conditions: When players create avatars, names, or descriptions, support a spectrum of identities and human characteristics.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded the avatar, name, and description context.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Avoid stereotypes and bias in game stories and characters

statement.en: Avoid stereotypes and bias in game stories, characters, and scenarios.
statement.ja: ゲームの物語、キャラクター、状況設定で固定観念や偏見を避ける。

conditions: Review portrayals involving race, gender, and cultural heritage and remove discovered bias.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Expanded the reviewed AVOID rule to the documented character and scenario review context.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Let players continue a game on another device

statement.en: Let players continue a saved game on another Apple device.
statement.ja: 保存したゲームを別のAppleデバイスで続けられるようにする。

conditions: Use GameSave to preserve game state for a player’s iCloud account.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded the GameSave mechanism.

statement.en: Use haptics to help players feel game action.
statement.ja: ハプティクスを使い、プレイヤーがゲーム内の動きを感じられるようにする。

conditions: Core Haptics is available on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS and on many game controllers.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Corrected the scope to the platforms where the source says Core Haptics is available.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Use Spatial Audio to immerse players

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to immerse players in the game’s soundscape where supported.
statement.ja: 対応環境ではSpatial Audioを使い、プレイヤーをゲームの音響空間へ没入させる。

conditions: Provide multichannel audio that can adapt automatically to the current device.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired capitalization and recorded the multichannel-audio condition.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Accommodate device features in game layouts

statement.en: Accommodate device features such as rounded corners and camera housings in game layouts.
statement.ja: 角の丸みやカメラ領域などのデバイス特性をゲームレイアウトで考慮する。

conditions: Rely on platform-provided safe areas when possible.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the generated statement and recorded the safe-area technique.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Integrate Game Center for discovery and social connection

statement.en: Integrate Game Center for cross-device discovery, progress, achievements, and social play.
statement.ja: 複数デバイスでの発見、進行状況、実績、ソーシャルプレイにGame Centerを統合する。

conditions: Game Center is available on every listed Apple platform.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired capitalization and summarized the documented Game Center capabilities.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Use Apple technologies for distinctive gameplay

statement.en: Use Apple technologies to enable distinctive gameplay mechanics.
statement.ja: Appleのテクノロジーを使って特徴的なゲームプレイを実現する。

conditions: Examples include augmented reality, machine learning, HealthKit, location, camera, and microphone.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Repaired the incomplete generated statement and preserved the technology examples.

statement.en: Keep the initial game download to 30 minutes or less.
statement.ja: ゲームの初回ダウンロードを30分以内に保つ。

conditions: Include as much playable content as practical in the initial installation.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the omitted initial-download duration and playable-content condition.

statement.en: Download additional game content in the background.
statement.ja: 追加のゲームコンテンツをバックグラウンドでダウンロードする。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the omitted background-download guidance.

statement.en: Support the platform’s most common interaction methods.
statement.ja: プラットフォームで最も一般的な操作方法に対応する。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure interaction requirement.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Teach game mechanics through play

statement.en: Teach game mechanics through play.
statement.ja: ゲームの仕組みをプレイを通じて教える。

conditions: Integrate configuration and onboarding into a playable tutorial when it fits the game.
exceptions: A written tutorial can be an optional reference instead of a gameplay prerequisite.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the omitted section lead and recorded the optional written-reference alternative.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Get permission before accessing sensors or personal data

statement.en: Get the player’s permission before accessing sensors or personal data.
statement.ja: センサーや個人データへアクセスする前にプレイヤーの許可を得る。

conditions: The game uses device sensors or personalizes play with data such as hand tracking.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the explicit You must privacy requirement and its data-access condition.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Place permission requests in the scenario that needs the data

statement.en: Place a permission request in the game scenario that needs the data.
statement.ja: 権限要求を、そのデータを必要とするゲーム場面で提示する。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the omitted contextual permission-request guidance.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Wait for meaningful play before requesting a rating or review

statement.en: Wait until players have meaningful time with the game before requesting a rating or review.
statement.ja: 評価やレビューを求める前に、プレイヤーがゲームを十分体験するまで待つ。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure rating-request timing requirement.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Avoid fixed in-game menu layouts

statement.en: Avoid fixed in-game menu layouts wherever practicable.
statement.ja: 可能な限り固定式のゲーム内メニューレイアウトを避ける。

conditions: Prefer dynamic layouts that use relative constraints.
exceptions: Create a custom device-specific layout only when necessary.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the fixed-layout AVOID guidance and preserved its practicability qualifier and exception.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Make game content perceivable through sight, hearing, or touch

statement.en: Make game content perceivable through sight, hearing, or touch.
statement.ja: 視覚、聴覚、触覚のいずれを使う場合もゲーム内容を知覚できるようにする。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure accessibility requirement and removed the incorrect touch-input modality inference.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.title: Ensure necessary cultural and language references are respectful

statement.en: When cultural or language references are necessary, ensure they are respectful.
statement.ja: 文化や言語への参照が必要な場合は、敬意ある表現にする。

conditions: The game needs references to real-life cultures or languages.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-GAMES-.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure inclusion requirement and preserved its necessity condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0001.title: Support platform-appropriate text and icon enlargement

statement.en: Let people enlarge text and icons using Dynamic Type or an equivalent custom control.
statement.ja: Dynamic Typeまたは同等のカスタム操作により、テキストやアイコンを拡大できるようにする。

conditions: Support enlargement to at least 200 percent on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS where the source guidance applies.
Support enlargement to at least 140 percent in watchOS apps.
Verify legibility, visibility, and reading comfort at enlarged sizes.

automated: Run UI tests at the platform's largest supported text setting and detect clipped, truncated, or overlapping essential content.
Verify that the supported enlargement range reaches the source-scoped percentage for the target platform.
manual: Can people enlarge text and icons to the source-scoped target without losing essential content or actions?

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0001.review_note: Recorded the platform-specific enlargement targets from the official Vision guidance.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0002.title: Use platform defaults and minimums for custom type sizes

statement.en: When using custom type styles, follow the target platform's recommended default and minimum sizes.
statement.ja: カスタム書体スタイルを使う場合は、対象プラットフォームの推奨デフォルトサイズと最小サイズに従う。

conditions: iOS and iPadOS: use 17 pt by default and do not go below 11 pt.
macOS: use 13 pt by default and do not go below 10 pt.
tvOS: use 29 pt by default and do not go below 23 pt.
visionOS: use 17 pt by default and do not go below 12 pt.
watchOS: use 16 pt by default and do not go below 12 pt.

automated: Compare custom type-style defaults and minimums with the source-scoped values for every supported platform.
manual: Do custom type choices remain readable while respecting the platform-specific default and minimum sizes?

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0002.review_note: Recorded the official custom-type default and minimum size table for each supported platform.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0003.title: Meet source-scoped minimum color contrast guidance

statement.en: Provide sufficient contrast between foreground text or icons and their backgrounds in every supported appearance.
statement.ja: 対応するすべての外観で、前景のテキストやアイコンと背景の間に十分なコントラストを確保する。

conditions: For the WCAG Level AA values used by Accessibility Inspector, use at least 4.5:1 for text up to 17 pt.
For the same source-scoped values, use at least 3:1 for 18 pt text and for bold text of any size.
Check both light and dark appearances when Dark Mode is supported.
If the default scheme falls short, provide a conforming higher-contrast scheme when Increase Contrast is enabled.

automated: Measure foreground/background contrast in light, dark, and Increase Contrast appearances against the source-scoped threshold.
manual: Are essential text, icons, and states legible in every supported appearance without relying on color alone?

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0003.review_note: Recorded the official WCAG-based contrast table and its Dark Mode and Increase Contrast conditions without treating it as a universal legal threshold.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0010.title: Meet platform control-size guidance

statement.en: Size interactive controls for comfortable selection using the target platform's default and minimum dimensions.
statement.ja: 対象プラットフォームのデフォルト寸法と最小寸法に従い、操作しやすい大きさのコントロールを提供する。

conditions: iOS and iPadOS: prefer 44 by 44 pt and do not go below 28 by 28 pt.
macOS: prefer 28 by 28 pt and do not go below 20 by 20 pt.
tvOS: prefer 66 by 66 pt and do not go below 56 by 56 pt.
visionOS: prefer 60 by 60 pt and do not go below 28 by 28 pt.
watchOS: prefer 44 by 44 pt and do not go below 28 by 28 pt.

automated: Measure rendered interactive hit regions and compare them with the source-scoped platform minimum.
manual: Are controls comfortably selectable for people with limited dexterity or mobility?

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0010.review_note: Recorded the official default and minimum control-size table for each supported platform.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0008.title: Consider pairing haptics with information-bearing audio cues

statement.en: Consider pairing information-bearing audio cues with matching haptics.
statement.ja: 情報を伝える音声キューに、対応するハプティクスを組み合わせることを検討する。

conditions: The interface communicates success, errors, game feedback, or other information through audio cues.
Apply only on platforms and devices that support the relevant haptic experience.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0008.review_note: Lowered SHOULD to MAY because the supporting official prose says to consider pairing matching haptics with audio cues.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0026.title: Account for font weight when choosing text size

statement.en: Account for font weight when choosing readable custom text sizes.
statement.ja: 読みやすいカスタム文字サイズを選ぶ際は、フォントウェイトも考慮する。

conditions: When a custom font uses a thin weight, aim above the platform's recommended size to improve legibility.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0026.review_note: Reworded the generated paraphrase to preserve the official relationship between thin font weight, larger size, and legibility.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0027.title: Integrate Siri and Shortcuts for voice-only tasks

statement.en: Integrate with Siri and Shortcuts so people can perform important or repetitive tasks using voice alone.
statement.ja: 重要なタスクや反復タスクを音声だけで実行できるよう、Siriとショートカットに連携する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0027.review_note: Removed a duplicated preposition and retained the source-scoped focus on important and repetitive tasks.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0033.title: Consider simplifying Assistive Access around core functionality

statement.en: Identify the app's core functionality and consider removing noncritical workflows and interface elements from Assistive Access.
statement.ja: アプリの中核機能を特定し、Assistive Accessでは重要でないワークフローやUI要素を省くことを検討する。

conditions: The app provides an Assistive Access experience on iOS or iPadOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0033.review_note: Lowered the compound prompt to MAY so its explicit consider clause is not raised to SHOULD; a future atomic split remains appropriate.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0034.title: Break multistep Assistive Access workflows into focused screens

statement.en: Break multistep Assistive Access workflows into screens that focus on one interaction at a time.
statement.ja: Assistive Accessの複数段階ワークフローを、一度に1つの操作へ集中できる画面に分ける。

conditions: The app provides an Assistive Access experience on iOS or iPadOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0034.review_note: Repaired the generated sentence and recorded the Assistive Access platform context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0036.title: Keep visionOS interface elements within the field of view

statement.en: Keep interface elements within a person's field of view and prefer comfortable horizontal layouts.
statement.ja: UI要素を視野内に収め、快適な横方向のレイアウトを優先する。

conditions: Apply in visionOS, avoiding rapid demands for attention across different locations.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0036.review_note: Replaced a truncated fragment with a concise paraphrase of the complete official visionOS tip.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0037.title: Reduce peripheral animation speed and intensity in visionOS

statement.en: Reduce the speed and intensity of animated objects, especially in peripheral vision.
statement.ja: 特に周辺視野では、アニメーションするオブジェクトの速度と強度を抑える。

conditions: Apply in visionOS when animated objects are present.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0037.review_note: Made the visionOS and peripheral-vision scope explicit.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0038.title: Use gentle camera and video motion in visionOS

statement.en: Use gentle camera and video motion, preserving the person's sense of control over world movement.
statement.ja: カメラや映像の動きを穏やかにし、周囲の動きに対する利用者の制御感を保つ。

conditions: Apply in visionOS experiences that use camera or video motion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0038.review_note: Restored the source meaning lost by candidate-length truncation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0039.title: Avoid head-anchored content that impedes comfort or assistive input

statement.en: Avoid anchoring content to the wearer's head when it can cause confinement or impede assistive technologies.
statement.ja: 閉塞感を与えたり支援技術を妨げたりする場合は、コンテンツを装着者の頭部へ固定しない。

conditions: Apply in visionOS, including use with Pointer Control.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0039.review_note: Restored the omitted assistive-technology consequence from the complete official list item.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0040.title: Minimize large and repetitive gestures in visionOS

statement.en: Minimize large and repetitive gestures that can become tiring or difficult in a person's surroundings.
statement.ja: 疲労につながったり周囲の環境で難しくなったりする、大きな反復ジェスチャを最小限にする。

conditions: Apply in visionOS interactions that require physical gestures.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0040.review_note: Restored the environmental and fatigue context lost by candidate-length truncation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-INCLUSION-0003.title: Consider carefully before including humor

statement.en: Consider whether humor is appropriate across the cultures, interpretations, and repeated-use contexts you support.
statement.ja: 対応する文化、解釈、反復利用の文脈を踏まえ、ユーモアが適切か慎重に検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-INCLUSION-0003.review_note: Repaired an ungrammatical generated paraphrase while retaining the source's optional strength and cross-cultural rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0003.title: Avoid launch-time permission requests unless required for operation

statement.en: Avoid requesting permission at launch unless the app needs the data or resource to function.
statement.ja: アプリの動作にデータやリソースが必要な場合を除き、起動時の許可要求を避ける。

conditions: Prefer asking when the person uses the feature that needs access.
A launch-time request remains appropriate when the app cannot function without the requested access.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0003.review_note: Preserved the explicit launch-time exception and the source preference for just-in-time permission requests.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0004.title: Explain each permission request with clear purpose copy

statement.en: Write a brief, specific purpose string that clearly explains how the app uses the requested capability, data, or resource.
statement.ja: 要求する機能、データ、リソースの用途を明確に説明する、簡潔で具体的な目的文を書く。

conditions: Use a complete sentence in sentence case.
Avoid passive voice and end the purpose string with a period.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0004.review_note: Recorded the official purpose-string writing constraints from the supporting prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0005.title: Use one clearly labeled button to open a system permission alert

statement.en: On a permission pre-alert, provide one button whose label clearly indicates that the system alert comes next.
statement.ja: 許可の事前画面には、次にシステムアラートが開くことを明確に示すボタンを1つだけ置く。

conditions: Use a progression label such as Continue or Next.
Do not label the pre-alert button with an approval term such as Allow.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0005.review_note: Captured the single-action, nonmanipulative labeling constraints from the complete pre-alert guidance.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0006.title: Avoid secondary actions on permission pre-alerts

statement.en: Avoid adding secondary actions that let people leave a permission pre-alert before viewing the system alert.
statement.ja: システムアラートを見る前に許可の事前画面から離れられる副次アクションを追加しない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0006.review_note: Repaired the generated negative sentence and retained the official close-or-cancel example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0008.title: Consider the location button for feature-specific sharing

statement.en: Consider using the location button for lightweight, feature-specific location sharing.
statement.ja: 特定機能で位置情報を手軽に共有できるよう、位置情報ボタンの利用を検討する。

conditions: The person has shown interest in a feature that benefits from one-time or lightweight location sharing.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0008.review_note: Replaced a truncated title and retained the source's feature-specific, optional scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0013.title: Avoid assuming who is signed in on macOS

statement.en: Avoid assuming a single person's identity from the signed-in macOS session.
statement.ja: サインイン中のmacOSセッションから、利用者が1人だと決めつけない。

conditions: Account for fast user switching and multiple active people on the same system.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0013.review_note: Made the macOS fast-user-switching rationale explicit.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0015.title: Choose a system-provided location-button title when customizing

statement.en: When customizing the location button, choose the system-provided title that best fits the feature.
statement.ja: 位置情報ボタンをカスタマイズする場合は、機能に最も合うシステム提供タイトルを選ぶ。

conditions: Customization is optional under the parent consider guidance.
Use a system-provided title such as Current Location or Share My Current Location.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0015.review_note: Lowered SHOULD to MAY because the item is an option under the parent statement that the button can be customized.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0016.title: Choose a system location glyph when customizing

statement.en: When customizing the location button, choose the system-provided filled or outlined location glyph.
statement.ja: 位置情報ボタンをカスタマイズする場合は、システム提供の塗りつぶしまたは輪郭の位置情報グリフを選ぶ。

conditions: Customization is optional under the parent consider guidance.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-PRIVACY-0016.review_note: Lowered SHOULD to MAY because the glyph choice is an optional customization listed under a can clause.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0008.title: Use flexible-height macOS buttons only for tall or variable content

statement.en: Use a flexible-height push button only for two-line text, tall icons, or other tall or variable-height content.
statement.ja: 2行テキスト、高いアイコンなど、高さが大きいか変動する内容に限って柔軟な高さのプッシュボタンを使う。

conditions: Apply to macOS push buttons.
Use a standard push button when the content doesn't require extra or variable height.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0008.review_note: Recorded the complete standard-versus-flexible push-button condition from the official macOS prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0015.title: Place macOS help buttons in expected window locations

statement.en: Place a macOS help button in the source-specified lower corner for the window or dialog style.
statement.ja: macOSのヘルプボタンを、ウインドウまたはダイアログ形式に応じて指定された下隅へ配置する。

conditions: In a dialog with dismissal buttons, use the opposite lower corner and align the help button vertically with them.
In a dialog without dismissal buttons, use the lower-left or lower-right corner.
In a Settings window or pane, use the lower-left or lower-right corner.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0015.review_note: Recorded all three rows of the official help-button location table.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0019.title: Pad macOS image-button content by about 10 pixels

statement.en: Include about 10 pixels of padding between an image and the clickable edges of its macOS image button.
statement.ja: macOSの画像ボタンでは、画像とクリック可能なボタン端の間に約10ピクセルの余白を確保する。

conditions: The button edges define the clickable area even when they aren't visible.
In general, avoid adding a system-provided border to an image button.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0019.review_note: Recorded the source-scoped padding value and invisible clickable-edge context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0020.title: Prefer discernible button shapes and fills in visionOS

statement.en: Prefer a discernible background shape and contrasting fill for visionOS buttons that need independent visual definition.
statement.ja: 単独で視覚的な輪郭が必要なvisionOSボタンでは、識別しやすい背景形状と対照的な塗りを優先する。

exceptions: A separate button background isn't necessary in a toolbar, context menu, alert, or ornament when the containing shape and material keep it comfortably visible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0020.review_note: Preserved the official exception for buttons already defined by a containing component.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0022.title: Provide gaze-friendly spacing around visionOS buttons

statement.en: Provide enough spacing around visionOS buttons for comfortable gaze targeting and nonoverlapping hover effects.
statement.ja: 視線で狙いやすくホバー効果が重ならないよう、visionOSボタンの周囲に十分な間隔を確保する。

conditions: Keep button centers at least 60 points apart.
For buttons that measure at least 60 points, add 4 points of surrounding padding.
Generally avoid arranging small or mini buttons in a vertical stack or horizontal row.

automated: Measure center-to-center button spacing and verify the source-scoped 60-point minimum.
For buttons at least 60 points in size, verify 4 points of hover-effect clearance.
manual: Can people look at and select each visionOS button without adjacent hover effects competing or overlapping?

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0022.review_note: Recorded the official 60-point center spacing, 4-point padding, and small-button arrangement conditions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0023.title: Match visionOS text-button shape to stack direction

statement.en: Use rounded rectangles for vertical stacks of text buttons and capsules for horizontal rows.
statement.ja: テキストボタンは、縦積みでは角丸長方形、横並びではカプセル形状を使う。

conditions: Apply to text-labeled buttons displayed in a visionOS stack or row.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0023.review_note: Recorded both directional shape mappings from the supporting official prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0024.title: Use standard visionOS controls for familiar audible feedback

statement.en: Use standard visionOS controls so interactions provide the familiar audible feedback people expect.
statement.ja: 期待される聞き慣れた音声フィードバックを提供できるよう、visionOSの標準コントロールを使う。

conditions: Audible feedback is especially important because visionOS doesn't provide haptic feedback.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0024.review_note: Recorded the visionOS no-haptics rationale that makes standard audible feedback important.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0026.title: Prefer full-width watchOS buttons for primary actions

statement.en: Prefer full-width buttons for primary watchOS actions.
statement.ja: watchOSの主要アクションには全幅ボタンを優先する。

conditions: If two buttons share a row, give both the same height.
When two buttons share a row, use images or short text titles for their content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0026.review_note: Recorded the same-height and concise-content conditions for two watchOS buttons sharing a row.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0028.title: Align heights in watchOS text-button stacks

statement.en: Use identical heights where possible for vertically stacked one-line and two-line watchOS text buttons.
statement.ja: watchOSで1行と2行のテキストボタンを縦に積む場合は、可能な限り同じ高さにする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0028.review_note: Preserved the source's where-possible qualification while recording the visual-consistency goal.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0001.title: Support all watchOS complication families when possible

statement.en: Support every complication family for which the app can provide useful information.
statement.ja: アプリが有用な情報を提供できるすべてのcomplication familyに対応する。

conditions: When useful family-specific information isn't available, provide an app-representative image that still launches the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0001.review_note: Preserved the when-possible qualification and the official fallback for unsupported information layouts.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0003.title: Protect private information in watchOS complications

statement.en: Help people prevent sensitive complication information from being visible to anyone other than the wearer.
statement.ja: complicationの機密情報が装着者以外に見えないよう、利用者が保護できる設計にする。

conditions: Account for information remaining visible on the Always-On Retina display.
HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0003.review_note: Replaced an ungrammatical paraphrase and captured the Always-On privacy risk from the supporting prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0006.title: Provide static placeholders for every supported complication

statement.en: Provide a static placeholder image for each supported complication layout.
statement.ja: 対応する各complicationレイアウトに静的プレースホルダ画像を用意する。

conditions: The system can display placeholders before localized content is ready and in the complication-selection carousel.
Match each placeholder to the applicable layout because placeholder and final image sizes can differ.
HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0006.review_note: Recorded the system display contexts and per-layout sizing caveat for placeholder images.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0007.title: Identify glanceable, essential, dynamic complication content

statement.en: Prioritize essential, dynamic information people want to view at a glance in a complication.
statement.ja: complicationには、利用者が一目で確認したい重要かつ動的な情報を優先する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0007.review_note: Repaired the generated paraphrase and retained the source preference for useful live information over static launch-only content.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0008.title: Avoid relying on color alone in complications

statement.en: Avoid using color as the only way to communicate important information in a complication.
statement.ja: complicationで重要な情報を伝える唯一の手段として色を使わない。

conditions: People need to receive the same information in tinted and nontinted modes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0008.review_note: Restored the tinted-versus-nontinted requirement lost by evidence-fragment truncation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.title: Offer high-value Home Screen quick actions

statement.en: Create Home Screen quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks people can start without opening the app first.
statement.ja: アプリを先に開かず開始できる、価値の高いタスクをHome Screen quick actionとして提供する。

conditions: People generally expect at least one useful quick action.
An app can provide up to four quick actions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.review_note: Recorded the expected minimum usefulness and source-scoped maximum of four quick actions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.title: Keep dynamic quick-action changes predictable

statement.en: Avoid changing dynamic quick actions in ways people can't predict.
statement.ja: dynamic quick actionを、利用者が予測できない形で変更しない。

conditions: Relevance-based changes may use current location, recent app activity, time of day, or settings changes when the result remains predictable.
HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.review_note: Preserved the allowance for dynamic relevance while retaining predictability as the governing constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.title: Use familiar icons for Home Screen quick actions

statement.en: Provide a familiar interface icon for every Home Screen quick action, preferring SF Symbols where suitable.
statement.ja: 各Home Screen quick actionに馴染みのあるUIアイコンを付け、適切な場合はSF Symbolsを優先する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.review_note: Recorded the official preference for SF Symbols when representing quick actions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.title: Avoid emoji as quick-action icons

statement.en: Avoid using an emoji in place of a symbol or interface icon for a Home Screen quick action.
statement.ja: Home Screen quick actionのシンボルまたはUIアイコンの代わりに絵文字を使わない。

conditions: Quick-action symbols are monochromatic and adapt in Dark Mode, unlike full-color emoji.
HIG-COMPONENTS-HOME-SCREEN-QUICK-ACTIONS.review_note: Repaired the generated negative sentence and retained the Dark Mode contrast rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0009.title: Carefully choose complication update times

statement.en: Choose complication timeline update times that maximize usefulness within the system's limited update and entry budgets.
statement.ja: システムの更新回数とentry数の制限内で有用性が最大になるよう、complication timelineの更新時刻を選ぶ。

conditions: Match timeline values to when each data item becomes relevant.
Account for the limited daily timeline updates and stored entries available to each app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-COMPLICATIONS-0009.review_note: Recovered a previously unextracted carefully-consider lead and recorded its timeline-budget context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0001.title: Use Live Activities for bounded tasks lasting up to eight hours

statement.en: Offer a Live Activity for a short- or medium-duration task or event with a defined beginning and end.
statement.ja: 開始と終了が明確な短時間または中時間のタスクやイベントにLive Activityを提供する。

conditions: The tracked activity should not exceed eight hours.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0001.review_note: Recorded the official short-to-medium duration scope and eight-hour upper bound.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0002.title: Avoid ads and promotions in Live Activities

statement.en: Avoid using a Live Activity to display advertising or promotional content.
statement.ja: Live Activityを広告やプロモーションの表示に使わない。

conditions: Display only information related to the ongoing task or event.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0002.review_note: Repaired the generated negative sentence and retained the task-related-content boundary.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0003.title: Avoid exposing sensitive information in Live Activities

statement.en: Avoid displaying sensitive or private information directly in a Live Activity.
statement.ja: Live Activityに機密情報や個人情報を直接表示しない。

conditions: Use an innocuous summary that opens the sensitive details in the app, or redact the sensitive view.
Where appropriate, let people configure whether sensitive data appears.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0003.review_note: Recorded the official summary, redaction, and user-configuration mitigations for prominent surfaces.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0005.title: Avoid app elements that call attention to the Dynamic Island

statement.en: Avoid adding elements inside the app whose purpose is to draw attention to the Dynamic Island.
statement.ja: Dynamic Islandへ注意を向けさせるための要素をアプリ内に追加しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0005.review_note: Repaired the generated negative sentence and retained the distinction between in-app and background presentation.

section_path: Starting, updating, and ending a Live Activity

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0014.title: Track related events in one dynamic Live Activity

statement.en: Prefer one Live Activity with a dynamic layout that rotates through related events instead of separate activities people must switch between.
statement.ja: 関連イベントごとに切り替えが必要な複数のactivityではなく、動的レイアウトでイベントを巡回する1つのLive Activityを優先する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0014.review_note: Recorded the single-activity and rotating-layout implementation described by the official prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0017.title: Keep compact Live Activity content narrow and camera-adjacent

statement.en: Keep compact-presentation content narrow, balanced, and directly adjacent to the TrueDepth camera.
statement.ja: compact presentationの内容を狭く均衡させ、TrueDepthカメラへ直接沿わせる。

conditions: Don't add padding between content and the TrueDepth camera.
Avoid obscuring key status-bar information and balance similarly sized leading and trailing views.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0017.review_note: Recorded the no-padding, status-bar, and leading/trailing balance constraints.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0020.title: Avoid notification-style Live Activity layouts

statement.en: Avoid replicating a notification layout for a Live Activity on the Lock Screen.
statement.ja: Lock Screen上のLive Activityで通知レイアウトを再現しない。

conditions: Create a layout specific to the Live Activity's information.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0020.review_note: Repaired the generated negative sentence and retained the requirement for information-specific layout.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0023.title: Verify the system-generated Live Activity dismiss-button color

statement.en: Verify that the system-generated dismiss-button color matches the Live Activity design, and adjust it when necessary.
statement.ja: システム生成のdismiss button色がLive Activityのデザインに合うことを確認し、必要なら調整する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0023.review_note: Repaired the incomplete generated verification statement and preserved the adjustment path.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0024.title: Use the 14-point standard Lock Screen margin

statement.en: Use the 14-point standard layout margin for a Lock Screen Live Activity.
statement.ja: Lock ScreenのLive Activityでは標準の14ポイントlayout marginを使う。

conditions: Tighter margins can be appropriate for graphics or buttons, but avoid crowded edges.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0024.review_note: Recorded the source-scoped 14-point margin and its limited tighter-margin exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0027.title: Verify StandBy Live Activities in Night Mode

statement.en: Verify that a StandBy Live Activity remains legible and sufficiently contrasted under the system's red Night Mode tint.
statement.ja: StandByのLive Activityが、システムの赤いNight Mode tintでも判読可能で十分なコントラストを保つことを確認する。

manual: Does the StandBy Live Activity remain legible and sufficiently contrasted under the red Night Mode tint?

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0027.review_note: Repaired the incomplete verification statement and recorded the system red-tint condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0028.title: Consider a supplemental CarPlay Live Activity layout

statement.en: Consider a custom CarPlay layout when the Live Activity benefits from larger text or additional information.
statement.ja: Live Activityで大きなテキストや追加情報が有用な場合は、CarPlay向けカスタムレイアウトを検討する。

conditions: Declare support for the ActivityFamily.small supplemental activity family instead of using the default appearance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0028.review_note: Recorded the supplemental activity-family mechanism from the official CarPlay guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0029.title: Consider a custom watchOS Live Activity layout

statement.en: Consider a custom Apple Watch layout when it can show more useful information than the system-provided default.
statement.ja: システム提供の標準表示より有用な情報を示せる場合は、Apple Watch向けカスタムレイアウトを検討する。

conditions: The same custom layout also appears in CarPlay, where interactive elements are disabled.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0029.review_note: Recorded the cross-platform CarPlay consequence of choosing a custom watchOS layout.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0031.title: Carefully consider a custom Lock Screen background

statement.en: Carefully consider whether a custom background color or opacity improves the Lock Screen Live Activity.
statement.ja: カスタム背景色や不透明度がLock ScreenのLive Activityを改善するか慎重に検討する。

conditions: Compact, minimal, and expanded presentations don't support custom background colors.
A custom Lock Screen background needs sufficient contrast on reduced-luminance Always-On displays.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0031.review_note: Recovered the carefully-consider lead and recorded its presentation and contrast limits.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0032.title: Carefully consider controls in a CarPlay Live Activity layout

statement.en: Carefully consider whether buttons or toggles belong in a custom Live Activity layout used in CarPlay.
statement.ja: CarPlayで使われるカスタムLive Activityレイアウトにボタンやtoggleが適切か慎重に検討する。

conditions: CarPlay deactivates interactive elements in Live Activities.
When people may observe the activity while driving, prefer timely content over controls.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0032.review_note: Recovered the optional lead and recorded the CarPlay noninteractive and driving contexts.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0033.title: Carefully consider controls in a custom watchOS layout

statement.en: Carefully consider whether buttons or toggles belong in a custom watchOS Live Activity layout.
statement.ja: watchOS向けカスタムLive Activityレイアウトにボタンやtoggleが適切か慎重に検討する。

conditions: The watchOS custom layout also appears in CarPlay, where interactive elements are disabled.
Don't include controls when people are likely to start or observe the Live Activity while driving.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0033.review_note: Recovered the optional watchOS lead and preserved its stricter driving-context condition.

section_path: Adding transitions and animating content updates

HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0034.title: Avoid overlapping elements during Live Activity transitions

statement.en: Avoid overlapping elements during Live Activity content transitions.
statement.ja: Live Activityのcontent transition中はelementの重なりを避ける。

conditions: Apply when adding transitions or animating Live Activity content updates.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LIVE-ACTIVITIES-0034.review_note: Recovered the qualified Try to avoid lead and scoped it to Live Activity content transitions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0019.title: Avoid relying on a watchOS short look for critical information

statement.en: Avoid using a watchOS short look as the only channel for important information.
statement.ja: watchOSのshort lookを重要情報の唯一の伝達手段にしない。

conditions: Deliver critical information through an additional channel because a short look appears only briefly.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0019.review_note: Recorded the brief-display limitation and redundant-delivery requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0020.title: Keep watchOS short-look content discreet

statement.en: Limit a watchOS short look to basic, nonsensitive information.
statement.ja: watchOSのshort lookは基本的で機密性のない情報に限定する。

conditions: Avoid potentially sensitive information in the notification title.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0020.review_note: Made the generic privacy prompt specific to the official short-look disclosure risk.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0021.title: Consider a rich watchOS long-look notification

statement.en: Consider a rich custom long look that provides needed information without requiring people to launch the app.
statement.ja: アプリを起動せず必要情報を得られる、豊かなカスタムlong lookを検討する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0021.review_note: Replaced a truncated title while preserving the optional source strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0022.title: Choose a suitable watchOS long-look sash appearance

statement.en: Choose a custom color or blurred appearance for the system-provided long-look sash when it supports the content.
statement.ja: 内容に適する場合は、システム提供のlong-look sashにカスタム色またはblurred appearanceを選ぶ。

conditions: A blurred translucent sash usually works well when a photo appears at the top of the content area.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0022.review_note: Recorded the two sash appearance choices and the photo-overlap context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0023.title: Choose a watchOS long-look content background

statement.en: Choose the transparent default, a system-matching translucent white, or a suitable custom color for the long-look content area.
statement.ja: long-look content areaには、標準の透明、システムに合う半透明白、または適切なカスタム色を選ぶ。

conditions: Use white at 18 percent opacity to match the background of other system notifications.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0023.review_note: Recorded the official 18-percent opacity option and transparent default.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0024.title: Provide at most four custom watchOS long-look actions

statement.en: Provide up to four custom actions below the watchOS long-look content area.
statement.ja: watchOSのlong-look content areaの下に最大4つのカスタムactionを提供する。

conditions: The system always adds a Dismiss button below the custom actions.
An iPhone companion's registered actionable notification types can configure the watchOS buttons.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0024.review_note: Recorded the four-action limit, system Dismiss button, and iPhone-companion sharing behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0025.title: Order watchOS notification actions for double tap

statement.en: Order custom notification actions so double tap runs the most appropriate first nondestructive action.
statement.ja: double tapで最も適切な最初の非破壊actionが実行されるよう、カスタム通知actionを並べる。

conditions: Consider placing the most frequently used nondestructive action at the top of the list.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0025.review_note: Repaired the generic generated wording and recorded how double tap selects an action.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0005.title: Avoid animated page transitions while scrubbing

statement.en: Avoid animating each page transition while a person scrubs through an iOS or iPadOS page control.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのpage controlをscrubしている間は、各ページ遷移をアニメーションしない。

conditions: Use the animated scrolling transition for taps, not rapid scrubbing.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0005.review_note: Recorded the source distinction between scrubbing and tapping.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0006.title: Avoid a scrubber with the minimal page-control background

statement.en: Avoid enabling page-control scrubbing with the minimal background style because it provides no scrubbing feedback.
statement.ja: scrub中のフィードバックがないため、minimal background styleではpage-control scrubbingを有効にしない。

conditions: Use the automatic or prominent background style when people need to scrub pages.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0006.review_note: Recorded the feedback limitation and supported background-style alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0007.title: Use tvOS page controls for peer full-screen pages

statement.en: Use a page control for a tvOS collection of content-rich full-screen pages that are peers in the hierarchy.
statement.ja: 階層上対等なcontent-richな全画面ページのtvOS collectionにはpage controlを使う。

conditions: Avoid additional controls that make it difficult to maintain focus while moving between pages.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0007.review_note: Recorded the full-screen peer hierarchy and focus constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0008.title: Use purposeful vertical pagination in watchOS

statement.en: Separate watchOS views into purposeful vertical pages that people scroll with the Digital Crown.
statement.ja: watchOSのviewを目的の明確な縦ページに分け、Digital Crownでスクロールできるようにする。

conditions: Prefer this pattern over horizontal pagination or deep hierarchical navigation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0008.review_note: Recorded the Digital Crown interaction and the disfavored alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0009.title: Consider one-screen-height watchOS pages

statement.en: Consider limiting each watchOS page to one screen height for a distinct, glanceable purpose.
statement.ja: 明確でglanceableな目的を持たせるため、各watchOSページを1画面分の高さに制限することを検討する。

conditions: Use variable-height pages sparingly and place them after fixed-height pages when possible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PAGE-CONTROLS-0009.review_note: Recorded the optional single-screen constraint and variable-height ordering guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0001.title: Use panels for content-related controls or information

statement.en: Use a panel to give people quick access to controls or information related to their current content.
statement.ja: 現在のコンテンツに関係するコントロールや情報へすばやくアクセスできるよう、panelを使う。

conditions: A panel can provide controls or settings that affect the selected item in the active document or window.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0001.review_note: Restored the complete content relationship that the 19-word source fragment truncated.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0002.title: Consider a panel for inspector functionality

statement.en: Consider a panel for inspector details that update with the current selection.
statement.ja: 現在の選択に応じて更新されるinspectorの詳細には、panelの使用を検討する。

conditions: Use a regular window for Info content that remains unchanged when the selection changes.
Depending on the app layout, a split-view pane can also present an inspector.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0002.review_note: Distinguished selection-following inspectors from persistent Info windows and the split-view alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0003.title: Prefer simple adjustment controls in panels

statement.en: Prefer simple, direct adjustment controls in a panel.
statement.ja: panelでは、単純で直接的な調整コントロールを優先する。

conditions: Avoid controls that require typing or selecting items to act upon when simpler controls suffice.
Consider sliders and steppers for direct adjustment.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0003.review_note: Recorded the multi-step interaction concern and the slider and stepper examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0004.title: Give each panel a brief purpose-based title

statement.en: Give each panel a brief title that describes its purpose.
statement.ja: 各panelに、その目的を表す簡潔なタイトルを付ける。

conditions: Use a short noun or noun phrase with title-style capitalization.
A floating panel needs a title bar so people can reposition it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0004.review_note: Recorded the title form and the positioning purpose of the title bar.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0005.title: Show panels only while the app is active

statement.en: Bring open panels forward when the app activates, and hide them when it deactivates.
statement.ja: アプリがactiveになったら開いているpanelを前面に出し、inactiveになったら非表示にする。

conditions: Bring all open panels forward regardless of which window was active when a panel opened.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0005.review_note: Expanded the generic lead into the two documented app-activity state transitions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0006.title: Avoid listing panels as documents in the Window menu

statement.en: Avoid listing panels as documents in the Window menu.
statement.ja: Windowメニューのdocument一覧にpanelを含めない。

exceptions: The Window menu may include commands that show or hide panels.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0006.review_note: Distinguished the prohibited documents list from permitted show and hide commands.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0007.title: Prefer standard panels over HUD-style panels

statement.en: Prefer standard panels, using HUD-style panels only in suitable immersive or visual contexts.
statement.ja: 標準panelを優先し、HUD-style panelは適切な没入型または視覚中心の状況に限って使う。

conditions: A HUD can suit a media-oriented app that presents movies, photos, or slides.
A HUD can suit a case where a standard panel would obscure essential content.
A HUD can suit a case needing no controls except a disclosure triangle, because most system controls do not match its appearance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0007.review_note: Preserved all three source-listed conditions for using a HUD instead of a standard panel.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0008.title: Maintain one panel style across app modes

statement.en: Maintain one panel style when the app switches modes.
statement.ja: アプリがmodeを切り替えても、panel styleを統一して維持する。

conditions: If full-screen mode uses a HUD, prefer retaining the HUD style after leaving full screen.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0008.review_note: Recorded the full-screen-to-windowed example without turning it into a universal requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0009.title: Use color sparingly in HUD-style panels

statement.en: Use color sparingly in HUD-style panels.
statement.ja: HUD-style panelでは色を控えめに使う。

conditions: Use small amounts of high-contrast color to highlight important information when needed.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0009.review_note: Recorded the distraction risk and the high-contrast highlighting use case.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0010.title: Keep HUD-style panels small and unobtrusive

statement.en: Keep HUD-style panels small and unobtrusive.
statement.ja: HUD-style panelは小さく、目立ちすぎないようにする。

conditions: Do not let a HUD obscure the content it adjusts.
Ensure the HUD does not compete with the content for attention.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0010.review_note: Repaired the HUD capitalization bug and preserved the obscuration and attention constraints.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0011.title: Avoid making a panel's minimize button available

statement.en: Avoid making a panel's minimize button available.
statement.ja: panelの最小化buttonは、原則として利用可能にしない。

conditions: A panel normally appears only when needed and disappears when the app is inactive.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0011.review_note: Recovered the qualified AVOID guidance without raising it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0012.title: Refer to panels by title

statement.en: Refer to panels by title in the interface and help documentation.
statement.ja: interfaceとhelp documentationでは、panelをそのタイトルで参照する。

conditions: In menus, use the panel title without adding the word panel.
In help documentation, use the title alone or append window when it improves clarity.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PANELS-0012.review_note: Recovered the naming guidance and preserved its different menu and documentation forms.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0018.title: Avoid complex chart interactions in watchOS

statement.en: Avoid requiring complex chart interactions in a watchOS app.
statement.ja: watchOSアプリでは、複雑なchart操作を要求しない。

conditions: Prefer glanceable information and simple interactions when they add value.
Use another platform's app version for additional chart detail and interactions when available.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0018.review_note: Recovered the qualified AVOID lead and recorded the glanceability and companion-platform guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTEXT-MENUS-0013.title: Avoid context menus taller than their visionOS window

statement.en: Avoid making a visionOS context menu taller than its window.
statement.ja: visionOSのcontext menuを、そのwindowより高くしない。

conditions: A menu that is too tall can obscure system-provided controls above or below the window.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTEXT-MENUS-0013.review_note: Recovered the qualified AVOID lead and its visionOS system-control obstruction rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0017.title: Avoid unnecessary transparency in watchOS images

statement.en: Avoid transparency in watchOS images when a solid background can reduce file size.
statement.ja: solid背景でファイルサイズを減らせるwatchOS画像では、透明部分を避ける。

exceptions: Use transparency where the system requires it to apply color, including complication images, menu icons, and other template images.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0017.review_note: Recovered the qualified AVOID lead without losing the template-image transparency exceptions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid flat 360-degree images for visionOS environments

statement.en: Avoid using a flat 360-degree image as a visionOS environment.
statement.ja: visionOSのenvironmentには、flatな360-degree画像を使わない。

conditions: Prefer object meshes with lighting and shaders for subtle environmental animation.
exceptions: If a flat 360-degree image is necessary, add a ground-plane mesh to improve realism and grounding.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the scale and immersion limitation, preferred mesh treatment, and ground-plane fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0012.title: Avoid rotating a virtual world in visionOS

statement.en: Avoid letting people rotate a virtual world in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSでは、virtual worldを利用者に回転させない。

conditions: World rotation can upset a person's sense of stability even when user-controlled and subtle.
Consider an instantaneous directional change during a quick fade-out instead.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0012.review_note: Recovered the qualified AVOID lead and recorded the source's stability rationale and fade alternative.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0013.title: Avoid repeating a control name in its tooltip

statement.en: Avoid repeating a control's name in its tooltip.
statement.ja: tooltipではcontrol名を繰り返さない。

conditions: Repeated names consume tooltip space and rarely add value to the description.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0013.review_note: Recovered the qualified AVOID lead and kept it scoped to macOS and visionOS tooltips.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0011.title: Avoid adding depth to visionOS text

statement.en: Avoid adding depth to text in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSのtextにはdepthを加えない。

conditions: Text that appears to hover above its background can be difficult to read and may cause visual discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0011.review_note: Recovered the qualified AVOID lead and preserved the legibility and visual-comfort rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POPOVERS-0012.title: Avoid popovers in compact iOS and iPadOS views

statement.en: Avoid popovers in compact iOS or iPadOS views.
statement.ja: compactなiOSまたはiPadOSのviewではpopoverを使わない。

conditions: Adjust the layout dynamically for the content area's size class.
Reserve popovers for wide views and use a full-screen modal view such as a sheet in compact views.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POPOVERS-0012.review_note: Recorded the size-class scope and the full-screen modal alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POPOVERS-0013.title: Consider detachable macOS popovers

statement.en: Consider letting people detach a macOS popover into a panel.
statement.ja: macOSのpopoverをpanelとして切り離せるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: Detachment can help when people need the popover to remain visible while they view other information.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POPOVERS-0013.review_note: Preserved the optional strength and documented the persistent-panel use case.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POPOVERS-0014.title: Keep detached macOS popovers visually familiar

statement.en: Keep a detached macOS popover visually similar to the original popover.
statement.ja: 切り離したmacOSのpopoverは、元のpopoverと視覚的に似た外観に保つ。

conditions: Visual similarity helps people maintain context after the popover becomes a panel.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POPOVERS-0014.review_note: Replaced generic generated wording with the source's context-preservation intent.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PROGRESS-INDICATORS-0006.title: Prefer macOS spinners for background or space-constrained status

statement.en: Prefer a macOS spinner for background operations or space-constrained status.
statement.ja: macOSのbackground operationや狭い領域でのstatus表示にはspinnerを優先する。

conditions: A spinner can communicate an asynchronous background task such as retrieving server messages.
A spinner can fit within a text field or next to a specific control.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PROGRESS-INDICATORS-0006.review_note: Restored the complete space-constrained clause and recorded the source examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PROGRESS-INDICATORS-0007.title: Avoid labeling macOS spinners

statement.en: Avoid labeling a macOS spinner.
statement.ja: macOSのspinnerにはlabelを付けない。

conditions: A label is usually unnecessary because a spinner typically appears after people initiate a process.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PROGRESS-INDICATORS-0007.review_note: Kept the qualified AVOID strength and recorded why a label is usually redundant.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0007.title: Consider a page control for page-by-page scrolling

statement.en: Consider a page control for page-by-page scrolling in iOS or iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのpage-by-page scrollingにはpage controlを検討する。

conditions: A page control communicates the available pages and the currently visible page.
exceptions: When showing a page control, omit the scroll indicator on the same axis to avoid redundant controls.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0007.review_note: Recorded the page-count purpose and the same-axis scroll-indicator exclusion.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0008.title: Support Look to Scroll in visionOS reading and browsing views

statement.en: Support Look to Scroll in visionOS reading or browsing views.
statement.ja: visionOSのreadingまたはbrowsing viewでLook to Scrollをサポートする。

conditions: Enable Look to Scroll explicitly for each applicable scroll view.
Remove scroll-position-dependent custom effects or animations before enabling Look to Scroll.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0008.review_note: Repaired capitalization and recorded the per-view opt-in and custom-effect constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0009.title: Avoid Look to Scroll for secondary visionOS content

statement.en: Avoid Look to Scroll for secondary visionOS content.
statement.ja: visionOSのsecondary contentではLook to Scrollを使わない。

conditions: Use standard gestures instead for views with controls or dense information that require quick, precise scrolling.
