HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0009.review_note: Recorded the control-density and precision conditions behind the secondary-content restriction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0010.title: Apply Look to Scroll consistently across similar visionOS views

statement.en: Support Look to Scroll consistently across similar visionOS views.
statement.ja: 同種のvisionOS viewではLook to Scrollを一貫してサポートする。

conditions: When one view supports Look to Scroll, enable it in all similar views so people know what to expect.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0010.review_note: Replaced the vague generated statement with the specific cross-view consistency requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0011.title: Prefer vertical scrolling for watchOS content

statement.en: Prefer vertical scrolling for watchOS content.
statement.ja: watchOSのcontentでは縦スクロールを優先する。

conditions: For a single list or content view taller than the display, use the Digital Crown for vertical scrolling.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0011.review_note: Recorded the single-view and Digital Crown context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0012.title: Use watchOS tab views for page-by-page scrolling

statement.en: Use vertically stacked tab views for page-by-page scrolling in watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSのpage-by-page scrollingには、縦に並べたtab viewを使う。

conditions: The system page indicator shows position within the current page and the set of pages.
Consider one-screen-height pages; use variable-height pages judiciously and place them after fixed-height pages when possible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0012.review_note: Recorded the Digital Crown page-indicator behavior and the page-height guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0013.title: Define clear visionOS Look to Scroll areas

statement.en: Define clear visionOS scroll areas for Look to Scroll.
statement.ja: visionOSのLook to Scroll用scroll areaを明確に定義する。

conditions: Prefer a scroll view that spans the full width or full height of the window.
When a scroll view is inset, provide clear boundaries that indicate where people need to look.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SCROLL-VIEWS-0013.review_note: Recovered the Define lead and recorded the full-span preference and inset-boundary fallback.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0006.title: Consider segmented controls for closely related subviews

statement.en: Consider a segmented control for switching between closely related iOS or iPadOS subviews.
statement.ja: 密接に関連するiOSまたはiPadOSのsubview切り替えにはsegmented controlを検討する。

exceptions: Use a tab bar instead when switching between completely separate app sections.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0006.review_note: Preserved the optional strength and distinguished related subviews from separate app sections.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0007.title: Consider clarifying macOS segmented controls with text

statement.en: Consider introductory text when a macOS segmented control's purpose needs clarification.
statement.ja: macOSのsegmented controlの目的に説明が必要な場合は、導入textを検討する。

conditions: For symbols or interface icons, consider a label below each segment.
If the app provides tooltips, provide one for each segment.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0007.review_note: Recorded the icon-label and per-segment tooltip guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0008.title: Use tab views for main-area switching in macOS

statement.en: Use a tab view for switching views in the main macOS window area.
statement.ja: macOS windowのmain areaでviewを切り替える場合はtab viewを使う。

exceptions: Consider a segmented control for switching views in a toolbar or inspector pane.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0008.review_note: Recorded the toolbar and inspector exception to the main-window tab-view guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0009.title: Consider spring loading for macOS segmented controls

statement.en: Consider spring loading for a macOS segmented control.
statement.ja: macOSのsegmented controlでspring loadingを検討する。

conditions: On a Magic Trackpad, spring loading activates a segment by force-clicking while dragging selected items over it.
People can continue dragging after the segment activates without dropping the selected items.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0009.review_note: Recorded the drag, force-click, and continued-drag interaction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0010.title: Consider split views for tvOS content filtering

statement.en: Consider a split view for tvOS content-filtering screens.
statement.ja: tvOSのcontent-filtering screenではsplit viewを検討する。

conditions: A split view can make navigation between content and filtering options easier.
A segmented control may be harder to access depending on its placement.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0010.review_note: Recorded the navigation benefit and placement-dependent accessibility concern.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0011.title: Keep focusable elements away from tvOS segmented controls

statement.en: Avoid placing other focusable elements near a tvOS segmented control.
statement.ja: tvOSのsegmented controlの近くに他のfocusable elementを置かない。

conditions: A tvOS segment becomes selected when focus moves to it, so nearby elements can cause accidental focus changes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0011.review_note: Recorded focus-driven selection and the accidental-focus risk.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0004.title: Include a grabber in resizable iOS and iPadOS sheets

statement.en: Include a grabber in a resizable iOS or iPadOS sheet.
statement.ja: resize可能なiOSまたはiPadOSのsheetにはgrabberを含める。

conditions: The grabber indicates that people can drag to resize or tap to cycle through detents.
The grabber supports VoiceOver resizing without requiring sight.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0004.review_note: Recorded the drag, tap, detent, and VoiceOver functions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0005.title: Support swipe dismissal for iOS and iPadOS sheets

statement.en: Support vertical swipe dismissal for iOS and iPadOS sheets.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSのsheetで縦swipeによるdismissをサポートする。

conditions: If the sheet has unsaved changes, use an action sheet to confirm a swipe-dismiss action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0005.review_note: Recorded the expected gesture and unsaved-changes confirmation path.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0006.title: Prefer page-sheet or form-sheet styles in iPadOS

statement.en: Prefer page-sheet or form-sheet presentation styles in iPadOS.
statement.ja: iPadOSではpage-sheetまたはform-sheetのpresentation styleを優先する。

conditions: These styles provide a default size and center content over a dimmed background.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0006.review_note: Recorded the default sizing, centering, and consistency rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0007.title: Keep other macOS app windows available while a sheet is open

statement.en: Let people use other macOS app windows without dismissing the current sheet.
statement.ja: 現在のsheetを閉じなくても、他のmacOS app windowを使えるようにする。

conditions: Bring the parent window forward when its sheet opens, including modeless document panels for a document window.
Allow people to bring other app windows forward before dismissing the sheet.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0007.review_note: Recorded the sheet's parent-window modality boundary and other-window access.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0008.title: Use macOS panels for repeated input-and-result workflows

statement.en: Use a macOS panel for repeated input-and-result workflows.
statement.ja: 入力と結果確認を繰り返すmacOS workflowではpanelを使う。

conditions: A find-and-replace workflow can use a panel so people can inspect each result.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0008.review_note: Replaced the long generated fragment with the source's repeated-observation intent.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0009.title: Avoid bottom-emerging visionOS sheets

statement.en: Avoid sheets that emerge from the bottom of a visionOS window.
statement.ja: visionOS windowの下端から現れるsheetを避ける。

conditions: Prefer centering the sheet in the person's field of view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0009.review_note: Recorded the visionOS field-of-view placement alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0010.title: Reserve watchOS sheets for custom modal presentation

statement.en: Use a watchOS sheet only for modal tasks needing a custom title or content.
statement.ja: custom titleまたはcontentが必要なmodal taskに限ってwatchOS sheetを使う。

exceptions: Use an alert or action sheet to present important information or a set of choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0010.review_note: Recorded the custom-presentation threshold and the alert or action-sheet alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0011.title: Keep watchOS sheet interactions brief and occasional

statement.en: Keep watchOS sheet interactions brief and occasional.
statement.ja: watchOS sheetでの操作は短く、頻度を抑える。

conditions: Use a sheet as a temporary interruption only for an important task.
exceptions: Do not use a sheet to navigate app content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0011.review_note: Repaired the generated grammar and recorded the task and navigation constraints.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0012.title: Give macOS sheets a content-appropriate default size

statement.en: Present a macOS sheet at a reasonable default size for its content.
statement.ja: macOS sheetはcontentに適した妥当なdefault sizeで表示する。

conditions: People don't generally expect to resize a sheet.
Support resizing when expanding the content would provide a clearer view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0012.review_note: Recovered the Present lead and recorded the optional resizing case.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0013.title: Size visionOS sheets to preserve context

statement.en: Present a visionOS sheet at a default size that preserves context.
statement.ja: visionOS sheetはcontextを保てるdefault sizeで表示する。

conditions: Avoid covering most or all of the parent window.
Consider allowing people to resize the sheet.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0013.review_note: Recovered the Present lead and recorded the coverage limit and resizing option.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0004.title: Consider a tab bar before a sidebar in iOS and iPadOS

statement.en: Consider using a tab bar first in iOS or iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSでは、まずtab barの使用を検討する。

conditions: A tab bar leaves more room for content and can navigate among many apps' main areas.
Use the convertible sidebar appearance when additional, less-frequent areas exceed tab-bar capacity.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0004.review_note: Recorded the content-space rationale and convertible-sidebar fallback.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0005.title: Consider adapting macOS sidebars to window size

statement.en: Consider automatically hiding or revealing a macOS sidebar as its window resizes.
statement.ja: macOS windowのresizeに応じてsidebarを自動的に隠す、または表示することを検討する。

conditions: Collapsing the sidebar in a smaller window can make more room for primary content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0005.review_note: Recorded the window-size condition and content-space purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0006.title: Keep critical content away from the bottom of macOS sidebars

statement.en: Avoid placing critical information or actions at the bottom of a macOS sidebar.
statement.ja: macOS sidebarの下部に重要な情報やactionを置かない。

conditions: People can reposition a window so its bottom edge is hidden.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0003.title: Use a volume view instead of a slider in iOS and iPadOS

statement.en: Avoid a generic slider for iOS or iPadOS audio volume.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのaudio volumeにはgeneric sliderを使わない。

exceptions: Use a customizable volume view that includes a volume-level slider and audio-output control.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0003.review_note: Repaired the ungrammatical generated statement and recorded the volume-view replacement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0004.title: Consider live feedback for macOS slider changes

statement.en: Consider showing live feedback as a macOS slider's value changes.
statement.ja: macOS sliderの値が変わるときにlive feedbackを表示することを検討する。

conditions: Live feedback lets people see the result of the adjustment in real time.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0004.review_note: Preserved the optional strength and recorded the real-time feedback intent.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0005.title: Choose macOS slider styles by value behavior

statement.en: Choose a macOS slider style that matches people's expectations.
statement.ja: 利用者の予想に合うmacOS slider styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Use a horizontal slider for a fixed start-to-end range.
Use a circular slider for values that repeat or continue indefinitely.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0005.review_note: Corrected the possessive and recorded the linear-versus-circular mapping.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0006.title: Consider introductory labels for macOS sliders

statement.en: Consider using a label to introduce a macOS slider.
statement.ja: macOS sliderを説明するlabelの使用を検討する。

conditions: Use sentence-style capitalization and generally end the label with a colon.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0006.review_note: Recorded the label capitalization and punctuation conventions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0007.title: Use macOS slider tick marks for clarity and accuracy

statement.en: Use tick marks to clarify a macOS slider's scale and values.
statement.ja: macOS sliderのscaleと値を明確にするためtick markを使う。

conditions: Tick marks help people understand the measurement scale and locate specific values.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0007.review_note: Replaced generic wording with the scale and value-location purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0008.title: Consider labels for macOS slider tick marks

statement.en: Consider labeling macOS slider tick marks when labels improve clarity.
statement.ja: clarityが向上する場合はmacOS sliderのtick markへのlabel追加を検討する。

conditions: Minimum and maximum labels are often sufficient; nonlinear values can benefit from periodic labels.
Consider a tooltip that shows the thumb value when the pointer rests over it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0008.review_note: Recorded selective labeling, nonlinear context, and the thumb-value tooltip option.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0009.title: Prefer horizontal sliders in visionOS

statement.en: Prefer horizontal sliders in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSではhorizontal sliderを優先する。

conditions: Side-to-side gestures are generally easier than vertical gestures in visionOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0009.review_note: Recorded the gesture-comfort rationale and corrected the platform scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-STATUS-BARS-0001.title: Consider hiding the status bar for full-screen media

statement.en: Consider temporarily hiding the status bar for full-screen media.
statement.ja: full-screen mediaの表示中はstatus barを一時的に隠すことを検討する。

conditions: Temporary hiding can reduce distraction and make the media experience more immersive.
HIG-COMPONENTS-STATUS-BARS-0001.review_note: Preserved the optional and temporary strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-STATUS-BARS-0002.title: Avoid permanently hiding the status bar

statement.en: Avoid permanently hiding the iOS or iPadOS status bar.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのstatus barを恒久的に隠さない。

conditions: Provide a simple, discoverable gesture that restores a temporarily hidden status bar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-STATUS-BARS-0002.review_note: Recorded the rediscovery gesture requirement and kept the guidance at AVOID.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0001.title: Use macOS tab views for closely related content

statement.en: Use a macOS tab view for closely related content areas.
statement.ja: 密接に関連するcontent areaにはmacOS tab viewを使う。

conditions: Each tab's content needs to be similar or related to the content in the other tabs.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Recorded the relationship implied by the tab view's visual enclosure.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0003.title: Label each macOS tab by its pane content

statement.en: Label each macOS tab to describe its pane's content.
statement.ja: 各macOS tabにpaneのcontentを表すlabelを付ける。

conditions: Prefer a noun or short noun phrase; a verb phrase can fit some contexts.
Use title-style capitalization.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Repaired generic generated wording and recorded label form and capitalization.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0004.title: Avoid pop-up buttons for switching macOS tabs

statement.en: Avoid using a pop-up button to switch macOS tabs.
statement.ja: macOS tabの切り替えにpop-up buttonを使わない。

conditions: A tabbed control exposes every choice and switches with one click or tap.
exceptions: A pop-up button can be reasonable when there are too many content panes to display as tabs.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0004.review_note: Recorded the interaction-cost rationale and the many-pane exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0005.title: Avoid more than six tabs in a macOS tab view

statement.en: Avoid providing more than six tabs in a macOS tab view.
statement.ja: macOS tab viewに6個を超えるtabを設けない。

conditions: At six or more tabs, consider another interface because tab layouts can become overwhelming.
exceptions: A pop-up-button menu can present view options when the tab count is too high.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-VIEWS-0005.review_note: Preserved the source lead's more-than-six limit and recorded the earlier reconsideration threshold.

statement.en: Preserve the default system-defined menus and their expected ordering.
statement.ja: system定義のdefault menuと期待される順序を保つ。

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0001.review_note: Recorded the familiarity and system-provided behavior behind the recommendation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0002.title: Always show the same set of menu items

statement.en: Keep the same menu items visible; disable unavailable actions instead of hiding them.
statement.ja: 同じmenu itemを常に表示し、利用不可のactionは隠さず無効化する。

conditions: Visible unavailable items help people learn which actions the app supports.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0002.review_note: Confirmed the explicit Always lead and recorded disable-instead-of-hide behavior.

statement.en: Use standard keyboard shortcuts for every standard menu item the app includes.
statement.ja: appに含める各standard menu itemにはstandard keyboard shortcutを使う。

conditions: Define a custom shortcut only when necessary.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0003.review_note: Recorded shortcut familiarity and the limit on custom shortcuts.

statement.en: Prefer short, one-word menu titles.
statement.ja: 短い1語のmenu titleを優先する。

conditions: Use title-style capitalization when a menu title needs multiple words.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0004.review_note: Recorded scanability, limited menu-bar space, and the multiword capitalization fallback.

statement.en: Place About first in the app menu and separate it from following items.
statement.ja: Aboutをapp menuの先頭へ置き、後続itemとはseparatorで分ける。

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0005.review_note: Recorded both first position and the immediately following separator.

statement.en: Provide a View menu even when only some standard view functions apply.
statement.ja: standard view機能の一部しか該当しない場合でもView menuを設ける。

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0006.review_note: Preserved the even-if condition that the generated paraphrase obscured.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0007.title: Ensure show/hide menu titles reflect current view state

statement.en: Keep every show/hide menu title synchronized with the corresponding view's current visibility.
statement.ja: 各show/hide menu titleを、対応するviewの現在の表示状態と一致させる。

conditions: Use Show when hidden and Hide when visible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0007.review_note: Confirmed the explicit Ensure lead and its state-dependent title behavior.

statement.en: List custom commands in app-specific menu bar menus.
statement.ja: custom commandをapp固有のmenu bar menuへ掲載する。

conditions: Include commands even when they also appear elsewhere in the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0008.review_note: Recorded discoverability, keyboard-shortcut, and Full Keyboard Access benefits.

statement.en: Order app-specific menus from most to least general or commonly used.
statement.ja: app固有menuを、より一般的または頻繁に使うものから順に並べる。

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0009.review_note: Replaced the awkward generated Aim paraphrase while retaining SHOULD.

statement.en: Provide a Window menu even for a single-window app.
statement.ja: single-window appでもWindow menuを設ける。

conditions: Include Minimize and Zoom for people using Full Keyboard Access.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0010.review_note: Recorded the single-window condition and keyboard-access rationale.

statement.en: Consider Window-menu items for showing and hiding app panels.
statement.ja: app panelの表示と非表示を切り替えるWindow menu itemを検討する。

exceptions: Font and text-color panels already belong in the Format menu.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0011.review_note: Retained optional strength and recorded the Format-menu exception.

statement.en: Avoid making a hidden dynamic menu item the only route to a task.
statement.ja: hidden dynamic menu itemをtaskへの唯一の経路にしない。

conditions: Provide another route for every task offered by a dynamic item.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0012.review_note: Recorded the discoverability rationale and alternate-path requirement.

statement.en: Use dynamic menu items primarily in menu bar menus.
statement.ja: dynamic menu itemは主にmenu bar menuで使う。

conditions: Contextual and Dock menus make dynamic items harder to discover.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0013.review_note: Recorded the contextual-menu and Dock-menu discoverability tradeoff.

statement.en: Consider grouping related iPad menu items into submenus to conserve vertical space.
statement.ja: iPadではvertical spaceを節約するため、関連するmenu itemのsubmenu化を検討する。

conditions: iPad menu rows are taller for touch and some iPad screens are smaller.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0014.review_note: Recorded the iPad-specific touch-target and screen-size rationale.

statement.en: Consider a symbol for a macOS menu bar extra.
statement.ja: macOS menu bar extraにはsymbolの使用を検討する。

conditions: Use a clear shape the system can adapt across menu-bar appearances and selection states.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0015.review_note: Retained optional strength and recorded system adaptation context.

statement.en: Prefer a menu over a popover when people click a macOS menu bar extra.
statement.ja: macOS menu bar extraのclick時はpopoverよりmenuを優先する。

exceptions: A popover can fit functionality too complex for a menu.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0016.review_note: Kept SHOULD because the supporting prose explicitly permits a complexity exception.

statement.en: Let people choose whether to add the app's macOS menu bar extra.
statement.ja: macOS menu bar extraを追加するかは利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Offer the choice in settings and consider exposing it during setup.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0017.review_note: Repaired the generated grammar and preserved explicit user choice.

statement.en: Avoid depending on the presence or position of macOS menu bar extras.
statement.ja: macOS menu bar extraの存在や位置に依存しない。

conditions: The system can hide extras and their positions vary with people's choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0018.review_note: Recorded both visibility and unpredictable-position risks.

statement.en: Consider exposing menu-bar-extra functions through another persistent entry point.
statement.ja: menu bar extraの機能を別の永続的な入口からも提供することを検討する。

conditions: A Dock menu remains available while the app is running.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0019.review_note: Repaired the generated grammar and recorded the Dock-menu example.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0020.title: Represent menu item actions with familiar icons

statement.en: Use familiar system icons for common menu-item actions.
statement.ja: 一般的なmenu itemのactionには、馴染みのあるsystem iconを使う。

conditions: Use the same system icon wherever actions like Copy, Share, or Delete appear.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0020.review_note: Recovered the omitted actionable lead and recorded its system-icon consistency context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0021.title: Place Find items according to the searched content

statement.en: Place Find commands in the menu that best matches the searched content.
statement.ja: Find commandは検索対象のcontentに最も合うmenuへ配置する。

conditions: File can fit better than Edit when people search for files or objects.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0021.review_note: Recovered the omitted Determine lead and preserved the context-dependent placement decision.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0022.title: Reflect the app hierarchy in app-specific menus

statement.en: Reflect the app's content hierarchy in app-specific menu ordering wherever practical.
statement.ja: 可能な限り、app固有menuの順序にcontent hierarchyを反映する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0022.review_note: Recovered the omitted qualified recommendation without raising it to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0023.title: Require only one modifier key for a dynamic menu item

statement.en: Require exactly one modifier key to reveal a dynamic menu item.
statement.ja: dynamic menu itemの表示に必要なmodifier keyは1つだけにする。

conditions: Multiple keys reduce discoverability and can be physically awkward while choosing a menu item.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0023.review_note: Recovered the omitted explicit Require lead and classified it as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0024.title: Ensure full-screen iPad app functions remain accessible through the UI

statement.en: Ensure every iPad app function remains accessible through its UI when the full-screen menu bar is hidden.
statement.ja: full-screenでmenu barが隠れても、iPad appの全機能へUIからアクセスできるようにする。

conditions: Always provide another path for dynamic items available only with a hardware keyboard.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0024.review_note: Restored the truncated iPadOS lead and classified its explicit Ensure instruction as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0025.title: Reserve YourAppName > Settings for iPadOS Settings

statement.en: Reserve YourAppName > Settings for opening the app's page in iPadOS Settings.
statement.ja: YourAppName > Settingsは、iPadOS Settings内のapp pageを開く用途に限定する。

conditions: Link internal preferences with a separate item below Settings in the same group.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0025.review_note: Recovered the omitted Reserve lead and recorded the separate internal-preferences path.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0026.title: Consider adding iPad app tabs to the View menu

statement.en: For tab-style iPad apps, consider adding each tab to the View menu.
statement.ja: tab-styleのiPad appでは、各tabをView menuへ追加することを検討する。

conditions: Consider assigning key bindings when tabs also appear in the View menu.
HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0026.review_note: Recovered the conditional Consider lead and retained MAY strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0001.title: Use a toggle for two opposing state values

statement.en: Use a toggle only for two opposing values that change content or view state.
statement.ja: contentまたはviewの状態を変える、対立する2値にのみtoggleを使う。

exceptions: Use another component for actions such as choosing from a list.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0001.review_note: Restored the truncated state-management scope and the nonbinary-action exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0002.title: Make toggle states visually obvious

statement.en: Make each toggle state visually obvious without relying on color alone.
statement.ja: 色だけに依存せず、toggleの各状態を視覚的に明確にする。

conditions: Combine color with fill, shape, checkmark, dot, or another perceivable difference.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0002.review_note: Confirmed the explicit Make sure lead and recorded the color-perception constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0003.title: Use switch style only in iOS or iPadOS list rows

statement.en: Use the iOS or iPadOS switch style only in a list row.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのswitch styleはlist row内でのみ使う。

conditions: The row content supplies the context, so a separate switch label is unnecessary.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0003.review_note: Recorded the list-row scope and contextual-label rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0004.title: Avoid a separate purpose label for an icon toggle button

statement.en: Avoid a separate purpose label for an icon-based toggle button.
statement.ja: iconを使うtoggle buttonにはpurpose説明用の別labelを付けない。

conditions: Use a clear icon and distinct active and inactive backgrounds to communicate purpose and state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0004.review_note: Scoped the avoidance to the icon-based button pattern described by the surrounding iOS guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0005.title: Place macOS toggle controls in the window body

statement.en: Place macOS switches, checkboxes, and radio buttons in the window body, not its frame.
statement.ja: macOSのswitch、checkbox、radio buttonはwindow frameではなくwindow bodyへ置く。

conditions: Avoid these controls in toolbars and status bars in particular.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0005.review_note: Recorded the toolbar and status-bar exclusions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0006.title: Prefer a macOS switch for emphasized settings

statement.en: Prefer a macOS switch when a setting needs emphasis or controls substantial functionality.
statement.ja: 強調が必要、または大きな機能を制御するmacOS settingにはswitchを優先する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0006.review_note: Recorded the switch's greater visual weight and broader-control use case.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0007.title: Use macOS checkboxes for setting hierarchies

statement.en: Use macOS checkboxes to present a hierarchy of settings.
statement.ja: settingのhierarchy表示にはmacOS checkboxを使う。

conditions: Use alignment and indentation to communicate grouping and dependencies.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0007.review_note: Recorded the hierarchy, grouping, and dependency rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0008.title: Consider radio buttons for more than two mutually exclusive options

statement.en: Consider macOS radio buttons for more than two mutually exclusive options.
statement.ja: 3つ以上の排他的optionにはmacOS radio buttonを検討する。

conditions: Use unique labels to clarify choices beyond on and off.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0008.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the more-than-two threshold.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0009.title: Consider a label for an unclear checkbox group

statement.en: Consider a group label when checkbox relationships are unclear.
statement.ja: checkbox間の関係が不明瞭な場合はgroup labelを検討する。

conditions: Describe the options and align the label baseline with the first checkbox.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0009.review_note: Recorded the label-content and alignment details.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0010.title: Prefer macOS radio buttons for mutually exclusive choices

statement.en: Prefer macOS radio buttons for mutually exclusive choices.
statement.ja: 排他的なchoiceにはmacOS radio buttonを優先する。

exceptions: Use checkboxes when people may choose multiple options.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0011.title: Avoid more than about five radio buttons in one set

statement.en: Avoid presenting more than about five radio buttons in one set.
statement.ja: 1つのsetに約5個を超えるradio buttonを並べない。

exceptions: Consider a pop-up button when presenting more than about five options.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0011.review_note: Recorded the approximate five-option threshold and pop-up-button alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0012.title: Space horizontal macOS radio buttons consistently

statement.en: Space horizontal radio buttons consistently using the longest label's required width.
statement.ja: horizontal radio buttonは最長labelの必要幅を基準に等間隔で配置する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0013.title: Clearly identify what a toggle affects

statement.en: Clearly identify the setting, view, or content affected by a toggle.
statement.ja: toggleが影響するsetting、view、contentを明確に示す。

conditions: Use surrounding context, a state label, or an icon that communicates purpose.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0013.review_note: Recovered the omitted Clearly lead and recorded the context, label, and icon techniques.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0014.title: Change a switch's default color only when necessary

statement.en: Change an iOS or iPadOS switch's default color only when necessary.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOS switchのdefault colorは必要な場合だけ変更する。

conditions: An accent color can work when it contrasts enough with the uncolored state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0014.review_note: Recovered the omitted Change lead and recorded the contrast constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0015.title: Use a toggle button outside an iOS or iPadOS list

statement.en: Outside a list, use a toggle button instead of an iOS or iPadOS switch.
statement.ja: list外ではiOSまたはiPadOS switchではなくtoggle buttonを使う。

conditions: Use a distinct appearance, such as a background highlight, for the active state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0015.review_note: Recovered the omitted contextual Use lead and recorded the state-appearance requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0016.title: Consider a mini switch in a grouped macOS form

statement.en: Within a grouped macOS form, consider a mini switch for a single-row setting.
statement.ja: grouped macOS form内のsingle-row settingにはmini switchを検討する。

conditions: A mini switch can keep row heights consistent with neighboring controls.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0016.review_note: Recovered the conditional Consider lead and retained MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0017.title: Avoid replacing an existing macOS checkbox with a switch

statement.en: Avoid replacing an existing macOS checkbox with a switch without a clear reason.
statement.ja: 明確な理由なく既存のmacOS checkboxをswitchへ置き換えない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0017.review_note: Recovered the qualified prohibition and retained AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0018.title: Accurately show each macOS checkbox state

statement.en: Accurately show each macOS checkbox as on, off, or mixed.
statement.ja: 各macOS checkboxをon、off、mixedの正しい状態で表示する。

conditions: Show mixed when subordinate checkboxes have different states.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0018.review_note: Recovered the omitted state-reflection lead and recorded the mixed-state condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0019.title: Prefer a macOS checkbox for one on-or-off setting

statement.en: Prefer a macOS checkbox for one setting that can be on or off.
statement.ja: 1つのon/off settingにはmacOS checkboxを優先する。

exceptions: Use two labeled radio buttons when one checkbox cannot communicate the opposing states clearly.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOGGLES-0019.review_note: Recovered the contextual Prefer lead and recorded the rare two-radio-button exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0017.title: Prioritize essential iOS toolbar items

statement.en: Prioritize only essential iOS items in the main toolbar; move additional items to More.
statement.ja: iOSのmain toolbarではessential itemを優先し、追加itemはMoreへ移す。

conditions: When space is limited, show essential items first and place extras in More.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0017.review_note: Scoped the guidance to limited iOS toolbar space and recorded the More fallback.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0018.title: Use a large iOS title to preserve orientation

statement.en: Use an iOS large title to preserve orientation during navigation and scrolling.
statement.ja: navigationやscroll中のorientation維持にはiOSのlarge titleを使う。

conditions: The title becomes standard while scrolling and returns to large at the top.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0018.review_note: Recorded the automatic large-to-standard transition described by the supporting prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0019.title: Consider combining an iPadOS toolbar and tab bar

statement.en: Consider sharing the iPadOS top bar between a toolbar and tab bar.
statement.ja: iPadOSのtop barをtoolbarとtab barで共有することを検討する。

conditions: This can preserve content width when the app has few main areas.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0019.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the small-area-count and content-width rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0020.title: Expose every macOS toolbar item as a menu-bar command

statement.en: Expose every macOS toolbar item as a menu-bar command.
statement.ja: すべてのmacOS toolbar itemをmenu bar commandとして提供する。

conditions: A hidden or customized toolbar must not be the only command path.
exceptions: Not every menu-bar command needs a corresponding toolbar item.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0020.review_note: Kept SHOULD because the source says Make, not an explicit unconditional requirement marker.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0021.title: Prefer the system-provided visionOS toolbar

statement.en: Prefer the system-provided visionOS toolbar.
statement.ja: visionOSではsystem-provided toolbarを優先する。

conditions: The system positions the toolbar and supports eye and hand input.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0021.review_note: Recorded the system placement and input-support rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0022.title: Avoid vertical toolbars in visionOS

statement.en: Avoid vertical toolbars in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSではvertical toolbarを避ける。

conditions: A vertical toolbar can be mistaken for a tab bar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0022.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the tab-bar ambiguity.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0023.title: Avoid pull-down menus in visionOS toolbars

statement.en: Avoid pull-down menus in visionOS toolbars.
statement.ja: visionOS toolbarではpull-down menuを避ける。

conditions: They can be hard to discover, add clutter, and obscure controls below.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0023.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the discoverability, clutter, and occlusion risks.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0024.title: Use a scrolling watchOS toolbar button for a related important action

statement.en: Use a watchOS scrolling toolbar button for an important action that is not a primary app function.
statement.ja: appのprimary functionではない重要actionにはwatchOS scrolling toolbar buttonを使う。

conditions: The action relates to the view's purpose without matching its primary function.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0024.review_note: Recorded the distinction between a view-related action and the app's primary function.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0025.title: Keep visionOS windows at least as wide as their toolbar

statement.en: Keep visionOS windows wide enough to preserve reliable access to every toolbar control.
statement.ja: すべてのtoolbar controlへ確実にアクセスできる幅をvisionOS windowに保つ。

conditions: Without an app menu bar, the toolbar keeps essential controls accessible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0025.review_note: Recovered the omitted Try lead and retained SHOULD rather than an unconditional requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0026.title: Consider context-specific toolbar controls for a visionOS modal state

statement.en: When a visionOS app enters a modal state, consider context-specific toolbar controls.
statement.ja: visionOS appがmodal stateへ入る場合、context-specificなtoolbar controlを検討する。

conditions: Restore the standard toolbar after leaving the modal state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0026.review_note: Recovered the omitted conditional Consider lead and retained MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0001.title: Give people a direct path to Top Shelf content

statement.en: Use Top Shelf to give people a direct path to relevant content.
statement.ja: Top Shelfから関連contentへ直接進めるようにする。

conditions: Carousel actions and carousel details provide playback and More Info buttons by default.
Use playback as primary and More Info to open app details.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0001.review_note: Recorded the default playback and More Info paths from the supporting prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0002.title: Avoid emphasizing advertisements or prices in Top Shelf

statement.en: Avoid emphasizing advertisements or prices in Top Shelf.
statement.ja: Top Shelfでadvertisementやpriceを強調しない。

conditions: Keep the focus on new and engaging content.
exceptions: Purchasable content is acceptable; consider showing prices only after people express interest.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0002.review_note: Preserved the purchasable-content and interest-triggered-price qualifications.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0003.title: Avoid implying interactivity in a static Top Shelf image

statement.en: Avoid implying interactivity in a static Top Shelf image.
statement.ja: static Top Shelf imageでinteractivityを示唆しない。

conditions: A static Top Shelf image is not focusable.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0004.title: Provide a succinct carousel-actions title

statement.en: Provide a succinct title for a Top Shelf carousel-actions item.
statement.ja: Top Shelf carousel-actions itemに簡潔なtitleを付ける。

conditions: Use the content title, such as a show, movie, or photo album name.
exceptions: A brief subtitle is optional when it adds useful context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0004.review_note: Recorded the supported title forms and optional brief subtitle.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0005.title: Identify the playing content in a carousel-details title

statement.en: Provide a carousel-details title that identifies the currently playing content.
statement.ja: carousel-details titleで現在再生中のcontentを特定する。

conditions: Place the title near the top for glanceable reading.
exceptions: A succinct phrase or app attribution may appear above the title.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0005.review_note: Recorded title placement and the optional phrase or attribution.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0006.title: Fill a complete Top Shelf sectioned content row

statement.en: Provide enough content to fill a complete Top Shelf sectioned content row.
statement.ja: Top Shelf sectioned content rowを満たす十分なcontentを用意する。

conditions: Load enough images to span the full screen width and include at least one label.
Poster assets: 404×608 pt actual, 380×570 pt focused, 333×570 pt unfocused at 1×.
At 2×, use 808×1216, 760×1140, and 666×1140 px for poster states.
Square assets: 608×608 pt actual, 570×570 pt focused, 500×500 pt unfocused at 1×.
At 2×, use 1216×1216, 1140×1140, and 1000×1000 px for square states.
16:9 assets: 908×512 pt actual, 852×479 pt focused, 782×440 pt unfocused at 1×.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0006.review_note: Recorded the complete-row minimum, label requirement, and three structured image-size tables.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0007.title: Account for scaling when mixing Top Shelf image sizes

statement.en: Account for automatic height scaling when mixing Top Shelf image sizes.
statement.ja: Top Shelf image sizeを混在させる場合は自動的なheight scalingを考慮する。

conditions: Images match the tallest row item; a 16:9 image reaches 500 pixels beside poster or square assets.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0007.review_note: Replaced the vague generated statement and recorded the documented scaling example.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0008.title: Provide three to eight scrolling inset banners

statement.en: Provide three to eight images in a Top Shelf scrolling inset banner.
statement.ja: Top Shelf scrolling inset bannerに3〜8枚のimageを用意する。

conditions: At least three images make the banner effective; more than eight makes specific images hard to reach.
Banner assets: 1940×692 pt actual, 1740×620 pt focused, 1740×560 pt unfocused at 1×.
At 2×, use 3880×1384, 3480×1240, and 3480×1120 px for banner states.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0008.review_note: Recorded both navigation limits and the structured banner image-size table.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0009.title: Feature new or upcoming Top Shelf content

statement.en: Feature new or upcoming content in Top Shelf.
statement.ja: Top Shelfでは新規または今後のcontentを取り上げる。

conditions: Examples include new releases, episodes, upcoming movies, and shows.
exceptions: Avoid promoting content people already purchased, rented, or watched.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0009.review_note: Recovered the omitted Feature lead and recorded its examples and stale-content exclusion.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0010.title: Personalize favorite Top Shelf content

statement.en: Personalize the favorite content an app supplies to Top Shelf.
statement.ja: appがTop Shelfへ提供するfavorite contentをpersonalizeする。

conditions: Use targeted recommendations, resume media playback, or return people to active gameplay.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0010.review_note: Recovered the omitted Personalize lead and recorded the supported continuation experiences.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0011.title: Showcase compelling dynamic Top Shelf content

statement.en: Showcase compelling dynamic content that encourages people to explore Top Shelf.
statement.ja: Top Shelfで探索を促す魅力的なdynamic contentを目立たせる。

conditions: Prefer current or highly rated content and layered images.
exceptions: Static images are acceptable when dynamic content is unavailable.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0011.review_note: Recovered the omitted Showcase lead and recorded the layered-image preference and static fallback.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0012.title: Supply a static fallback when full-screen Top Shelf content is unavailable

statement.en: When full-screen Top Shelf content is unavailable, supply at least one static fallback image.
statement.ja: full-screen Top Shelf contentが利用できない場合、static fallback imageを1枚以上用意する。

conditions: The system shows the fallback while the app is focused in the Dock.
tvOS flips and blurs the fallback to fit 1920 pixels at 16:9.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0012.review_note: Recovered the conditional Supply lead and recorded the fallback presentation and structured asset size.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0013.title: Add required banner text to the image and accessibility label

statement.en: When a scrolling inset banner needs text, add it to the image.
statement.ja: scrolling inset bannerにtextが必要な場合はimageへ追加する。

conditions: Also include the text in the image accessibility label for VoiceOver.
In layered images, consider placing text on a dedicated upper layer.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOP-SHELF-0013.review_note: Recovered the conditional Add lead and recorded the VoiceOver and layered-image requirements.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0007.title: Consider a gesture for opening iPadOS content in a new window

statement.en: Consider letting people use a gesture to open iPadOS content in a new window.
statement.ja: gestureでiPadOS contentを新しいwindowへ開けるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: A pinch gesture can expand an item into a new window.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0007.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the documented pinch interaction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0009.title: Avoid critical content or actions in a macOS bottom bar

statement.en: Avoid placing critical information or actions in a macOS window's bottom bar.
statement.ja: macOS windowのbottom barにcritical informationやactionを置かない。

conditions: People can relocate a window so its bottom edge becomes hidden.
exceptions: Use a bottom bar only for a small amount of directly related information.
Use an inspector when more information needs presentation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0009.review_note: Restored the truncated bottom-edge risk and recorded both limited-use and inspector alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0010.title: Prefer a visionOS window for familiar interfaces and tasks

statement.en: Prefer a visionOS window for familiar interfaces and tasks.
statement.ja: familiar interfaceやtaskにはvisionOS windowを優先する。

exceptions: Consider a volume for bounded 3D content such as a game board.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0010.review_note: Recorded the familiar-interface rationale and bounded-3D volume alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0011.title: Minimize empty space in the initial visionOS window size

statement.en: Choose an initial visionOS window size that minimizes empty areas.
statement.ja: empty areaを最小化するinitial visionOS window sizeを選ぶ。

conditions: A visionOS window defaults to 1280×720 pt and initially appears about two meters away.
At two meters, its apparent width is about three meters.
Excess empty space enlarges the window and obscures other spatial content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0011.review_note: Recorded the default size, initial placement, apparent width, and spatial-obstruction rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0012.title: Match the initial visionOS window shape to its content

statement.en: Choose an initial visionOS window shape that suits its content.
statement.ja: contentに合うinitial visionOS window shapeを選ぶ。

conditions: Wide content suits wide windows; vertically extended content suits taller windows.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0012.review_note: Repaired the generic Aim paraphrase and recorded the content-shape relationship.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0013.title: Set minimum and maximum sizes for each visionOS window

statement.en: Choose minimum and maximum sizes that keep each visionOS window usable.
statement.ja: 各visionOS windowがusableな状態を保つminimum sizeとmaximum sizeを選ぶ。

conditions: Keep layouts from overlapping when small or becoming unusable when large.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0013.review_note: Recorded the resize range and its small-overlap and large-usability failure modes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0014.title: Minimize 3D content depth in a visionOS window

statement.en: Minimize the depth of 3D content displayed in a visionOS window.
statement.ja: visionOS window内の3D contentのdepthを最小化する。

conditions: The system clips 3D content that extends too far from the window surface.
exceptions: Use a volume for content that needs greater depth.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0014.review_note: Recorded the system clipping behavior and volume alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0015.title: Prefer a visionOS volume for rich 3D content

statement.en: Prefer a visionOS volume for rich 3D content.
statement.ja: rich 3D contentにはvisionOS volumeを優先する。

exceptions: Prefer a window for familiar, UI-centric interfaces.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0015.review_note: Recorded the volume and window content-type distinction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0016.title: Place 2D volume content for viewing from multiple angles

statement.en: Place 2D content in a visionOS volume so it works from multiple viewing angles.
statement.ja: visionOS volume内の2D contentを複数angleから見ても機能する位置へ置く。

conditions: Use an attachment to pin 2D content to a specific 3D area.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0016.review_note: Recorded the perspective-change risk and attachment technique.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0017.title: Consider high-value volume content in a visionOS ornament

statement.en: Consider presenting high-value visionOS volume content in an ornament.
statement.ja: high-valueなvisionOS volume contentをornamentで表示することを検討する。

conditions: In visionOS 2 or later, an ornament can reduce clutter and elevate important controls.
An attachment anchor keeps the ornament viewer-relative while people move around the volume.
Avoid placing an ornament on the toolbar or tab-bar edge.
Prefer only one additional ornament to avoid overshadowing volume content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0017.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded version, anchor, edge, and ornament-count constraints.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0018.title: Align a visionOS volume for its interaction pattern

statement.en: Choose a visionOS volume alignment that supports its interaction pattern.
statement.ja: interaction patternを支えるvisionOS volume alignmentを選ぶ。

conditions: Floor-parallel alignment suits content with little interaction.
Viewer-facing tilt can keep interactive content usable while the viewer reclines.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0019.title: Retain the visionOS window glass background

statement.en: Retain the default glass background in a visionOS window.
statement.ja: visionOS windowのdefault glass backgroundを維持する。

conditions: Glass adapts to lighting and communicates window scale and position.
Removing glass reduces legibility and perceived relationships between UI elements.
An opaque background obscures surroundings and can make the window feel constricting.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0019.review_note: Recovered the omitted Retain lead and recorded the glass-material rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0020.title: Generally use dynamic scaling for a visionOS volume

statement.en: Generally use dynamic scaling for visionOS volume content.
statement.ja: visionOS volume contentには通常dynamic scalingを使う。

conditions: Dynamic scaling preserves legibility and interaction at greater viewing distances.
exceptions: Use fixed scaling for real-world objects when preserving physical scale matters.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0020.review_note: Recovered the qualified Use lead and preserved the fixed-scaling exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0021.title: Use the default visionOS baseplate to reveal volume edges

statement.en: Use the default visionOS baseplate appearance to help people discern a volume's edges.
statement.ja: default visionOS baseplate appearanceでvolumeのedgeを認識しやすくする。

conditions: In visionOS 2 or later, the system adds a gentle glow when people look at the baseplate.
The glow helps expose edges and the resize control when content doesn't fill the volume.
exceptions: Full-bleed content or a custom baseplate may not need the default glow.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0021.review_note: Recovered the omitted Take advantage lead and recorded the glow behavior and exceptions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0016.title: Keep tvOS app-icon content inside a safe zone

statement.en: Include a safe zone that keeps tvOS app-icon content visible during focus effects.
statement.ja: focus effect中もtvOS app-icon contentが見えるsafe zoneを設ける。

conditions: The system may crop icon edges while the focused icon scales and moves.
Safe-zone size varies with image size, layer depth, and motion.
The system crops foreground layers more than background layers.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0016.review_note: Recorded the focus-cropping behavior and the variables that affect safe-zone size.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0017.title: Avoid concave shapes in a visionOS app-icon background

statement.en: Avoid shapes intended to look concave or hollow in a visionOS app-icon background.
statement.ja: visionOS app-icon backgroundでconcaveまたはhollowに見せるshapeを避ける。

conditions: System shadows and specular highlights can make the shape protrude instead of recede.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0017.review_note: Recorded the system-effect reversal that makes concave background shapes misleading.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0018.title: Avoid a black watchOS app-icon background

statement.en: Avoid using black for a watchOS app-icon background.
statement.ja: watchOS app-icon backgroundにblackを使わない。

conditions: Lighten a black background so the icon doesn't blend into the display background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0018.review_note: Recorded the display-background blending risk and lightening mitigation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0017.title: Consider a limited tvOS palette coordinated with the app logo

statement.en: Consider a limited tvOS color palette that coordinates with the app logo.
statement.ja: app logoと調和する限定的なtvOS color paletteを検討する。

conditions: Use color subtly to communicate brand while deferring to content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0017.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the content-first branding rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0018.title: Avoid indicating tvOS focus with color alone

statement.en: Avoid using color as the only indication of tvOS focus.
statement.ja: tvOS focusをcolorだけで示さない。

conditions: Use subtle scaling and responsive animation as primary focus cues.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0018.review_note: Recorded the noncolor focus cues from the supporting prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0019.title: Use color sparingly on visionOS glass

statement.en: Use color sparingly in visionOS, especially on glass material.
statement.ja: visionOS、特にglass materialではcolorを控えめに使う。

conditions: Physical and virtual colors visible through glass can reduce colorful content legibility.
Use color to emphasize important information or relationships between interface parts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0019.review_note: Recorded the glass-transmission legibility risk and intended emphasis cases.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0020.title: Prefer visionOS color in bold text and large areas

statement.en: Prefer using color in bold visionOS text and large areas.
statement.ja: visionOSではbold textとlarge areaでcolorを使うことを優先する。

conditions: Color in lightweight text or small areas can be harder to perceive and understand.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0020.review_note: Recorded the lightweight-text and small-area perception risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0021.title: Use watchOS background color to communicate information

statement.en: Use watchOS background color to support content or communicate additional information.
statement.ja: watchOS background colorでcontentを支え、追加informationを伝える。

conditions: Background color can establish place and help people recognize key content.
exceptions: Don't use background color solely as visual decoration.
Avoid full-screen color in workout or audio views that remain visible for long periods.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0021.review_note: Recorded the communication purpose and both decoration and long-duration restrictions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0022.title: Balance brightness in fully immersive visionOS experiences

statement.en: Balance brightness levels to preserve visual comfort in a fully immersive visionOS experience.
statement.ja: fully immersive visionOS experienceではbrightness levelを均衡させてvisual comfortを保つ。

conditions: High contrast can cause discomfort after people's eyes adapt to low light.
Make content fully bright only when the surrounding visual context is also bright.
exceptions: Avoid bright flashing or moving objects against very dark backgrounds.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0022.review_note: Recovered the contextual Help lead and recorded the adaptation and contrast constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0023.title: Account for tinted-mode graphic complications

statement.en: Account for people preferring tinted mode in watchOS graphic complications.
statement.ja: watchOS graphic complicationでtinted modeを好む人を考慮する。

conditions: Tinted mode applies one wearer-selected color to images, gauges, and text.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0023.review_note: Recovered the omitted Recognize lead and recorded the system's single-color behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0008.title: Design simple macOS document-icon imagery

statement.en: Design simple macOS document-icon images that clearly communicate the document type.
statement.ja: document typeを明確に伝えるsimpleなmacOS document-icon imageを設計する。

conditions: Prefer uncomplicated shapes and a reduced palette of distinct colors.
Keep the design recognizable down to 16×16 px.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0008.review_note: Recorded the shape, palette, and minimum rendered-size constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0009.title: Consider simplifying small macOS document icons

statement.en: Consider reducing complexity in small versions of a macOS document icon.
statement.ja: small versionのmacOS document iconではcomplexity低減を検討する。

conditions: Use fewer or thicker details at intermediate sizes.
Remove details that become unclear at 16×16 px.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0009.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the source's size-specific simplification techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0010.title: Avoid important content beneath the document-icon fold

statement.en: Avoid important content in the top-right corner of a macOS document-icon background.
statement.ja: macOS document-icon backgroundのtop-right cornerにimportant contentを置かない。

conditions: The system masks the image and draws a white folded corner over it.
Background assets: 512×512 px at 1× or 1024×1024 px at 2×.
Background assets: 256×256 px at 1× or 512×512 px at 2×.
Background assets: 128×128 px at 1× or 256×256 px at 2×.
Background assets: 32×32 px at 1× or 64×64 px at 2×.
Background assets: 16×16 px at 1× or 32×32 px at 2×.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0010.review_note: Recorded the fold-mask obstruction and every documented background asset size.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0011.title: Keep most center imagery inside a 10% margin

statement.en: Define a 10% margin and keep most macOS document center imagery within it.
statement.ja: 10% marginを定義し、macOS document center imageの大半を内側へ収める。

conditions: Let the image occupy about 80% of its canvas.
A 256×256 px canvas yields an approximately 205×205 px main-image area.
exceptions: Extend small parts into the margin when optical alignment needs it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0011.review_note: Recorded the 10% margin, 80% occupancy, numeric example, and optical-alignment exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0012.title: Consider a familiar-object center image for a document icon

statement.en: When a familiar object conveys a document type or app connection, consider using it as the center image.
statement.ja: familiar objectがdocument typeやapp connectionを伝える場合、center imageへの使用を検討する。

conditions: Keep the center image simple, unambiguous, and recognizable at every size.
Make the center-image canvas half the overall document-icon size.
Center assets: 256×256 px at 1× or 512×512 px at 2×.
Center assets: 128×128 px at 1× or 256×256 px at 2×.
Center assets: 32×32 px at 1× or 64×64 px at 2×.
Center assets: 16×16 px at 1× or 32×32 px at 2×.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0012.review_note: Restored the truncated condition and recorded every center-image size.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0014.title: Specify a succinct document term when the extension is unclear

statement.en: When a file extension is unfamiliar, specify a succinct term that clarifies the macOS document type.
statement.ja: file extensionがunfamiliarな場合、macOS document typeを明確にする簡潔なtermを指定する。

conditions: The system otherwise shows the file extension at the document icon's bottom edge.
Use a term short enough to remain legible after automatic scaling.
The system capitalizes every letter by default.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0014.review_note: Recovered the omitted Specify lead and recorded the extension, scaling, and capitalization behavior.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0007.title: Expose visual element relationships to VoiceOver

statement.en: Specify element grouping, order, and links so VoiceOver communicates relationships that are otherwise visual.
statement.ja: elementのgrouping、order、linkを指定し、visual-onlyな関係をVoiceOverへ伝える。

conditions: Audit relationships conveyed only through proximity, alignment, or other visual context.
Respect the reading order of the active language and locale.
Group related images with their respective captions.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0007.review_note: Recovered the omitted Specify lead and recorded visual-context, reading-order, and grouping requirements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention

statement.en: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention on content without hiding other experiences.
statement.ja: 他の体験を隠さずcontentへ注意を向けるため、dimmed passthroughを使う。

conditions: Use it in the Shared Space or a Full Space.
Passthrough uses black tint by default and can use a custom tint.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the attention purpose, supported spaces, and default or custom tint behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use mixed immersion for unbounded 3D experiences

statement.en: Use mixed immersion in a Full Space for unbounded 3D content blended with passthrough.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでunbounded 3D contentをpassthroughと組み合わせるにはmixed immersionを使う。

conditions: Mixed immersion has no system-defined movement boundary.
Nearby content becomes semi-opaque when a person approaches a physical object.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the Full Space scope, absent boundary, and automatic physical-object response.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use progressive immersion to blend an environment with surroundings

statement.en: Use progressive immersion when a custom environment should partially replace passthrough.
statement.ja: custom environmentでpassthroughを部分的に置き換える場合はprogressive immersionを使う。

conditions: Support portrait or landscape content where appropriate.
People adjust immersion within a 120–360 degree default range or a specified custom range.
The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded partial replacement, orientation, adjustable range, and movement-boundary context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use full immersion for a fully virtual environment

statement.en: Use full immersion for a 360-degree custom environment that completely replaces passthrough.
statement.ja: passthroughを完全に置き換える360-degree custom environmentにはfull immersionを使う。

conditions: The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary when the experience starts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded complete passthrough replacement and the system-defined movement boundary.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game

statement.en: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game.
statement.ja: immersive appやgameに複数の利用方法を用意する。

conditions: Support accessibility features people use to personalize interaction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded user choice and accessibility personalization as coequal design constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion

statement.en: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion.
statement.ja: Shared Spaceまたはmixed immersionでの起動を優先する。

conditions: Preserve switching among running experiences.
Let people choose when to increase immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded cross-app switching and user control over increased immersion.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Guide attention to key moments at every immersion level

statement.en: Help people engage with key moments at every level of immersion.
statement.ja: immersion levelにかかわらず、key momentへ利用者の注意を導く。

conditions: Start with subtle cues and strengthen them only for a documented reason.
Cues can include dimming, tinting, motion, scale, and Spatial Audio.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the cue types and subtle-first escalation strategy.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer subtle passthrough tint colors

statement.en: Prefer subtle passthrough tint colors in visionOS 2 and later.
statement.ja: visionOS 2以降ではsubtleなpassthrough tint colorを優先する。

conditions: Coordinate surroundings and visible hands with the experience.
exceptions: Avoid bright or dramatic tints that distract people or reduce immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the version scope, coordination purpose, and distracting-tint restriction.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Protect visual comfort in a Full Space

statement.en: Protect people’s visual comfort in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceで利用者のvisual comfortを守る。

conditions: Prefer placing 3D content within the field of view.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the general comfort prompt from the explicit comfortable-motion requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Choose immersion that supports expected movement

statement.en: Choose an immersion style that supports the movement people may make.
statement.ja: 利用者が行う可能性のあるmovementに対応するimmersion styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Minor movements include shifting weight, turning, and changing between sitting and standing.
Use mixed immersion when people may move beyond the approximately 1.5-meter boundary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded expected movement and the boundary-dependent mixed-style fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or full immersion

statement.en: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or fully immersive experiences.
statement.ja: progressiveまたはfully immersiveな体験でmovementを求めない。

conditions: Provide interaction methods that work without physical movement.
exceptions: Bring virtual content closer instead of requiring a person to approach it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded disability and physical-space constraints with a no-movement alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Adopt ARKit when blending content with surroundings

statement.en: Adopt ARKit when custom content needs information about a person’s surroundings.
statement.ja: custom contentで利用者の周囲情報が必要な場合はARKitを採用する。

conditions: Use surroundings or hand-position data only for the scoped experience.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the ARKit choice from the explicit permission requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Design smooth, predictable immersion transitions

statement.en: Design smooth, predictable transitions between immersion styles.
statement.ja: immersion style間をsmoothかつpredictableに遷移させる。

conditions: Use gentle transitions that let people visually track changes.
exceptions: Avoid sudden or jarring transitions that can disorient people.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded visual tracking and the disorientation risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Let people choose when to change immersion

statement.en: Let people choose when to enter or exit a more immersive experience.
statement.ja: よりimmersiveな体験へ入る時と出る時を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Provide a clear action for entering and exiting immersion.
exceptions: Avoid requiring system controls to reduce immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded explicit entry and exit actions and the system-control restriction.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer familiar virtual-hand characteristics

statement.en: Prefer virtual hands that match familiar positions, gestures, and interactions.
statement.ja: familiarな位置、gesture、interactionに一致するvirtual handsを優先する。

conditions: Support natural interaction and sustained immersion in virtual worlds.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded position and gesture matching as the familiar-characteristics basis.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use caution with oversized virtual hands

statement.en: Use caution when virtual hands are larger than the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: virtual handsを利用者の手より大きくする場合は注意する。

conditions: Avoid obscuring content or making interaction feel clumsy.
Keep virtual hands proportional to the surrounding space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded content visibility, interaction precision, and spatial-proportion risks.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Minimize distracting environmental content

statement.en: Minimize environmental content that distracts from the primary task.
statement.ja: primary taskから注意をそらすenvironmental contentを最小限にする。

conditions: Avoid excessive movement and high-contrast detail around primary content.
Use higher-quality assets in important areas and quieter assets elsewhere.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded task focus and the source's quality and dimming hierarchy techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Make environmental objects’ interactivity understandable

statement.en: Help people distinguish interactive objects in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでinteractive objectを判別できるようにする。

conditions: Use object proximity to support expectations about reach and interaction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded proximity as the documented cue for likely interactivity.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Keep environmental animation subtle

statement.en: Keep animation in a custom environment small and gentle.
statement.ja: custom environmentのanimationをsmallかつgentleに保つ。

conditions: Enrich the environment without distracting people or causing discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated subtle-animation guidance from the explicit field-of-view-edge prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Create an expansive custom environment

statement.en: Create an expansive custom environment regardless of the place it depicts.
statement.ja: 描く場所にかかわらずexpansiveなcustom environmentを作る。

conditions: Avoid spatial restriction that can cause discomfort or claustrophobia.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded spatial comfort and claustrophobia as the expansion rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use Spatial Audio to create environmental atmosphere

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to create atmosphere in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentのatmosphereを作るためSpatial Audioを使う。

conditions: Avoid excessive repetition or looping in the soundscape.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated atmospheric audio guidance from the conditional other-audio requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment

statement.en: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentで利用者がgroundedだと感じられるようにする。

conditions: Use a ground plane to provide a stable spatial reference.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the grounding goal from the explicit ground-plane requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Minimize asset redundancy in a custom environment

statement.en: Minimize repeated assets and models in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでassetやmodelの繰り返しを最小限にする。

conditions: Frequent repetition can make an environment feel less realistic.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded realism as the reason to limit repeated assets.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Reserve immersion for meaningful moments and content

statement.en: Reserve immersion for meaningful tasks, moments, and content.
statement.ja: immersionをmeaningfulなtask、moment、contentに限定する。

conditions: Keep tasks in the Shared Space when immersion adds little value.
Let people remain aware of surroundings and other software when appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded task-level proportionality and continued access to surroundings and other software.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid obscuring passthrough in mixed immersion

statement.en: When using mixed immersion, avoid obscuring too much passthrough.
statement.ja: mixed immersionではpassthroughを過度に遮らない。

conditions: Preserve enough physical context for people to understand and navigate their surroundings.
exceptions: Use progressive or full immersion when virtual objects must substantially obscure passthrough.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional AVOID lead and its safer immersion-style alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Indicate an immersive exit control’s purpose

statement.en: Indicate the purpose of an immersive-experience exit control.
statement.ja: immersive experienceのexit controlが何を行うか示す。

conditions: Differentiate reducing immersion from quitting the experience.
exceptions: Before quitting, consider pause or return controls that let people save progress.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the omitted Indicate lead and recorded both possible exit outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Fade virtual hands when hand tracking is interrupted

statement.en: When hand tracking is interrupted, fade virtual hands out and reveal the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: hand trackingが中断したらvirtual handsをfade outし、利用者自身の手を表示する。

conditions: Fade virtual hands back in when tracking returns.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional fade lead and its tracking-return transition.

conditions: Prevent motion from causing distraction, confusion, or discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered explicit comfortable-motion guidance from the supporting paragraph.

conditions: The experience uses ARKit data to blend custom content with a person’s surroundings.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit permission requirement from the ARKit supporting paragraph.

conditions: An immersive experience provides an exit control.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit outcome-clarity requirement from the exit-control supporting paragraph.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid frozen virtual hands during tracking interruption

statement.en: Avoid leaving virtual hands frozen or unresponsive when hand tracking is interrupted.
statement.ja: hand tracking中断時にvirtual handsをfrozenまたはunresponsiveな状態で残さない。

conditions: Reveal the viewer’s hands while virtual hands are unavailable.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the direct prohibition and kept it at conservative AVOID strength.

conditions: The experience displays animation in a custom environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit field-of-view-edge motion prohibition.

conditions: People can play other audio while they use the environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional soundscape-volume requirement from supporting prose.

conditions: The app or game presents a custom environment in a Full Space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit ground-plane requirement from supporting prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0007.title: Aim to support portrait and landscape on iOS

statement.en: Aim to support both portrait and landscape orientations on iOS.
statement.ja: iOSではportraitとlandscapeの両orientationへの対応を目指す。

conditions: Let people discover a single supported orientation by rotating the device.
exceptions: A task-specific experience may support only portrait or only landscape.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0007.review_note: Recorded the preferred dual-orientation support and the single-orientation exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0008.title: Prefer a full-bleed iOS game interface

statement.en: Prefer a full-bleed interface for an iOS game.
statement.ja: iOS gameではfull-bleed interfaceを優先する。

conditions: Accommodate hardware corner radius, sensor housing, and Dynamic Island.
exceptions: When necessary, consider an optional letterboxed or pillarboxed view.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0008.review_note: Recorded hardware accommodation and the optional fitted-view fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0009.title: Avoid full-width iOS buttons

statement.en: Avoid full-width buttons in iOS interfaces.
statement.ja: iOS interfaceではfull-width buttonを避ける。

conditions: Inset buttons from screen edges using system-defined margins.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0009.review_note: Separated the default AVOID guidance from the explicit necessary-button exception requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0010.title: Test iPadOS layouts at common window sizes

statement.en: Test iPadOS layouts at common system window sizes and provide smooth transitions.
statement.ja: iPadOS layoutを一般的なsystem window sizeでtestし、smoothなtransitionを提供する。

conditions: Test halves, thirds, and quadrants on multiple devices.
Cover the supported minimum-to-maximum window-size range.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0010.review_note: Recorded the system arrangements, device coverage, and full resizing range.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0011.title: Consider a convertible tab bar for iPadOS navigation

statement.en: Consider a convertible tab bar for adaptive iPadOS navigation.
statement.ja: adaptiveなiPadOS navigationにはconvertible tab barを検討する。

conditions: Let people switch between tab-bar and sidebar presentations when appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0011.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the user-switchable adaptive presentation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0012.title: Avoid critical macOS content at a window’s bottom edge

statement.en: Avoid controls and critical information at the bottom of a macOS window.
statement.ja: macOS windowのbottomにcontrolやcritical informationを置かない。

conditions: People may move the bottom edge below the screen.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0013.title: Avoid the macOS camera housing area

statement.en: Avoid displaying content within the macOS camera housing area.
statement.ja: macOSのcamera housing area内にcontentを表示しない。

conditions: The camera housing occupies the window’s top-edge region.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0013.review_note: Recorded the exact display-feature obstruction scope.
