HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0014.title: Design tvOS layouts for varied television sizes

statement.en: Design tvOS layouts to work well across varied television sizes.
statement.ja: tvOS layoutをさまざまなtelevision sizeで適切に表示できるよう設計する。

conditions: tvOS shows the same interface rather than automatically adapting it to every display.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0014.review_note: Recorded the nonadaptive display behavior and cross-size requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0015.title: Pad tvOS focusable elements for their focused size

statement.en: Include padding between tvOS focusable elements that accommodates their focused size.
statement.ja: focus時のsizeを収めるpaddingをtvOS focusable element間に設ける。

conditions: UIKit focus effects enlarge elements when they receive focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0015.review_note: Separated general focus padding from the explicit important-information non-overlap rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0016.title: Add vertical spacing around titled tvOS grid rows

statement.en: Include additional vertical spacing around titled tvOS grid rows.
statement.ja: title付きtvOS grid rowの上下に追加のvertical spacingを設ける。

conditions: Separate a title from the preceding unfocused row.
Separate the title from the following unfocused items.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0016.review_note: Recorded both title-spacing relationships despite the inherited final-grid section path.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0017.title: Use consistent tvOS grid spacing

statement.en: Use consistent spacing in tvOS grids.
statement.ja: tvOS gridでconsistentなspacingを使う。

conditions: 2 columns: 860 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
3 columns: 560 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
4 columns: 410 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
5 columns: 320 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
6 columns: 260 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
7 columns: 217 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
8 columns: 184 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
9 columns: 160 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0017.review_note: Preserved every official tvOS grid width and spacing row from the structured tables.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0018.title: Keep partially hidden tvOS grid content symmetrical

statement.en: Keep partially hidden tvOS grid content symmetrical across screen edges.
statement.ja: 部分的に隠れるtvOS grid contentをscreen edge間でsymmetricalにする。

conditions: Use equal widths for partially hidden offscreen content on both sides.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0018.review_note: Recorded the equal-width technique for directing attention to fully visible content.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0019.title: Consider centering important visionOS content and controls

statement.en: Consider centering the most important visionOS content and controls.
statement.ja: 最も重要なvisionOS contentとcontrolを中央に置くことを検討する。

conditions: Centering can improve discovery and interaction, especially in large windows.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0019.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the large-window discoverability rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0020.title: Keep visionOS window content within its bounds

statement.en: Keep visionOS window content within its XY-plane bounds.
statement.ja: visionOS window contentをXY-planeのbounds内に保つ。

conditions: Leave areas outside the window clear for sharing, resizing, moving, and closing controls.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0020.review_note: Recorded every system-control area affected by out-of-bounds 2D or 3D content.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0021.title: Make visionOS interactive components comfortable to look at

statement.en: Make visionOS interactive components easy and comfortable to look at.
statement.ja: visionOS interactive componentを見つけやすくcomfortableに見ることができるようにする。

conditions: Provide space for visual identification and the system hover effect.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0021.review_note: Separated the usability goal from the explicit enough-space requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0022.title: Extend watchOS content edge to edge

statement.en: Extend watchOS content from one screen edge to the other.
statement.ja: watchOS contentをscreenの端から端まで広げる。

conditions: Treat the Apple Watch bezel as natural visual padding.
exceptions: Consider minimizing padding between elements to preserve usable space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0022.review_note: Recorded bezel padding and the space-preserving inner-padding option.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0023.title: Avoid too many side-by-side watchOS controls

statement.en: Avoid placing more than two or three watchOS controls side by side.
statement.ja: watchOS controlを横に2個または3個より多く並べない。

conditions: Use at most three glyph buttons or two text buttons in a row as the general rule.
exceptions: Two short text buttons can work side by side when the screen does not scroll.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0023.review_note: Recorded glyph and text limits plus the short-label non-scrolling exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0024.title: Support watchOS autorotation for shareable views

statement.en: Support autorotation in watchOS views people may show to others.
statement.ja: 他者へ見せる可能性のあるwatchOS viewでautorotationをsupportする。

conditions: Examples include showing an image or presenting a QR code to a reader.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0024.review_note: Recorded the wrist-away sharing scenarios that justify autorotation.

conditions: The iOS app or game supports only landscape orientation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit two-direction landscape requirement.

conditions: A full-width button is necessary despite the general guidance to avoid it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit hardware-curvature and safe-area requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0028.title: Hide the iOS status bar only when it adds value

statement.en: Hide the iOS status bar only when doing so adds value or enhances the experience.
statement.ja: 価値を加えるか体験を高める場合にだけiOS status barを隠す。

conditions: Keep useful status information visible in ordinary app contexts.
exceptions: Deep game or media experiences may benefit from hiding it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0028.review_note: Recovered the omitted Hide lead and preserved its narrow value-based condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0029.title: Defer compact iPadOS layouts while the full layout fits

statement.en: While an iPadOS window resizes, defer compact layout until the full layout no longer fits.
statement.ja: iPadOS windowのresize中はfull layoutが収まらなくなるまでcompact layoutへの切替を遅らせる。

conditions: Design the full-screen layout first.
For complex layouts, hide tertiary columns as width narrows.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0029.review_note: Recovered the contextual Defer lead and recorded the tertiary-column technique.

conditions: A person resizes the window between its minimum and maximum supported sizes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0031.title: Adhere to the tvOS screen safe area

statement.en: Keep primary tvOS content within the screen safe area.
statement.ja: primary tvOS contentをscreen safe area内に保つ。

conditions: Inset primary content 60 points vertically and 80 points horizontally.
exceptions: Only deliberately flowing or partially displayed offscreen content may extend outside.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0031.review_note: Recovered the Adhere lead and preserved all safe-area measurements and exceptions.

conditions: A focus effect enlarges the element.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit important-information non-overlap requirement.

conditions: The interface uses a tvOS grid whose items enlarge on focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit row-and-column focus-spacing requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0034.title: Use an ornament for visionOS controls outside a window

statement.en: When controls do not belong inside a visionOS window, place them in an ornament.
statement.ja: controlがvisionOS window内に属さない場合はornamentへ配置する。

conditions: Keep controls visually associated with the window without obstructing system controls.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0034.review_note: Recovered the conditional Use lead and recorded the system-control separation purpose.

conditions: Prevent the system hover effect from obscuring other content.
The source gives 60-point center spacing as an example, not an unconditional minimum.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.review_note: Recovered the explicit spacing requirement while keeping 60 points as an example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0008.title: Keep large virtual-object motion comfortable

statement.en: Keep people comfortable when showing movement of large virtual objects in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSでlarge virtual objectのmovementを見せるとき利用者のcomfortを保つ。

conditions: Large objects may fill much of the field of view and obscure passthrough.
exceptions: Increase translucency or reduce contrast so movement is easier to perceive comfortably.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0008.review_note: Recorded field-of-view coverage, passthrough occlusion, and both comfort techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0009.title: Consider fades for relocating a visionOS object

statement.en: When object relocation communicates nothing useful, consider hiding the movement with fades.
statement.ja: object relocationが有用な情報を伝えない場合、fadeでmovementを隠すことを検討する。

conditions: Fade the object out before relocation and back in afterward.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0009.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the no-useful-information condition and two fade phases.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0010.title: Consider a stationary reference for visionOS motion

statement.en: Consider giving people a stationary frame of reference around visionOS motion.
statement.ja: visionOS motionの周囲にstationaryなreference frameを設けることを検討する。

conditions: Contain visual movement within an area that does not move.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0010.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the stationary containment that reduces discomfort.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0011.title: Avoid sustained object oscillation in visionOS

statement.en: Avoid showing visionOS objects that oscillate continuously.
statement.ja: visionOSでobjectが継続的にoscillateする表示を避ける。

conditions: Avoid frequencies around 0.2 Hz because people can be especially sensitive to them.
exceptions: When oscillation is needed, keep amplitude low and consider translucency.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0011.review_note: Recorded the 0.2 Hz sensitivity and both mitigation options.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0013.title: Avoid visionOS motion at field-of-view edges

statement.en: Wherever practicable, avoid motion at the edges of a person’s visionOS field of view.
statement.ja: 可能な限りvisionOSのfield of view端でmotionを表示しない。

conditions: Peripheral motion can distract people or create a false sense of self or environmental movement.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0013.review_note: Preserved the practicability qualifier and peripheral-vision comfort rationale.

conditions: An immersive visionOS experience needs to show an object moving in peripheral vision.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit brightness-matching requirement within the edge-motion exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0001.title: Avoid head-anchored visionOS content

statement.en: Avoid anchoring visionOS content to the wearer’s head.
statement.ja: visionOS contentを利用者のheadにanchorしない。

conditions: Head anchoring can feel confining and reduce the apparent stability of surroundings.
exceptions: Anchor content in a person’s space so they can look around naturally.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0001.review_note: Recorded the confinement and stability risks plus the spatial-anchor alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0002.title: Communicate virtual-content depth accurately

statement.en: Provide visual cues that accurately communicate virtual-content depth.
statement.ja: virtual contentのdepthを正確に伝えるvisual cueを提供する。

conditions: Missing or conflicting real-world depth cues can cause visual discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0002.review_note: Recorded the real-world cue consistency and visual-comfort requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0003.title: Use visionOS depth to communicate hierarchy

statement.en: Use visionOS depth to communicate hierarchy and prominence.
statement.ja: visionOS depthでhierarchyとprominenceを伝える。

conditions: Use depth changes to distinguish foreground elements from surrounding content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0003.review_note: Recorded prominence and depth-change perception as the hierarchy mechanisms.

conditions: Prefer depth for large, important interface elements.
Review repeated depth changes because refocusing can be tiring.
exceptions: Avoid depth that reduces legibility or usability on small objects.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.review_note: Replaced generic conditions with the source's value, scale, legibility, and refocusing limits.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0005.title: Consider fixed scale for life-size virtual objects

statement.en: Consider fixed scale when a virtual object must look like its physical counterpart.
statement.ja: virtual objectをphysical counterpartと同じように見せる場合はfixed scaleを検討する。

conditions: Use fixed scale sparingly and prefer it for noninteractive objects.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0005.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the life-size, sparse-use, and noninteractive conditions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0006.title: Avoid too many visionOS windows

statement.en: Avoid displaying too many visionOS windows at once.
statement.ja: visionOS windowを一度に過剰表示しない。

conditions: Preserve visibility of surroundings and avoid overwhelm or constriction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0006.review_note: Recorded surroundings visibility, comfort, and multiwindow relocation costs.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0007.title: Prioritize standard indirect visionOS gestures

statement.en: Prioritize standard indirect gestures in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSではstandard indirect gestureを優先する。

conditions: Indirect gestures work across object distances without raising a hand into view.
exceptions: Consider direct gestures for nearby objects used briefly for close inspection or manipulation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0007.review_note: Recorded fatigue, distance, familiarity, and the limited direct-gesture exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0008.title: Space visionOS interactive components for comfortable gaze

statement.en: Include enough space around visionOS interactive components for easy, comfortable gaze selection.
statement.ja: visionOS interactive componentの周囲にeasyでcomfortableなgaze selection用spaceを設ける。

conditions: Prevent hover effects from crowding other content.
exceptions: The source gives 60-point centers and 16-point gaps as examples, not unconditional minima.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0008.review_note: Recorded gaze and hover behavior without promoting example measurements to universal thresholds.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0009.title: Support stationary use of a visionOS app

statement.en: Let people use a visionOS app with minimal or no physical movement.
statement.ja: visionOS appをminimalまたはno physical movementで使えるようにする。

conditions: Support stationary use unless physical movement is essential to the experience.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0009.review_note: Recorded the stationary-accessibility default and essential-movement exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0010.title: Use the floor to place large immersive content

statement.en: Use the floor to place a large visionOS immersive experience.
statement.ja: largeなvisionOS immersive experienceの配置にfloorを使う。

conditions: Place floor-extending content on a flat horizontal plane aligned with the physical floor.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0010.review_note: Recorded the plane geometry and physical-floor alignment technique.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0012.title: Center important visionOS content in the field of view

statement.en: Center important visionOS content within the field of view.
statement.ja: importantなvisionOS contentをfield of view内の中央に置く。

conditions: Avoid distracting motion and bright, high-contrast peripheral objects around important content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0012.review_note: Recovered the Center lead and recorded its immersive attention constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0013.title: Rely on the Digital Crown for visionOS window recentering

statement.en: Rely on the Digital Crown to let people recenter visionOS windows.
statement.ja: visionOS windowのrecenterにはDigital Crownを利用する。

conditions: The system handles recentering; the app needs no custom support for the action.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0013.review_note: Recovered the Rely lead and recorded that recentering is system-provided.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0014.title: Avoid overlapping visionOS interactive elements

statement.en: Avoid overlapping visionOS controls with other interactive elements or views.
statement.ja: visionOS controlを他のinteractive elementやviewと重ねない。

conditions: Preserve reliable gaze selection of a single element.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0014.review_note: Recovered the direct overlap prohibition and its gaze-selection rationale.
